title: [Ratha Kanneer] Thannai Arindhu
english_stanzas:
Dance, O snake! Dance, O snake!
Dance, O snake, and say: tend the Great Light!

Is there feeling in a stone idol cut by the chisel?
Is there feeling in the fools of this world?
Does the flaw in copper go when it is scoured with tamarind?
Ignorance will not leave the fool: dance, O snake, and say so!

Does pure wisdom come from doing pooja?
Is there merit in walking around the earth?
Only in the hour when desire is gone is the First Being
ever reached: say it boldly, and dance, O snake!
Dance, O snake! Dance, O snake!

The four Vedas, the six kinds of Shastras, and many more,
the Tantras, the Puranas, and the Agamas that proclaim them,
and all the other books of every kind:
dance, O snake, and call them empty books!
Dance, O snake! Dance, O snake!

title: [Joe] Urugi Urugi
english_stanzas:
Without you, my sky would close
You alone are my love, always

Is it the veena, or the flute,
Or the honeyed voice that speaks?
Is it the milk, or the anklet’s chime,
Or the silver chains on your feet?

Is it the white butter melting on the shore,
Or the babbling words?
Or the rainbow in your eyes,
Those hues of love?

Without you, my sky would close
You alone are my love, always

title: [Siddhar Paadal] Kudhambai
english_stanzas:
For those who embrace the boundless sky as truth,
what use is a title or ownership?
O, adorned one?
what use is a title or ownership?

For the sage who has seen the essence of all,
What use are rigid vows,
O, adorned one?
What use are rigid vows?

For those who perceive beyond sight itself,
What binds them to desire,
O, adorned one?
What binds them to desire?

For those who have found the path free of deceit,
Why let the mind waver,
O, adorned one?
Why let the mind waver?

For those who have seen the source and the end,
What need is there for arguments,
O, adorned one?
What need is there for arguments?

For those who have shattered sleep and dwell in awareness,
What need for outward gestures,
O, adorned one?
What need for outward gestures?

For those who stand firm in wisdom’s plane,
What need for chants and spells,
O, adorned one?
What need for chants and spells?

For those who walk the path of truth in penance,
What need for rituals,
O, adorned one?
What need for rituals?

For those who dissolve in the stillness of union,
What need for sorrow and strife,
O, adorned one?
What need for sorrow and strife?

For the sage, steeped in the essence of Tamil’s wisdom,
What need for noise and hollow echoes,
O, adorned one?
What need for noise?

For the one who has risen beyond the mind’s peak,
And glimpsed the vastness beyond,
What place for desires still clinging?
O, adorned one?
what place for desires?

For the one who has burned slow and steady,
Until emptiness itself unfolds,
What need for the illusions of passion?
O, adorned one,
what need for longing?

For the one who walks the solitary path,
Unfettered, untouched by death itself,
What need for retreat and renunciation?
O, adorned one,
what need for seclusion?

For the one who moves boundless in the infinite void,
Dancing in the cosmos unchained,
What need for schemes and cunning?
O, adorned one,
what need for trickery?

For the one who overflows in bliss,
Rooted deep in knowing,
What need for even the notion of wisdom?
O, adorned one,
what need for knowledge itself?

For the one who walks among sages each day,
What need for vows and safeguards?
O, adorned one,
What need for caution and script?

For the one who has seen wholeness itself,
Why would they return to this earth?
O, adorned one,
Why would they return?

In the vastness, standing empty and still,
Why do you gaze upon it with longing?
O, adorned one,
Why do you still yearn?

From form to formless, from light to boundless sky,
It stands as divine radiance, see it!
O, adorned one,
See it as sacred presence!

The One who is the beginning and the end,
Shines as pure radiance eternal,
O, adorned one,
Shines as pure radiance eternal.

Anger, envy, cruel words, and hardened grasp,
Are but seeds of sin,
O, adorned one,
Are but seeds of sin.

For the sage who restrains haste and knows the truth,
What need for discipline and postures?
O, adorned one,
What need for yogic rites?

For the one who has conquered the self,
And sits atop the mountain still,
What need for temple rituals?
O, adorned one,
What need for sacred offerings?

For the one who walks as if already dead,
What need for clapping hands in praise?
O, adorned one,
What need for songs and dance?

To scorn the pure-hearted, the noble ones,
Is to fall into the depths of ruin.
O, adorned one,
It is to sink into the lowest pit.

For the one who has seen truth,
And understood the way of wisdom,
What use is a deer skin seat?
O one adorned in golden hoops,
What need for these false displays?

For the seeker who has stilled the mind,
And placed it in the hands of the Lord,
Why wear matted locks and beard?
O, adorned one,
Why carry the marks of a sage?

For the one who drinks mango’s raw milk,
And dwells atop the mountain high,
What need for coconut’s sweet milk?
O, adorned one,
What need for luxury anymore?

The gold you hoard, the wealth you chase,
When death arrives, does it follow your trace?
O, adorned one,
Does it walk beside you to the grave?

For the one with no roots, no home of his own,
What use are hymns and temple songs?
O, adorned one,
Why sing praises when all is unknown?

For those who have known themselves,
And merged with the Supreme,
What use are lingering desires?
O, adorned one,
What use are lingering desires?

Those who shed their suffering,
Yet hold steady to the path,
Shall see the Eternal, the Divine.
O, adorned one,
Shall see the Eternal, the Divine.

title: [Pattinathar] Oru Mada Maathum Oruvanum Aagi
english_stanzas:
A man and woman unite in love,
A bond of joy, as life’s threads interweave.
From passion’s surge, a seed is cast,
Merging with essence, a miracle amassed.

A single drop, cold and slight,
Nestles within, igniting life’s light.
A tender bud forms, a vessel of grace,
Growing limbs, a soul takes its place.

Eyes to see, ears to hear,
A voice to speak, a form draws near.
Nine months pass, destiny aligns,
The mother labors, the child defines.

Born to earth, bound to fate,
Guided by stars, time, and date.
Days, weeks, and moments decree,
Life unfolds, as it’s destined to be.

Wrapped in the care of a mother’s embrace,
Silken drapes fall, a tender trace.
From gentle bosom flows nectar sweet,
Nurturing wisdom as the child’s first feat.

Glistening ornaments, tender lips smiling,
The infant crawls, their joy beguiling.
From a mother’s lap, words first arise,
Calling out, “Come, stay,” with innocent cries.

Adorned in anklets and silken threads,
Nourished with care, to life they’re led.
Playing in dust from streets untamed,
Wandering, exploring, by curiosity claimed.

At five years old, in games they revel,
Unaware of life’s deeper level.
With time, they seek wisdom’s embrace,
A guru’s guidance, life’s rightful place.

Through Tamil’s arts, they glimpse life’s shore,
Praised as a crescent destined to soar.
Sixteen springs come, youth takes form,
Beauty ignites hearts, passion’s storm.

A figure enchanting, the girls behold,
With darting glances, their feelings unfold.
He struts like a peacock, graceful, grand,
Hearts aflutter, they follow, unmanned.

Unable to bear their silent plight,
They search and chase, day and night.
Offering riches to gain his grace,
Caught in the fervor of love’s embrace.

Youth departs, vigor fades,
Teeth fall, and eyes dim in shade.
Age advances, hair turns grey,
Wracked by ailments, the body gives way.
A cane in hand becomes their guide,
Stooped and bent, they stumble aside.

Steps falter, their gait now slow,
Bowed by the weight of years they show.
Hearing dulls, the mind grows frail,
Words tumble forth, an unbroken trail.
With a rush, the body betrays,
The ebb of life, its fragile ways.

Speech falters, the tongue now mute,
Fingers tremble, their grip is brute.
Thin gruel trickles as the final fare,
The body ceases, life hangs in despair.
Breath halts, the chest heaves no more,
As time brings them to eternity’s shore.

Like a waxing crescent, his teeth gleam white,
His body is hairy, a dreadful sight.
Darkness in form, his visage stark,
A towering mountain, the death messengers embark.

With nets in hand, they cast their snare,
Claiming the soul in a moment rare.
The sons, in grief, bow low and weep,
Carrying their father, his fate to meet.

Through stumbling steps, they reach the pyre,
Consumed by grief as flames leap higher.
Wood piled high, the blaze takes hold,
Burning the body, life’s story retold.

The flesh melts away, the bones charred black,
The soul departs, never turning back.
A fistful of ash, all that remains—
Oh Lord, I surrender; break life’s chains!

title: [Jaanu] Journey
english_stanzas:
Who am I amidst this vast crowd,
oh leaf?
I cast away my identity and rose above,
oh mind!

Amidst the vast throng where the self fades,
Life calls out with a loud cry—’Come, live!’
Grace, in its faint voice, softly speaks,
Guiding me toward an unfathomable depth,
I swim and swim, only to drown,
Touching a life that remains unlived,
Clarity, clarity, clarity unfolds,
And in that clarity, I bloom
In a light unseen, I behold myself,
Fully and completely, for the very first time.
In an unfallen state, I rise,
Madness surges, energy flows, clarity dawns,
And I float weightless, liberated, whole.

Profundity is the state of true wisdom,
Here, now, and in this moment—everything exists.
Appearances are but deceptive arguments,
Here, now, and in this moment—everything exists.
Days are a lie, a construct of time,
Here, now, and in this moment—everything exists.
Listen, listen! The voice of clarity resounds,
As I hear and hear, it transcends all sound,
And echoes beyond what ears can perceive.

Beyond the pride of six senses,
Effortlessly, I’ll exist with ease,
As one life, unified in being.
Unshaken, even if broken by others,
Like a doll that smiles regardless,
I will remain true to my nature.
Like a leaf that rests on a flowing river,
I will sit lightly and take flight.
Watching the beauty of a mother asleep on earth,
Like a child who slumbers in response,
I will emulate boundless love,
Endlessly, without pause.

I sat at the edge of the infinite,
Now, now, in this moment, as an eye that sees.
I merge with the ultimate truth,
Now, now, becoming one with it.
In boundless love, I swayed and blossomed,
Now, now, I am whole.
I dissolve into immense power,
As the illusions of differences and desires fade away.

Within myself, I swayed,
Like a swing moving gently to and fro.
Who set me swaying and watched,
Unwavering, without weariness?
Like a crow playing on mighty waves,
Who created me with such daring?

Like a child who smiles,
Even at a roaring tiger,
Forgetting anger, I will smile,
Unfazed and unflinching.

Like the ripples forming a ring,
Where a flower falls upon the pond,
I will pass on the vibrations of my life,
Without a cry, without despair.

As an utterance, I live,
Echoing through the expanse of existence.
As fragments, I transform,
Becoming the very whole I once sought.
Like the tide, I flow forward,
Ebbing and surging, ceaselessly.
I become the messenger,
Carrying the essence of what I’ve lived.

Like a blossom, I bloom and flourish,
Awakening into vibrant existence.
Like an ear, I listen intently,
Absorbing the whispers of the universe.
Aararo Aaraariraro,
Time cradles and rocks me softly,
Wisdom nods in gentle affirmation.
Aararo Aaraariraro,
It sings like a mother’s song.

Jaanu, Journey song translation and meaning.

title: [Gulu Gulu] Anbarey
english_stanzas:
Endless are the joys, a thousand-fold they bloom,
Humanity becomes the cradle, holding them in its womb
The inner soul is exhilarated, deeply alight,
Its reason bears no intent, no guiding light.

Who drapes tomorrow in honeyed hues?
Who sketches patterns, on time’s sand?
Who layered milk on barren lands?
Who stretched the sky’s bridge vast and far?

He poured flowers into moonlight’s grace,
And I swam through the pond, a quiet place.
He cast a fish into the moon’s embrace,
I become a star, consumed by her grace.

Beloved, you who join me on my way,
Beloved, whose smiles brighten my day.
Beloved, the adorable song in bus rides, you are,
Beloved, the breeze that whispers through the window, you are.

A yearning that never existed, is it this?
Or a dream that lulls sleep into bliss?
A natural force that shapes my breath,
Or a sublime essence that transcends death?

Is it the aroma of tea from a neighbor’s home,
Or love that flows steady, like a river’s roam?
A closeness that feels like a distant shore,
Or the tender affection of a half-bloomed flower?

He poured flowers into moonlight’s grace,
And I swam through the pond, a quiet place.
He cast a fish into the moon’s embrace,
I become a star, consumed by her grace.

Beloved, you who join me on my way,
Beloved, whose smiles adorn my day.
Beloved, the adorable song in bus rides, you are!
Beloved, the breeze that whispers through the window, you are!

He touched my reflection, set me afire?
Planted a kiss, then thought to retire?
What twist of fate would this moment bestow?
Did he happen for it?

Without a warning, he entered my soul,
Rushing in, like speed’s doubled roll.
He never touched, yet with eyes’ embrace, he leaves?

Is he the enduring essence of humanity,
Or does he restlessly strive to fade away?
Is he revealed in the river’s reflective flow,
Only to vanish in a fleeting moment’s glow?

Will he carry the tale forward, unbroken,
Or is he the deer that deceives the eye?
A fleeting comfort for just a moment’s stay,
Or a memory etched, lingering every day?
Is he a wave in the ocean of memory’s tide,
Is this the truth at last?
Or is it still my dream?
Or is it the drama the heart weaves in our meeting’s span,
For which the falling of the curtain is imminent?

Beloved, you who join me on my way,
Beloved, whose smiles adorn my day.
Beloved, the adorable song in bus rides, you are!
Beloved, the breeze that whispers through the window, you are!

title: [Vaazhai] Thenkizhakku
english_stanzas:
From the southeast, a honeybee hums,
And a budding hibiscus,
With endearment, they sing a heartfelt lullaby.

Like a rainbow unseen for countless days,
Your words arrive, a radiant display.
High in the skies, like a soaring fish,
Your yearning leaps, a boundless wish.

In the rainfall of your radiant smile,
I sprout as a plant, blooming all the while.
Until the scorching sun’s days arrive,
I’ll support your vine, a motherly guide.

As you weave your story, word by word,
And I listen, in silence, undisturbed,
We become magical birds in flight.

From the southeast, a honeybee hums,
A budding hibiscus softly blooms,
With endearment, it coos a heartfelt lullaby.

A lone cloud drifts through the open sky,
Won’t it sing, with wings spread high?
Like starlit patterns an ant might draw,
Won’t words dance, enchanted by your awe?

The playful mischief you knowingly weave,
Reveals you clearly, a joy to perceive.
I’ll strum a million tunes within its embrace.

As chariots race through every street,
And trees sway to swings in rhythmic beat,
Won’t time itself hasten its fleet?

The palms will flow with sweet milk anew,
Celebrate that thought, let joy ensue.
A day will dawn when hunger subsides,
Dance, forgetting pain, as hope abides.

The palms will flow with sweet milk anew,
Celebrate that thought, let joy ensue.
A day will dawn when hunger subsides,
Dance, forgetting pain, as hope abides.

The palms will flow with sweet milk anew
(As you weave your story, word by word)
Celebrate that thought, let joy ensue
(And I listen, in silence, undisturbed)
We’ll become magical birds in flight.
A day will dawn when hunger subsides
(As you weave your story, word by word)
And the sun will rise to brighter tides
(And I listen, in silence, undisturbed)
Forget all pain, and dance in delight
(We’ll become magical birds in flight).

A day will dawn when hunger fades,
Forget your pain, let your dance cascade.

title: [Sangamam] Margazhi Thingal
english_stanzas:
It is the month of Margazhi,
A day radiant with the moon’s glow.
Come, let us bathe in sacred waters,
O maidens adorned with fine ornaments.

In the thriving village of Ayarpadi,
O prosperous young maidens,
See the son of Nandagopan,
The fierce wielder of the sharp spear,
The youthful lion, Yashoda’s pride.

Is this not the month of Margazhi?
Is this not the day kissed by the moon’s light?
Is this not the time for Krishna to arrive?

Just one glimpse of your divine face,
Is enough to set my soul free.

Just one glimpse of your divine face,
Is enough to set my soul free.

Come, my Lord,
Must this life remain a mere dream?

Is this not the month of Margazhi?
Is this not the day kissed by the moon’s light?
Is this not the time for Krishna to arrive?

My heart trembles,
Overflowing with tears that refuse to cease.

Like water streaming through my hands,
Why does my soul feel like it’s fading away?

Shall we meet just once,
Or will only you see my body remain?

In the brilliance of art,
Is it wrong to confess love?
Please give me your answer.

Is this not the month of Margazhi?
Is this not the day kissed by the moon’s light?
Is this not the time for Krishna to arrive?

Just one glimpse of your divine face,
Is enough to set my soul free.

Come, my Lord,
Must this life remain a mere dream?

Oh, the flame of love you lit,
Extinguish this sorrow.

Let the hope of tomorrow’s dusk
Grow and nurture my belief.

Our love is a sacred flame,
A radiant flame of art,
Oh, goddess of beauty, come to me!

title: [Shanti Nilayam] iraivan varuvaan
english_stanzas:
The divine will come
He always shows the path of virtue and grace

Let us know Him
For His love is the mercy we receive

In vibrant flowers, He placed the fruit
In a single shell, He hid the pearl

In tender hearts, He sowed affection
And made affection speak in their hearts

Love is the temple
Desire is the land
And affection is the home

He built the temple called the heart
And gave the gates called the eyes

He showed us the path that the eyes can see
And urged us to walk the righteous paths

Let the eyes see Him
Let the heart think of Him
And let the hands worship Him

The divine will come
He always shows the path of virtue and grace

title: [Vaidehi Kathirunthal] Rasathi Unnai
english_stanzas:
My dear darling, the heart that can’t see you,
Flutters aimlessly like a tattered kite in the breeze.

My dear darling, the heart that can’t see you,
Flutters aimlessly like a tattered kite in the breeze.

The day has slipped away,
The lamp has been lit,
Oh golden deer, this heart wanders, searching for you.

My dear darling, the heart that can’t see you,
Flutters aimlessly like a tattered kite in the breeze.

For the eyes, you are a vibrant parrot,
For the ears, you are a melodious cuckoo,
To my heart, you are the spreading forest vine,
You are everything, my love.

Oh darling, you are the slippery shining golden box,
Oh darling, you are the ever-growing classic Tamil language,
Oh darling, you are the everlasting star that comes to kiss me daily.
Who is there for me on this Earth without you?
You alone are my life and breath, come back,
So that I can live.

A maiden as pure as the Ganges,
A prince as charming as Krishna,
Whisper a love story into my ears,
Why not?

Is she my aunt’s daughter or my uncle’s daughter?
What bond do we share, what relation ties us?
In every meeting, in every thought, there’s a sweetness.
Oh dear, the days you are absent
Are like a sky where clouds cannot swim.
The unyielding longing is unbearable, overwhelming.

My dear darling, the heart that can’t see you,
Flutters aimlessly like a tattered kite in the breeze.
The day has slipped away,
The lamp has been lit,
Oh golden deer, this heart wanders, searching for you.

My dear darling, the heart that can’t see you,
Flutters aimlessly like a tattered kite in the breeze.

title: [Viduthalai Part 2] Dhinam dhinamum
english_stanzas:
Daily, daily, your memories
Bend me and make me lost

Daily, daily, your memories
Bend me and make me lost

Every moment, pulling me closer
Its enduring pain is unbearable

No way to get out of it
Inside, my heartbeat has lost its rhythm

No way to get out of it
Inside, even my heartbeat has lost its rhythm

Daily, daily, your memories
Bend me and make me lost

When our eyes met first time,
Various thoughts sang like a cuckoo

Without focus, something turned me around
Everything I heard became music
My heart fell into a trap
Couldn’t escape from that whirlpool

You sing only my song, dear
Protecting my words for me

Two little birds clinging together
One circles while the other comes
As pearl-like rain gently pours from the sky

Daily, daily, your memories
Bend me and make me lost
Daily, daily, your memories…

I wait, watching the path you walk
My restless heart leaps when the wind sways

At the doorstep, like flowers on a kolam
Seeing you, my longing subsides and  stops tormenting me!
I’m alone, my heart is anguished
Your cool face has calmed it

Is the earth spinning just for us?
Is day turning into night?

As the stars wink their eyes
Come close and embrace me
I want to rest my head on your shoulder peacefully

Daily, daily, your memories
Bend me and make me lost

Every moment, pulling me closer
Enduring this pain is unbearable

No way to step outside
Inside, even my heartbeat has lost its rhythm
No way to step outside
Inside, even my heartbeat has lost its rhythm
Daily, daily…

title: [En Magan] neengal athanai perum …
english_stanzas:
Are each of you truly noble?
Reach within and examine the truth in your heart.

The wealthy are seen as virtuous,
While the poor bear a tainted label in this world.
Then, what truly is good or evil?
What is sin or virtue on this path?

Are each of you truly noble?
Reach within and examine the truth in your heart.

I saw a black serpent, alluringly beautiful,
I saw reverence given to those who wrong others,
I saw schemers rising to positions of honor,
And witnessed the pity of those who fault me for truth.

The thief lives like a generous benefactor,
The temple destroyer like a holy man,
The corrupt as dignified men,
The deceiver of towns as a true noble.

Are each of you truly noble?
Reach within and examine the truth in your heart.

Behind the mask of law, a farce plays on,
Today, the dance of authority changes faces.
But those above watch their every move,
The truth may not show now, but time will reveal.

Their guise won’t last,
Tomorrow’s world will not let them go,
Mark my words.

The thief who evades for many days, will one day face his cell,
And the sinner’s curse, through generations, will prevail.

Are each of you truly noble?
Reach within and examine the truth in your heart.

title: [Karakattakkaran] indha maan undhan sondha
english_stanzas:
This deer is yours, truly yours,
It draws near and sings softly by your side.

Oh soul that dances within my thoughts,
Precious gem of my eyes,
I long to meet you, divine one,
You, my very life.

In the hook of your spear-like gaze,
I fell, helplessly caught upon your shoulders.

In this delicate affliction, worn thin like thread,
I seek blessings at the temple of your grace.

Oh graceful swan,
My golden treasure,
Your thoughts are colored like the rainbow’s arc.

Oh, your cheek, like a goblet of nectar adorned,
Gleams with jewels, with diamonds sparkling bright.

Thoughts of you bring delightful trouble,
A river of ecstasy flows within the grace of womanhood.

The golden girdle sways,
Seeking its place within the depth of your eyes.

A glance at her form stirs shyness,
And in joy, I find a tender pain.

Oh, what happens when I think of you!
My body gleams, while the pain lingers close behind.

Words pierce my heart,
Even the Lord in heaven tests me, teasing my soul.

Desire flows from this very body,
In longing, I stand, filled with bliss.

This deer is truly yours,
It draws near and sings softly by your side.

Oh soul that dances within my thoughts,
Precious gem of my eyes,
I long to meet you, divine one,
You, my very life.

title: [Anandha Jodhi] Kadavul irukkindrar
english_stanzas:
God exists,
God is here—
But can you see Him with your eyes?
Though you drift through the air itself,
Can you see it with your eyes?
Can you truly see it with your eyes?
God is here, but can your eyes perceive Him?

In the dark, you open your eyes—can you grasp what’s before you?
You revel in music’s tune, yet do you ever see its form?

The shape of truth lying deep within—
Does it reveal itself outside?
Buddha may have passed away—but do his teachings fade?

Has truth ever truly fallen?
Has righteousness ever vanished from the world?

Even after reading all of history,
Does doubt still creep in?
Does doubt still rise within you?

Justice cannot be found just by seeking,
Nor does it sit on the streets.
Justice will not bow to the whip,
Nor is it swayed by the law’s rule.

It arises in time, with hands outstretched,
And it does not hesitate to protect.
It does not hesitate to guard.

God exists,
God exists,
God exists.

title: [Avan Pithana?] Iraivan irukkinraanaa …
english_stanzas:
Does God exist?
This is what humanity asks.
If He exists in this world,
Where does He live?
Where does He live?

I became a theist, placing my faith in Him,
Yet He never revealed Himself.
I became an atheist, abandoning belief,
And still, He showed no fear ( did not care)

Does humanity exist?
This is what God asks.
If they truly exist in this world,
Where do they live?
Where do they live?

I showered love on Him,
But He never took me in.
Even to lift this suffering,
He didn’t come to lend a hand.

There’s no certainty in vision,
No justice in love.
The heart that is present one day
Is absent the next.

One heart resides in a humble hut,
Another in a grand tower.
When unwanted ties start to bind,
The heart splinters, countless thoughts unwind.

The one who sees is blind,
The one who reads is ignorant.
The one who speaks truth
Is labeled mad in this world.

Water boils, yet the fire cools,
A mirror shows white as black,
In this world, reality often fools.

Even when unified in thought
And living as one,
Who has ever thought
Of the woman as precious as their eye?

If she’s there, she’s confined to her place;
If she’s not, she’s easily forgotten.
If these are humanity’s values,
Then nature itself will halt.

Once doubt is born,
Truth can’t flourish.
Even those who are supposed to uphold truth
Don’t come forward to testify.

The case remains unresolved,
Humanity’s judgment is absent.
One who forgets humanity
Cannot be called divine.

Does God exist?
This is what humanity asks.
If He exists in this world,
Where does He live?
Where does He live?

title: [Uththaman] Kelai magane
english_stanzas:
Listen, my son, hear these words,
You are the hero of tomorrow’s world.
Listen, my son, hear these words,
You are the hero of tomorrow’s world.

If you see wrongdoing, turn away from it,
Look ahead and follow the righteous path.
Be brave enough to face danger,
And leave sorrow behind you.

You are the sacred light of the aarti,
The sound of the divine chants,
The bell of the temple—you are, indeed, you are…

Be adaptable in your ways like a monkey,
Yet transform into a tiger when faced with cruelty.
Focus sharply like the crane,
And embody the strength of an elephant in character.

You are the graceful dancing deer,
The joyous peacock,
The chirping parrot—you are, indeed, you are…

What the father gave, he entrusted to the mother,
And what the earthly mother gave, she passed to me.
While the Divine Mother resides above,
Her essence and heart are with you always.

title: [Sethu] Maalai en vedhanai
singer: P. Unnikrishnan, Arunmozhi, S. N. Surendar
english_stanzas:
The evening adds to my sorrow, dear,
Love is showing its strength over me.
Why do you torment me so? Tell me, my love.
Show your face, my full moon,
You are the veena of my love.
In the melody of my pain,
My heart races with desire.

The evening adds to my sorrow, dear,
Love is showing its strength over me.

There are thousands of stories here of those who’ve lost in love,
Love isn’t false, nor is it a lie;
There are countless true stories on this earth.
What’s the suspense in your love, Ambi?

The sin of love began in Adam’s time,
Why waste time in needless sorrow?
Let the story reach its conclusion at the right moment.

Will the day come when the little bird lands in my hand?
Will heaven appear here on earth?
The evening adds to my sorrow, dear,
Love is showing its strength over me.

What’s the flower’s answer to the wind’s questions?
What’s the moon’s answer to the cloud’s questions?
Even the dancing waves of the sea have an answer, little brother.

Seeing her silence, my heart trembles,
Unwanted thoughts arise when it’s about love’s union.
Desire pierces deep within my heart,
My soul longs to rest in her lap.

The evening adds to my sorrow, dear,
Love is showing its strength over me.
Why do you torment me so? Tell me, my love.
Show your face, my full moon,
You are the veena of my love.
In the melody of my pain,
My heart races with desire.
The evening adds to my sorrow, dear,
Love is showing its strength over me.

title: [96] Yean
english_stanzas:
Why did you leave without a word?
Why did you leave yesterday’s door unlocked, leaving me behind?

The sky is dark,
But where are my clouds?
Is this moment a riddle,
As my steps wade through tears?

The melodies of our love
The flowing tears now
Become prayers in my search for you.

I thought you left the city,
But my eyes still search for you here and everywhere.

If you have abandoned the root of our love,
That truth will haunt me deep inside.

Where is your sky?
While my eyes seek you.

Thoughts of tomorrow burn within me,
Where is your path?
My wings are weighed down like stones,
A bird that will die grounded, unable to soar.

title: [96] Iravingu Theevai
english_stanzas:
Separation takes form, and I melt away,
Like the soul of my soul, I part from you.

You flowed into my heart like a river from the mountains,
Bringing many oceans to this barren land.
Let the dreams fade away, as they accompany me.

This lotus, despite being in the pond, feels lonely,
Two lives on the same path search for each other,

Without you, my days are lifeless,
Life, come back to me, you are the soul of my soul,
Will you return?
Will you return?

Each day, life awakens,
But the heart vanishes, day by day.
Till the end of life, filled with you,
The heart celebrates you and lives on.

Even when the trees fall and nests shatter,
The cuckoos still sing their melody.
When the night ends and finds its rest,
The moon waits patiently.

The rain flows to the sea,
This deep love reaches the earth.
Even if the body separates from you,
My love will always stay with you.

title: [Love Insurance Kompany] Dheema
english_stanzas:
The one who broke the cage of my heart,
The dear daughter-in-law for my parents,
Show me the way,
To lie down beside you, my love.
Will fate allow me,
To have children from your bloodline?

In the heart of the town,
On a street,
In this light-filled moment.

Waiting for the rain to come,
For it to deliver you to me,
Wondering what the universe is planning,
What fate holds for us.

Inside the home you’ve built,
Among the tender plants and blooming flowers,
With your curly hair swaying,
And two sons by your side,
A gift from the divine,
Their eyelashes heavy with dreams.
Like the beat of a drum,
And she blooms.
You should always come back to me as my love.

For our two sons,
To wed two daughters,
Who bear your face,
Blessed by the divine,
And all will gather,
To take beautiful pictures,

Show me the way,
To lie down beside you, my love.
Will fate allow me,
To have children from your bloodline?

title: [96] Vasantha kaalangal
english_stanzas: The spring seasons are turning bitter as they pass,

The thirst for life that once bloomed is now withering,
Won’t the moments of the past return to soothe this pain?

Can my heart survive in the indifference of your gaze?
Words, like cowards, fail to sing, even when the lute is in hand.
The spring seasons are turning bitter as they pass,

In the sorrows of love,
Even the truths we held start to fade.
The paths multiply endlessly,
But they all lead back to you.

Will you let me burn in this love like the moon’s gentle light?
Will you deceive me in the morning’s glow? Come.
In the painful darkness, will you survive?
This dawn, my love, belongs to us.
The spring seasons are turning bitter as they pass,

title: [96] Thaabangale…
english_stanzas:
They fall, touch, and burn the beauty within,
Like a mother, they lull and soothe.
Through the path of eyes, through unspoken words,

They fall, touch, and burn the beauty within,
Like a mother, they lull and soothe.
Through the path of eyes, through unspoken words,

Doesn’t time become the bird of the night?
The same song, the same question.
Hasn’t the sky slipped down to embrace and dance?

They fall, touch, and burn the beauty within,
Like a mother, they lull and soothe.
Through the path of eyes, through unspoken words,

Am I the fire being drenched?
Are you the unending rain?
Will I be extinguished?
Is this a spontaneous melody?
Is it dreams of love?
Is it not enough?

Are the questions of time endless? Enough.
As you come closer, my melting heart fades away.

They fall, touch, and burn the beauty within,
Like a mother, they lull and soothe.
Through the path of eyes, through unspoken words,

title: [Captain Prabhakaran] Aattama Therottama
english_stanzas:
Is it a dance, a chariot procession, or a grand show?
Is it a dance, a chariot procession, or a grand show?
For so long, as a maiden, I’ve been thinking only of you,
I dance, I cast my net,
I sing, seeking answers.

Oh, Samba, Samba, a beauty so fine,
Samba, Rambha, a beauty so fine,

Is it a dance, a chariot procession, or a symbolic act?
Is it a dance, a chariot procession, or a classical dance?

The stage that was never climbed, now even the young lad has mounted,
The dance you’ve never seen is performed just for you.
Singing a riddle song no one can understand,
Oh my, I’ve curved it all out, searching precisely.

The rooster’s crow is being heard—Oh, my dear King!
The gentle breeze is swirling in circles.
Your bold glance has caught me—You’re searching for me.
The passing wind gently burned me.

Won’t the golden deer leap and frolic in celebration?
In this wounded heart, won’t the scars heal today?
The maiden’s thoughts will end for sure, come, haha!

Is it a dance, a chariot procession, or a grand show?
For so long, as a maiden, I’ve been thinking only of you,
I dance, I cast my net,
I sing, seeking answers.

Oh, Samba, Samba, a beauty so fine,
Samba, Rambha, a beauty so fine,

title: [Aayirathil Oruvan] Adho andha paravai…
english_stanzas:
Let us live like that bird so free,
Let us dance like the waves of the sea.
Beneath the same sky, upon the same land,
Let us sing together, our anthem of rights, hand in hand.
The wind does not forsake us as slaves to bind,
Love, compassion, and motherhood do not stray.

No one is born without a mother’s embrace,
We cannot speak without words, without a trace.
In death, we all walk the same path after all.

A million people must live in unity, free,
Let our nation be as sacred as a temple, you’ll see.
Without fear, let us dance and sing with glee,
Freedom must reign on all lands where slavery be.

Beneath the same sky, upon the same land,
Let us sing together, our anthem of rights, hand in hand.

Let us live like that bird so free,
Let us dance like the waves of the sea.
Beneath the same sky, upon the same land,
Let us sing together, our anthem of rights, hand in hand.

title: [Kathiruntha Kangal] Valarntha Kalai …
english_stanzas:
She’s forgotten the skills she once grew, listen, my son,
Look at the painting she once carefully drew, my son.
She’s forgotten the skills she once grew, listen, my son,
Look at the painting she once carefully drew, my son.

Tell your father that family skills are enough, my son,
Why still pursue these other arts too, my son?
Tell your father that family skills are enough, my son,
Why still pursue these other arts too, my son?

She’s forgotten the skills she once grew, listen, my son,
Look at the painting she once carefully drew, my son.

The girl who spoke of love, where is she now, my son?
The girl who spoke of love, where is she now, my son?
The one I married has changed, tell me why, my son?
The bride I tied the sacred thread to, why has she changed, my son?

Tell him that the one who loved him is still his wife, my son,
Tell him that the one who loved him is still his wife, my son,
Why did he close his eyes back then, my son?

I wrote it in my heart that day, do you know, my son?
If asked to write it again, could I even do so, my son?

Why does she grow angry every day, tell me, my son?
What does she need, what does she desire—ask her, my son.

Can one say aloud everything they think, my son?
Can I tell you all of this only after you’re born, my son?

She’s forgotten the skills she once grew, listen, my son,
Look at the painting she once carefully drew, my son.

Let all that has happened until now just pass, my son,
Tell her to live with me from now on without anger, my son.

Who else do I have besides him, my son?
Tell him I came to him seeking refuge, my son.

title: [Thiruvilaiyadal] Isai Thamizh
english_stanzas:
Musical Tamil, the grand feats you’ve achieved,
Yet in your presence, Lord, my trials aren’t relieved.
Musical Tamil, the grand feats you’ve achieved,
Musical Tamil, the grand feats you’ve achieved,
Yet in your presence, Lord, my trials aren’t relieved.
Musical Tamil, the grand feats you’ve achieved,
Yet in your presence, Lord, my trials aren’t relieved.
Musical Tamil, the grand feats you’ve achieved.

Shame descends upon the land of Pandya, O Divine,
Shame descends upon the land of Pandya,
O Lord Shiva, beloved of Parvati the fair, in your own abode,
Shame descends upon the land of Pandya,
O Lord Shiva, beloved of Parvati the fair, in your own abode,

Life swoons within the notes of celestial song,
In the music of the cosmos where souls belong.
Is victory meant for one, or to Madurai’s Tamil son?
Is victory meant for one, or to Madurai’s Tamil son?

Musical Tamil, the grand feats you’ve achieved,
Yet in your presence, Lord, my trials aren’t relieved.
O Divine!

Is the story of the Sivalingam bearing witness a lie? (Sundarar (Sundaramurthy Nayanar) story)
Is the method by which the maternal uncle delivered justice in the divine assembly also a lie? ( murugan, lord vishnu story)
Is the story of the Sivalingam bearing witness a lie?
Is the method by which the maternal uncle delivered justice in the divine assembly also a lie?

You who carried earth to fill the sacred ground,
Endured the lash of whips, yet faith in you was found. ( Reference : Tirunavukkarasar)
Even when Tamil’s voice calls out your name,
Why do you not answer?

Musical Tamil, the grand feats you’ve achieved,
Yet in your presence, Lord, my trials aren’t relieved.
O Divine!

If blame befalls the mother, isnt it for the son too?
If Mother Tamil suffers, won’t it affect you too?
O Leader who feeds the roots to help the tree survive,
if shame comes to your land, who will stand by?
If it’s not for you, then it’s not for me,
If it’s not for you, then it’s not for me,

Musical Tamil, the grand feats you’ve achieved,
Yet in your presence, Lord, my trials aren’t relieved.
O Divine!

title: [Idhaya Kamalam] unnai kaaNaadha kaNNum
english_stanzas:
A gaze without seeing you is no gaze at all,
A heart that doesn’t think of you is no heart at all,
Words not spoken by you are not words at all,
Without you, I am not myself at all.

Here, you are one half, and I am the other,
If either parts, half the pain remains.

Times will change, and scenes will shift,
In love’s presence, you and I are not different.

A temple without a deity is not a temple,
Without a temple there is no need of a lamp.
You are that temple, and I the lamp within,
In the presence of the divine, you and I are not different.

I embraced you like a child to my bosom, out of longing,
Will you give, or will I give?
Regardless of who gives, you and I are not different.

title: [Kandukondain Kandukondain] Kannamoochi yenada …
english_stanzas:
Why play hide and seek, my dear one?
I am fragile, like glass, easy to shun.
I asked the riverbank for your trace,
I asked the breeze to halt its chase.
I questioned the vast sky, but it gave no reply,
In the end, I found you, my heart’s ally.
I found you in the blossom of my heart,
A love so deep, never to part.

Is my heart just a toy for your play?
Don’t I have feelings, unique in their way?
The waves in my heart never find peace,
With your lips, come seal my mouth, come, my darling.
Close my eyes with your gentle lids,
Isn’t your body my attire, my bids?
Even after dancing in the ocean’s embrace,
Your color remains, still full of grace.
Merge into my heart, let our colors blend,
Join my soul, to you I extend.
Let our lips stay moist and tender,
Come unite with me, our love to render.

When rain falls from the sky, you shield with a mountain high,
When tears fall from my eyes, what will you use to keep me dry?
You savor the tears of a flower so tender,
Am I not a woman, my love, for you to render?
Do you lack the eyes to see my sorrow?
Am I absent from your dreams of tomorrow?
My heart swings daily, it’s no silent chime,
My anklets speak, not mute, through time.
In my breath, life swells and grows,
Only your touch can ease my throes.
Come give me life, let our love show.

title: [Sahodhari] Naan oru muttaaLunga
english_stanzas:
I am but a fool, or so they say,
Four learned wise ones declared it so.
I am but a fool, or so they say,

Those who previously spoke, now find themselves deceived,
Even while I know everything that transpired, I came to give counsel,
Yet, I am but a fool, that is the way.

They mocked the beautiful wife as donkey
“Hey ! Hey! Hey! Donkey!”
They proclaimed an adored wife a donkey,
When they faced them, their faces bore a strike so bold.
They demanded silence… they dragged and repeatedly bashed,
They bickered and babbled, with vexation unleashed.
I am but a fool, they say.

The shy one, who once walked with downcast eyes,
Now playfully winks, her boldness a surprise.
The milkmaid, now an all-rounder in every task,
Adopting the ways of the West, in spirits they bask.
Questioning brings kicks, as I stand in dismay,
I am but a fool, or so they say.

They spoke of four virtues like modesty and grace,
Yet a group that lost it all now roams this place.
I told those who’ve changed, and they came to hit,
The one who spoke out, me, they called a spineless twit.
I am but a fool, or so they say.

title: [Saamy] Kalyaanam Thaan Kattikittu
english_stanzas:
In wedlock’s dance, shall we take a chance,
Or flee like a free-spirited romance?

Shall we tie the sacred thread first and unite,
Or shall we bear offspring first and then unite in marriage’s light?

In the fragrance of frankincense, you gently grew,
You’re the one whose laughter’s timing always knew.

For the gods, there’s no need to seek auspicious time,
All the pretense and pretext you utter, it’s not fair in any rhyme.

You speak with such flavor, it’s enticing indeed,
Do you cook with the same flair, is it your culinary creed?

Mashing the toor dal, ghee’s richness in store,
Shall we make payasam, a treat to adore?

A simple balanced diet, did I ask of you that?
I inquired if you knew to cook with spice and fire, just like that?

Pepper rasam with the spiciness spike,
I’ll prepare it well; come taste, take a hike!

Do you know to fry crabs, or roast a chicken right,
Can you prepare goat-leg soup with all your might?
Is my hip’s spicy secret, hidden from plain sight?
If you find it, you can savor it with delight.

You resemble the Ayyanar deity guarding the town’s end,
Displaying your fiery mustache, a fierce and steadfast friend.
But akin to the mother hen, protective, you tend,
Fearful to venture beyond, in safety, you depend.

Once we fix the dates and exchange pleasantries with grace,
I shall cross the boundaries, following your embrace.

When Panguni month arrives, I’ll give you presents so fine,
Until then, my dear, let’s not rush, and in harmony, we’ll entwine.

As I bathe with turmeric, my heart does race,
Your sight makes my whole body blush with grace.

Shall I grind the fenugreek and apply it through your body, my dear?
Shall I be your pillow all through the night, drawing near?

title: [Karakattakkaran] Mundhi Mundhi …
english_stanzas:
At the forefront, Vinayaka, divine and dear,
Thirty million gods, to you we revere,
You came, you came, to us so near,
Blessings abundant, we hold them dear.

Oh, Sivaguru with mighty grace,
I offer devotion, this heart’s embrace,
With faith unwavering, I bow at your feet,
Bestow victory, in this sacred space.

In the vastness of the sky, nine planets aligned,
On this earthly realm, I bear a splendid water-pot (karagam), ornate and defined,
From the noble village, they converge, hearts entwined,

In the southern realms of Devi, bathed in Madurai’s golden ray,
I garnered countless laurels, gleaming in my dance’s bright display,
With Goddess Saraswathi’s grace, I learned the artful way,
Conquering realms, as a dancer, I excelled on stages, day by day.

With the summer rains and lightning’s striking drums,
No weakness, no fatigue in these legs that dance and strum,
Unfazed, unburdened, I remain a youthful man, life’s sum.

Who can win in a contest against me, you say?
To my golden feet, please reveal, don’t delay,
All women, blossoms fair, but these men, who are they?
They stand, forgotten, anxious, in disarray.

title: [Vaaranam Aayiram] Adiye Kolludhe
english_stanzas:
In your essence, you slay, oh so divine,
Beauty’s allure, in your grace, does shine.
The world surrenders, two souls entwine,
In the union of hearts, a love’s design.

With you, every passing second gains purpose,
My morning time and evening skies, without you, wither away.”

Day and night, your face, like bait,
Even my rest becomes a pursuit, why is it so?
First and last, it’s you, I know,
Why do I become perplexed after I realize?

In the wind’s embrace one day,
A fragrance came my way,
It’s your love, I must say,
Something electric in your gaze at play,
Striking me, I did sway,
In the rainy season, as the earth slides away,
My heart longs for you, come what may.

Your beauty’s peak, it’s you I seek,
I tread softly, a step or two,
One word, just one, in whispers meek,
this very moment, I will marry you

When your words take flight, my joy ignites,
Like a peacock’s plume, you caress me light.
The vast sky turns blue the whole while,
A fleeting moment of vermilion, your radiant smile.
For my sake, you’ve come, what more can I say?
Beside me, like a shadow, you choose to stay.
You surrendered to me, to claim my love’s true might,
In losing yourself, you emerged my eternal light.

title: [Pachaikili Muthucharam] Karu Karu …
english_stanzas:
Beneath those dark, enchanting eyes, a single glance’s trance,
A sip of nectar, overflow, in your spell, I dance.
Night’s slumber holds me close, but your presence I enhance,
When thoughts of rising bloom, a thunderous throw, perchance.

You… a garland of jasmine,
You… a tree that sheds its leaves, a grace reborn.
My shiny new silver pot, each night I chase,
In search of you, my eyes find their place.

You, like a golden statue, shining so bright,
Ivory peaks in the soft morning light,
In Cupid’s net, our hearts take their flight,
My eyes seek you out, in their depths, you alight.

With fresh and novel verses, my poetry blossoms abundantly,
Dreams upon dreams arrive, captivating my eyes with fervor,
Even as my heart makes a feeble attempt to forget,
Once again and again, your face lingers, making me endure.

Like a lotus leaf, you are yourself, serene and pure,
A solitary sun in a day, that’s what you truly are,
Bringing the southern breeze’s gift of rain, you endure,
And like a treasure, you blossom, shining like a star.

You’re a jasmine garland, delicate and fair,
A tree shedding leaves on the earthly terrain,
Like a fresh silver pot, precious and rare,
My eyes search for you, again and again.

You’re a golden statue so divine,
A white mountain where moonbeams shine,
With Cupid’s arrow, the web weaved fine,
My eyes seek you, my love’s lifeline.

One day after another, time flows away,
In the night the heart dies, awaiting the new day’s ray.
As we speak, still searching for what’s unknown,
Like the creases in my palm, slyness quietly runs, I implore.

You, the rain that falls upon the arid land,
Within, the storm brews, errors persist, hand in hand.

title: [Jailer] Rathamaarey …
english_stanzas:
Beloved of blood, oh beloved of blood,
Beloved of fervor, oh beloved of fervor,
Beloved of blood, oh beloved of fervor,
My beloved of blood.

The ones who bore you, oh how we bore you,
Announce your arrival to the world, my son.
Beloved of fervor, oh beloved of fervor,
My beloved of blood.

My face mirrored, my very soul’s core,
Born to carry my legacy,
Virtues that shape the world I hold,
None like you, a truth untold.

Beyond me, my connection true,
A refuge in you, strength anew.

Oh, my son, my son, draw near,
Oh, my son, my son, be here,
Let praise cascade, petals take flight,
In every realm, let your presence alight.

Oh, my son, oh, my son, draw near,
Oh, my son, oh, my son, be here,
With each glance, your image I wear,
Blossoms bloom, fragrant and rare.

Beloved of blood, oh beloved of blood,
Beloved of fervor, oh beloved of fervor,
Beloved of blood, oh beloved of fervor,
My beloved of blood.

The ones who bore you, oh how we bore you,
Announce your arrival to the world, my son.
Beloved of fervor, oh beloved of fervor,
My beloved of blood.

At destiny’s helm, resolute and grand,
Father and son, entwined, they stand,
Triumph tales echo through the land,
Cub of the lion, world proclaims your name,
Echoes of praise, a proud acclaim,
I rest, content, in that joyful fame.

A home that pours only love, its grace,
For those fortunate to embrace its warm embrace,
A wonder, a marvel, in that sacred space.

Architect of serenity, oh cherished son,
Oh, progeny, oh, progeny, you’re the one,
Oh, progeny, oh, progeny, what you’ve done.
Let praise rain down, petals dance free,
In every chapter of life’s grand decree.

Oh, my son, oh, my son, by my side,
Oh, my son, oh, my son, my pride,
Your face, a reflection, a story to share,
Blossoms adorn it, beyond compare.

Beloved of blood, oh beloved of blood,
Beloved of fervor, oh beloved of fervor,
Beloved of blood, oh beloved of fervor,
My beloved of blood.

The ones who bore you, oh how we bore you,
Announce your arrival to the world, my son.
Beloved of fervor, oh beloved of fervor,
My beloved of blood.

title: [Shanmugapriya] Iraivanukkum peyarai vaithaan …
english_stanzas:
A name was assigned to the almighty,
by a human here,

“There is no almighty”,
said another human here,

to both, some one gave the intellect
to say so,

Now understand its truth,
is he not god?
is he not god?

the trees sway with the winds,
has anyone seen the winds?

along the streets there is grass everywhere,
have you seen its seeds?

The skies take in the waters of the ocean,
have the eyes seen?

Inside the body resides the soul,
does the soul have a form?
doe the soul have a form?

the one who wandered in search,
said he could not find

the clear-headed one too
denied its existence
the one who denied the existence,
whose existence did he deny?

I never said that there is no power, he said
I never said so! he said

title: [Thillu Mullu] Thillu Mullu Thillu Mullu …
english_stanzas:
hodgepodge, hodgepodge,
the mind is full of stones and thorns,
A thousand dramas, A thousand roles,

He came dressed as the king,
he did not have a kingdom to rule,
he came dressed as the groom.
he does not have a bride in reality!

No shame, No sorrow,
Put on the act, there is no sin

Morning a sage,
in the evening (even) mother-in-law,

You can lie for the greater good
said saint Thiruvalluvar.
There are also ones who built temples for society (social good)
but were also thieves,
speaking the truth,
leaving all the doctrines,
and living, is it a sin or a boon?

even if a man without virility keeps a moustache,
he does not become valorous,
the thing which does not have the minute and hour hand,
does not show time,

for doing good, you may weild the sword,
if not, let it be

You may do anything, as long it is for the good,
You may do anything, as long it is for the good,

title: [Manapanthal] Udalukku uyir kaaval …
english_stanzas:
The soul guards the body,
The light guards the world,
The shores guard the ocean,
The eyelids guard the eyes,

Mother guards during childhood,
The intellect guards, when grow up,
In the youth, the companion guards,
when you die, who guards you?

the law is the guard for the outside,
while virtue is the guard of the mind,
If both vanish, who protects?
what is the guard, who is the guard, which is the guard?

To the damsel with love failure,
Who is the guard for her life?
To the soul whom she marries,
In this world, who is the guard?

title: [Manimandabam] uRavu varum oru naaL pirivu varum
song: uRavu varum oru naaL pirivu varum
english_stanzas: relationships will come some day, as will separation one day,

relationships will come some day, as will seperation one day,
there will be income, along the way expenses will come too,
relationships will come some day, as will seperation one day,

The day comes, and soon after night comes
The day comes, and soon after night comes
The dating companion will also leave
The dating companion will also leave
relationships will come some day, as will separation one day,

Some days in desire, some days in suffering
Some days in desire, some days in suffering
Some days in love, some days in worry
Some days in love, some days in worry
some days living, many days languishing,
we only live a few days, why does the heart wilt away on so many days?
relationships will come some day, as will separation one day,

will everything that went come back? will our thoughts ( of worry) being it back?
who prevented what already came? who can deny what the future beholds?
relationships will come some day, as will seperation one day,

et’s close our eyes, with it lets close our sorrows,
let’s close our eyes, with it lets close our sorrows,
lets us wake up again, lets us be born as a human being
lets us wake up again, lets us be born as a new human being

relationships will come some day, as will seperation one day,
The dating companion will also leave
relationships will come some day, as will seperation one day,

title: [Yaar Nee] En Vedhanaiyil
english_stanzas:
why is it that both your eyes cry with me
in my distress, my dear?
when the world itself is constantly changing
why is the confusion, my dear?
when the same person looks differently
why is the tear, my dear?

I came along yesterday, I am with you today,
I will come with you tomorrow too..
On the same day, to want to see your face here and there,
I will come along,
In your journey, In your vision,
my body will come along, my dear,
why is it that both your eyes cry with me
in my distress, my dear?

When I was standing in the rain of sorrow,
I saw you in my vision,
in the same path, in the same rain,
I am now going to see my life,
why is it that both your eyes cry with me
in my distress, my dear?
when the same person looks differently
why is the tear, my dear?

As I walk today across the abode of the
the god of time (death), who am I now?
On the path that I am traveling, I see a loving face,
who am I tomorrow?
In your palace, if my memory resides,
please pardon me, my dear
why is it that both your eyes cry with me
in my distress, my dear?

title: [Akkarai Pachai] Ikkaraikku akkarai pachai …
english_stanzas:
the grass is greener on the other side,
always, the grass is greener on the other side,

For things I dont possess,
I always crave!

The mirror in my house,
did not show my face,

The family man desires to be ascetic,
ask the ascetic, and he desires to be a family man!

A deer wanders in search of shade, our eyes love the scene,
just look in front of us, there are a few million witnesses!

those who fall into the ocean, swim
those who fall on the fruit, eat
those who see the path, take the journey
those who don’t see a path, stand still,
The man who swims with his hands on a stone floor,
is it that easy to change the decree of time?

your eyes search for the sun, on a rainy day,
while on the day of the scorching sun, the body yearns for the cold,
you wander searching this and that,
no matter what you get, you continue to be anxious!
our place in this life,
is but the alms are given by the almighty,
those who do not realize this, are always desiring the other side!

title: [Airaa] Megathootham
english_stanzas: Cloud messenger (Mega thootham is one of the ancient literature written by Kalithaasan that revolves around the distant couple, where the man sends clouds as a messenger to his wife)
Cloud messenger
I should sing
Will this girls’ dream turn into a dessert?
Can a summer moon fill her thirst?
There is a light at the end of the tunnel
This is also a dream
Scared heart that fears shattered dream
I want to sing megathootham
I want you by my side
I want to see Kalidaasan
Life will bear another rainbow (will be colourful yet again)
Cloud messenger
Cloud messenger
I should sing
Time dramatically threw you and me in air
The love in the wind bought us together to make a poetry of us
My house bound by Godly Mullai (flower) blooming garden
Keep me always in your thoughts (don’t forget me)
Be my side in storm and winds
I want to sing megathootham
I want you by my side
I want to see Kalidaasan
Life will bear another rainbow (will be colourful yet again)
Just like the pure beauty of Thumbai (a flower)
I see in you
I yearn for the day I have you in my arms
When hearing these words, I become teary eyed
The moistness in this girls’ eyes turn into the rain bearing dark cloud
Will this girls’ dream turn into a dessert?
Can a summer moon fill her thirst?
There is a light at the end of the tunnel
This is also a dream
Scared heart that fears shattered dream

title: [Rocky] Aaalilaalilo
english_stanzas: Aaali aali lo (Hush little one)
Sleep with your eyes open
Aaali aali lo (Hush little one)
My ginger my little one (addressing sweet ones)
Aaali aali lo (Hush little one)
The dawn is not visible
Aaali aali lo (Hush little one)
My very awake light
Country forest and nests
Taken away by fire
In your eyes
Lies my life
Aaali aali lo (Hush little one)
Sleep with your eyes open
Aaali aali lo (Hush little one)
My ginger my little one (addressing sweet ones)
Oh my beauty
My dawn
My saree is your soft bed
The dampness is your silk dress
Sleep my fish (sweetly addressing the little one)
Without closing your eyes
When my tears fall on you
Without asking why
Everything will change
This loneliness, this poverty
You will be used to it
With the vision in your small eyes
The world becomes beutiful
Aaali aali lo (Hush little one)
Sleep seeing the sky
Aaali aali lo (Hush little one)
My eye my world
Aaali aali lo (Hush little one)
Aaali aali lo (Hush little one)
My awake light
Flower, it’s thorn and its stalk
Fire has eaten away
My roots lie in your eyes

title: [Padithal Mattum Podhuma] Annan Kaattiya Vazhiyamma
english_stanzas:
this is the way shown by the elder brother! oh dear!

this is the curse born from love!

the eyes were spoiled by the eye-lids themselves!

my own hands have hit me!
this is the way shown by the elder brother! oh dear!

fire burns when touched!

smile burns even without contact!

knowingly doing harm is enmity!

unknowingly doing harm is this relationship!
this is the way shown by the elder brother! oh dear!

I used to think of him as my shelter

the one who embraced has now burnt the heart

I stood praying anticipating him to bless and give,

instead he broke the praying hands,
this is the way shown by the elder brother! oh dear!

While I lived thinking always of him,

he lived only for himself,
I still have not forgotten him,
I do not hate even while he has done so much ( against me )!

title: [Maragadha Naanayam]- Nee Kavithaigala
english_stanzas: Are you a poem?
Are you my dream, you gorgeous (with eyes like a fish)?
Am I the present or the past
Answer me my love
When my heart is filled with love for you
Isn’t it like the water on the lotus?
Give me a glance, white snow.

Don’t run away from me

You are my boundary
Show me a smirk along your lips, my flower (Mullai- is a type of flower)
Like a new song drenched in the rain
You are the beautiful arrogance

Your scent that spreads everyday through the wind

Is a new addiction you beautiful sculpture

Hey beautiful!

I was born ahead for you (Between them, he was born ahead and was waiting for her in his life)
You young vine, opened your arms for me, my boon

Its time to bosom like a orchid flower.

What can I say, I have nothing unsaid
In a full moon, winter night, on a fruitful time don’t bolt away
Give me a glance you full moon

Don’t veil away from me

You are my boundary
Show me a smirk along your lips, my flower (Mullai- is a type of flower)
Are you a poem?
Are you my dream, you gorgeous (with eyes like a fish)?
Am I happening or in the past
Answer me my love
When my heart is filled with love for you
Isn’t it like the water on the lotus?
Give me a glance you full moon

Don’t veil away from me

You are my boundary
Show me a smirk along your lips, my flower (Mullai- is a type of flower)

title: [Paalum Palamum] aalaya maNiyin
english_stanzas:
I heard the sound of the temple bell,
I heard the sound of birds speaking the words of grace,

He is your Lord
I heard the sound of singing,
He is your leader
I heard my mother’s voice!

In the moving time of evening ,
My Lord came in the chariot,

He told “this is a home of the poor“,
And he garlanded me with his two eyes.

In the middle of the temple of love ,
On the lap of the merciful god,

At the time no one realised,
I surrendered to him in the end.

title: [Hey Sinamika] Yaarisaika …
english_stanzas:
from where (whom) do these notes come from?

is it the sound of the arched harp (யாழ் https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yazh)?

does it come as winds from the peaks of the majestic mountains?

does it come as rains from the from the silvery skies?

is it the one riding atop the chariot?

does it come adorned as music soaked in honey?

is it the one riding on the winds?

is it flowing soaked in tender love?

caressing the top of the Gopuram (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gopuram)

caressing the waves of the seas,

caressing the leaves of the big tree,

it comes to caress my heart!

with the glory of the entire skies,


the happiness that comes after letting go of the timidity,

is now coming without me (my touch)?

did it come from from the islands?

did it adorn the burning fire and come?

is it bending the course of time?

is it healing the wounds of the heart!

caressing the sounds of the caged cuckoo,

caressing the dancing peacocks of the rain forest,

caressing the (ancient) Tamil verses on the palm leaf,

is it coming now in my song too?

Like the mother who rushes,

in the moments when her offspring falls down,

as I lay on the soil and tremble,

wont you come now and support?

title: [Maalaiyitta Mangai] Senthamizh Thaen Mozhiyal …
english_stanzas:
The one who blossomed amidst the nerunji forest,
Telling to stop, she stopped and left in the path,
She stood as is like a statue,
Yet, she flew afar,

Will my soul stay put?
Will my heart stay steady?
Wont my life become fragrant?

The damsel, like the honey-sweet Tamil,
The slender damsel, who smiles pleasant as the moon,
The smiling damsel, who is slender as a tender plant,
Her kisses taste like nectar from her fruity sweet lips,
As I cherish them, she bows with shyness!

Was she born in the winds?
(As she is as light as air)
Or is she the one who was brewed new by imagination itself?

Is she the unblemished lotus blossomed in the marsh? 
Or is she the garland made of chrysanthemum?

Is the flower “Neelam” born from her eyes?
Was it she who added the blue to the sea?

Isn’t she the woman, who possesses such beauty, 
even women themselves fall for? 
(Despite forgetting the natural jealousy they feel towards a woman beautiful than themselves)

Is the one who adorns clouds in her hair? 
And further adorns them with the stars as flowers?

Is she the enchantress (Mohini, female avatar of Vishnu), 
who could submerge entire worlds in desire?

title: [Valar Pirai] Poojiyathukkulle Oru
english_stanzas:
in the nothingness ( encompassing everything ),

he rules it all,
he remains an enigma,
if you begin to understand him, he is god! ( you will see god)

in the nine gates of the human body (Two eyes, two ears, your mouth, your nostrils, your anus and genitals),

placing a drop of breathe (life),

he sold us in the market (by making us born), the one,

if you are able to realise his track, he is god! ( you will see god)

in the tender coconut,

in its floating core shell,

he stays as the flesh of coconut,

if you begin to know him, he is god! ( you will see god)

For those who after realising every thing as bitter

and come completely detached,

there is one who became dearer as a friend (relation),

if you continue to trace him, he is god ( you will see god)

In the expanses of the skies,

riding on the wheels of intelligence,

there is one who is riding the chariot of wisdom,
if you seek him, he is god ( you will see god)

He is the one who gives vision to the learned,

He is the one who gives hands to those who have renounced everything,

there is one who created the creators,
if you follow him, he is god ( you will see god)

realising the sufferings of the heart,

much like the suffering of the cotton,

there is one who solves your fears and problems,

he is none other than the solace granting god,

the one who sees the toad hinding in the stones,

the one who sees the child in the womb,

there is one who provides them nutrition,

the one who eats and enjoys with them, he is god!

he is one transcending the beginning,

the is one beyond the end,

he comes running for help,

if you are able to realise him, he is god (you will see god)

he is the one who made the heat in fire,

he is the one who kept coldness in water,

he is the who kept white within black,

if you revere him with all your heart, he is god (you will see god)

he comes as a deep realization in the heart,

he gets subsumed in the heart,

he shows that he exists,

he is the formless one, he is god!

he kept the egg in the hen,

and the hen inside the egg,

he is the one gave progeny even to the banana plant,

that complicated simpleton, is known as god on this earth!

in a small wheel,

he rotate the souls,

he is the one who lives forgetting who he is,

if you embrace him, he is god ( you will see god)

for those who live with great pride

about their bravery,

he fixes a date even for them and takes them ( death),

he is the one who directs the drama, the god!

title: [Jai Bhim] Mannile Eeramundu
english_stanzas: It is a damp soil (There is humanity still left)
Thorn forest also bears flowers
There is a tomorrow when you believe
There are people to hold (support) you
Wherever you go
The golden sky dwells in your eyes
There are no limits here, come
Time is on our side
It is a damp soil (There is humanity still left)
Thorn forest also bears flowers
There is a tomorrow when you believe
There are people to hold (support) you

walk in the path of truth,

Practicing veracity in real time is the morality of life

To hoist the flag of love,

people will come together to accompany you
Is there a life that ceases its search?
Everything is within you, you search my dear
It is a damp soil (There is humanity still left)
Thorn forest also bears flowers
There is a tomorrow when you believe
There are people to hold (support) you
Wherever you go
The golden sky dwells in your eyes
Time is on our side
It is a damp soil (There is humanity still left)
Thorn forest also bears flowers
There is a tomorrow when you believe
There are people to hold (support) you

title: [Kalyana Oorvalam] aaNdavan mugatha
english_stanzas:
I want see god’s face ( meet him face to face),

I want to ask him one thing,
why did you create me? oh god!
what were you thinking when you were creating me?

In this world, if you have money,

you can get many a things!

when you are creating, if you can also tear a few notes ( of money)

and create that will help!

not education, not hard work,

only money is the goal of life!
equity(honesty) already committed
suicide long time ago,

the body of the leader, frightened of justice,

disappeared into the temple
crying or praying will not help,
what ever was to happen will only happen!

For every living organism the god gave

one span stomach isn’t it?

if there is no means to take care of the stomach,

then only one molam (about 1.5 feet) rope is the way? ( to hang and die)

to have created both the stomach and the rope

is your mistake, isn’t it?

title: [Delhi Mapillai] Aandavan oru naal
english_stanzas:
One day, God opened a shop,

he stocked thousands and thousands of things in it,

depending on the status of people, he quoted the price,,

he asked them to buy based on their needs

the women came to buy beauty

the men came to be buy desire

the leaders bought fame

the poets bought (creative) lies from there

the blind asked for vision to see

the dumb asked for language to communicate

the relatives wanted their beloved (dead) back,

a few asked the price to reach heavenly abode,

Humans were ready to buy anything they desired,

they were willing to give any price that was quoted,

( or can be interpreted as, god was ready to give it any price that was asked)

However, there was no one who was willing to give the heart as the price

to buy love (and affection)

title: [Shanthi] Yaar andha nilavu
english_stanzas:
Who is that moon ( damsel)?

Why this dream?
Hearing someone, thinking someone else,

someone else came as the relation

it is the doing of fate,

this, my coming, here

The garland and the turmeric (mangal sutra) changed,

that was one turmoil,

the bed and the heart wilt away,

that was a big suffering,

Oh god! you gave whom to whom?

The lamps at your temple has been changed,
do you realize?
the play does not end
in a day

there is no peace anywhere

in the life of some
oh god! with whom do you

stand on the dais

today who did you see in person as whom?

title: [Pattina Pravesam] vaan nilaa nilaa alla
english_stanzas:
The moon in the sky is not the moon

your youth is the moon

the moon called honey moon

is the moon of my beloved

the days I spend without you,

I am the waning white moon

in this land with out the deers,

your eyes provide their glimpse,

In the land with out the flowers,

the woman makes up for them,

Is god in the stone (idol)?

or in the speech of women?

in the gold she adorns? in the vermillion dot on her forehead?

in her budding refreshing smile?

in the affection she shows?

is pleasure in the cot,

or in her body’s attributes?

in the suffering? in the love?

in the fights? in the coming together?

or in the poetry that she plays?

is it in our life’s journey path?

or is in the radiance of the damsel?

is it in the town? is it in the country?

is bliss to be found at home?

or is it in the petals of her heart?

is the relationship in darkness?

or in the grace of a damsel?
countless desires,

why does my moon have so many?

tell them to me my dear moon!

title: [Thiruvilaiyadal] Ondraanavan Uruvil
english_stanzas: He is the one (unified form), bodily he is two ( he and parvathi)
With the genesis of Tamil, he became three
( Iyal (இயல்) – poetry , Isai (இசை) – music, Naadakam (நாடகம்) – drama )
In the good Vedas, he became four
(the rig veda, yajur veda, sama veda, atharva veda)
By taking on the syllable, நமசிவாய ( Na- Ma- Si- Va- Ya), he became five
In the sensul tastes, he became six
( Sweet (Inippu), Sour (Pulippu), Salty (OOvarppu), Bitter (Kasappu), Pungent (Kaarppu), Astringent (Thuvarppu) )
In the melodious swaras, he became seven
(Sa – Shadjama (Tonic), Ri – Rishabha, Ga – Gandhara, Ma – Madhyama, Pa – Panchama (Perfect Fifth), Da – Dhaivata, Ni – Nishada)

In the siddhis, he became eight

(அணிமா(anima), மஹிமா(mahima), லஹிமா(laghima), கரிமா(garima), பிராப்த்தி(prapti), பிரகாமியம்(prakamya), ஈசத்துவம்(istava) and வசித்துவம்(vasitva))

In the scintillating emotions, he became nine

Shringara (love/beauty), Hasya (laughter), Karuna (sorrow), Raudra (anger), Veera (heroism/courage), Bhayanaka (terror/fear), Bibhatsya (disgust), Adbutha (surprise/wonder) and Shantha (peace or tranquillity)
He is the one who donned the 10 heads (Ravana), he is the one who is attached to the heart,

He is the father of the 12 handed Murugan!

Ref: https://astroulagam.com.my/lifestyle/real-story-behind-murugans-6-faces-84324
He is the one who does not age! He is beginning and the very first one!
He is the middle one (naduvan- god of death), the one who guards the midway between the past (previous birth) and the future ( the after life). [The middleman between death and afterlife]

He is the one who stands as the man and the woman!

He is the one who preached that they are but the one ( essence of the same cosmic energy- man and woman)

He is half him and half his wife ( Parvathi)!

He gave the equal half to feminity!

He is the wind, he is the light! He is the water, He is the fire!

He is the yesterday, He is the today, He stands there forever as the stable water fountain ( Ganges)

He stands as the beacon and epitome of love!

title: [Kanniyin Kaadhali] Kalangaathiru Manamey …
english_stanzas:
Oh mind do not get upset , You,
Please do not get upset,
Your dreams will become reality one day

Without effort nothing will come to your hand,
to those who work hard, nothing slips off their hand,
if you keep trying every-time,
which is not possible?
what is impossible for you?
(Nothing is impossible)
Even queen Alli,

who detested even the scent of a man,
One day, fell in the net of Arjuna.

Even if she refused to see you
to seem more fashionable,
Her youth,
would trouble her greatly!

The very next moment,
She would develop affection for you,
She would sing praises of you,
and would also give a kiss

title: [Iravin Nizhal] Maayava Thooyava
english_stanzas:
Oh mystique, Oh pure one, come on to adorn me with the flowers,

transform into the rain and pour onto me,

Oh sweet one, Oh descendent of the Yadu (both referring to Krishna), Come to play the flute,

Come as the music along the lips!

your chest is my province,

your view is my recreational park,

in my mouth, there is honey secreting,

is it my tongue, is it your tongue, on dear come!

Oh Mystique, Oh Pure one, come on to adorn the flowers,

transform into the rain and pour onto me,

In the strings used to tie flowers,

she had strung her longing and waiting,

come onto to adorn it onto your body!

As the herd of the cows sleep this night,

come to dance, without the tremble (dont shake or stress),

adorn onto me without crumbling!

Oh mystique, Oh pure one, come on to adorn the flowers,

transform into the rain and pour onto me,

Oh sweet one, Oh descendent of the Yadu (both referring to Krishna), Come to play the flute,

Come as the music along the lips!

your chest is my province,

your view is my recreational park,

in my mouth, there is honey secreting,

is it my tongue, is it your tongue, on dear come!

Oh mystique, Oh pure one, come on to adorn the flowers,

transform into the rain and pour onto me,

title: [Aruvadai Naal] Devanin Kovil moodiya neram
english_stanzas:
Struck in love by cupid

transitioning into the vermillion

signifying marriage,
and attaining true bliss

When the temple of the god is closed,

what shall I ask for, oh god?

Today my soul wears off!

Dont know why, but my heart wilts!

When the temple of the god is closed,

what shall I ask for, oh god?

I bear the burden of sadness,

I endure the lightning strikes of sorrow,

I bear the burden of sadness,

I endure the lightning strikes of sorrow,

Like the river banks that always live separated,

I am the lonely heroine

People unite to only separate

the heart is to only forget

only when we forget, peace will prevail

When the temple of the god is closed,

what shall I ask for, oh god?

My journey is on the one way road,

the heart is filled with many anxieties?

My journey is on the one way road,

the heart is filled with many anxieties?

You were the one who said “ask and it will be given”

I asked for one thing, did you give?

My heart is scrambling, searching for solace,

Even to cry, the eyes have exhausted the tears,

I am a crying lover!

When the temple of the god is closed,

what shall I ask for, oh god?

Today my soul wears off!

Dont know why, but my heart wilts!

When the temple of the god is closed,

what shall I ask for, oh god?

title: [Kaathalum Kadanthu Pogum]- Akkam Pakkam Paar
english_stanzas:
Come on, you can live carelessly,

nothing will happen anyways!

Keep going, be it a forest or a ridge,

The mirage wont appear,
Aha Aha, there is nothing to loose

See to your left and right,

Who is the father? Who is the mother?
See around for yourself
Who is your kith and kin?
Everything is in your perspective, bro
The entire world will be drenched only in the overflowing love,
Why lonely all the time?
Come let us celebrate it. ( Lets celebrate, be it your loneliness)
Fall asleep in your half-way dream
Lets’ live the rest
The shadows too wears off in the evening
Sets (The sun and the shadows) as we see
The days wear off, for eternity,
And yet it comes and goes

title: [Vikram]- Porkanda Singam
english_stanzas: My soul trembles as I carry you
You shattered brave heart, I am whimpering
The revolving earth is frozen to me
It refuses to move to the next minute
Should I put you to sleep on my chest?
or should I cremate the lost life?

The lion that has seen many battles;
Anguished heart
Subdued yet I exist for you
Don’t cry my son, my lifetime is yours
To protect you like my eyelid
I wear off my life
My soul trembles as I carry you
You shattered brave heart, I am whimpering

The lion that has seen many battles,
Anguished heart
Subdued yet I exist for you
Don’t cry my son, my lifetime is yours
To protect you like my eyelid
I wear off my life

title: [Kasi] En mana vaanil.
english_stanzas:
who spread your wings in my heart

when you listen to my story

your wings will automatically fold (cringe)

the bubbly prancing

juvenile wave

if you hear about my state

all you enthusiasm will stop

just like you,

I too desired to spread my wings,

but returned in disappointment everyday

after attempting to fly without wings,

will this one songs suffice to tell my ordeal?

can can my heart bear it, tell me now!

I asked for boons from god

he gave me the tunes and melody

among my fellow humans, who will know this?


are my struggles of the past
