title: Moopilla Thamizhe Thaaye (Tamil Anthem)
singer: A. R. Rahman, Saindhavi Prakash, Khatija Rahman, A. R. Ameen, Amina Rafiq, Gabriella Sellus, Poovaiyar, Rakshita Suresh, Niranjana Ramanan, Aparna Harikumar, Nakul Abhyankar
english_stanzas:
A dawn after the storm!

A dawn in a new horizon!

You, Tamizh, the Boopaalam*, Welcome!

For ruling this world, Come up!
*Boopaalam - In musical Tamil, this raga is related to awakening. Usually this raga is used for hymns meant for Morning.

We have fallen many a times in the past,

But we rose every single time!

We have split up many a times in the past,

But we united every single time!
Whatever might be the downside, we, Tamizhans, always bounce back without a doubt or exception!

In all eight directions, Tamizh reaches,

playing its sweet victorious beats with the Murasu*!

The wisdom ( advancements) reaches the skies,

Yet, the poetry falls like the raindrops!
*Murasu - A traditional percussion instrument used predominantly to announce and more often in a victorious note.

In Agam*, it charms with romance!

In Puram*, it bristles with war!

Without any hindrance anywhere and everywhere,

“Tamizh”,The conch blows# on loud and clear!

For those kids, not falling asleep,

Tamizh soothes and melts as lullaby!

For those, who come with hunger,

Tamizh drips and satiate as nectar!

There came seven patrons..

As gift, they gave life itself!

There came several enemies..

They returned, learning many lessons!

Tamizhar taught virtues by practicing them. The seven patrons gave donations beyond normal charity. They were compassionate towards all sector of beings, as simple as a creeper and selfless to give away immortality and even their own life.
Paari gave away his chariot, for the creeper of Mullai (Jasmine) to nourish. (To plant)
Began gave blanket for the shivering peacock. (To bird)
Kaari gave away wisdom through council. (To society)
Aay surrendered a very precious Kalinga to God. (To Divinity)
Adhiyamaan gave away gooseberry, which gives immortality to the eater, to the poetess Avvaiyaar. (To scholar\*)\*
Nalli gave all facilities to live for his friends. (To friends)
Ori gave his country to Paanar who asked for alms and also died fighting for them. (To artists)
Source: Seven Patrons - https://bit.ly/3qVGhoD

In the courts of Moovendhar*,

The Tamizh poets won!

Recognising the intellectual,

Emperors paid respects!

You, Tamizh, is the mother of mothers!

You are the Sun that’s ascending in the horizon!

You are older than the oldest!

You are the immortal mother, Tamizh!
Tamizh, despite being the mother of mothers and older than oldest, is still on the ascend and just at the horizon, as it's life ahead is as long and far beyond comprehension and thus its immortal!

We may have withered in the past,

We blossomed back every single time!

We may have laid still, in the past,

We branched and grew every-time!

We may have got smothered in the past,

We sizzled back every-time!

We may have got lost many a times in the past,

We bonded back every single time!

We may have fallen in the past,

We rose back every single time!

We have been learning, for ages,

that Tamizh has three varieties..

And when Prose, Drama and Poetry entwine,

Heart melts away in its grandeur!

when language leads the way, with passing time,

it has no end and its glory continues forever,

it fills up everywhere as the elixir!

Grandeur and level of Tamizh is so majestic, such that, the pride of Tamizh is in the forefront and it spreads its highness to its followers and it grows even more spreading the beauty and elixir of it, even more!

As Scientific Tamizh,
And as commercial Tamizh,
In the paths of web,
Inter weaves the world of Tamizh.

Tamizh has encompassed scientific frontier as well as commercial frontier even from ages ago, as the literature proves the advancement in those fields. And now it has advanced and grew dynamically and has also taken to the Web / Internet!

We came to the forefront through our writings!

We stood unparalleled through typing!

We adapted and fit into computers!

We mould to the shape of trend!
Despite the form of expressing is ever changing, we adapt and keep growing, breaking all hurdles and keep abreast of improvements!

We are keen and attentive!

We imbibe (the new) and adapt!

We never back off!

We conquer by moving forward!

As the technology evolves,

And finds form to sustain,

It gets ready beautifully,

Adorning new formats!

Undefeated in any front,

My dearest Tamizh, C’mon!

In the lives of coming generation,

To bring prosperity, C’mon!

Quoting the praise of past,

Noting the unseen boundaries,

Some try to lock you up!

Oh Tamizh, you just come blazing!

Those who are just blabbering,

Will be confined to homes!

The best of words, is action!

Let’s get going!

Let’s spread across all directions!

In foreign universities,

Let’s form Chair for Tamizh!

And let us all pull it forward!

Without the language,

The race doesn’t exist!

So be aware,

and embrace Tamizh!

The heritage of Tamizh is so vast and advanced and that what defines the race of Tamizhan. This line reiterates the tamizh saying, "தமிழன் என்றொரு இனம் உண்டு, தனியே அதற்கொரு குணம் உண்டு" - "There's a race, Tamizhan and it has unique virtues."

Let’s proclaim it every single day,

Tamizh is our life force!

Who else than you, Tamizh,

Could lead us into betterment?!

It’s raining “love” incessantly in my sky,
Why so?

You’re my tomorrow’s morning sunshine,
You’re the tea in my hands,
You’re the joy enjoyed by our kid,
who’s babbling with the flowers in the front yard..
As your cheeks wrinkle,
As my mustache grays,
As we live the to the brim of life,
Is that moment not so far away?
Even at that moment of closing your eyes forever,
I’ll be seeing only joy in your eyes…

title: [Payanangal Mudivathillai] Ilaya nila
english_stanzas:
The young moon pours light deep down
to my heart, it drenches me,
The strolling clouds dream a dream,
the sky breaks out in celebration!

The young moon pours light deep down
to my heart, it drenches me,
The strolling clouds dream a dream,
the sky breaks out in celebration!
The young moon pours light deep down
to my heart, it drenches me,

On its way, in the nights dew,
The young moon drenches daily,
Wiping it’s face with fluffy clouds,
It strolls till dawn,

On its way, in the nights dew,
The young moon drenches daily,
Wiping it’s face with fluffy clouds,
It strolls till dawn,

The young moon pours light deep down
to my heart, it drenches me,
The strolling clouds dream a dream,
the sky breaks out in celebration!
The young moon pours light deep down
to my heart, it drenches me,

Witnessing the procession of clouds on the streets of skies,
brings me peace
And dreams to the eyes of the damsels,

The cluster of clouds are wandering, lost,
Did they lose their addresses?
And since they are lost,
they cry, is that the rains?

The cluster of clouds are wandering, lost,
Did they lose their addresses?
And since they are lost,
they cry, is that the rains?

In the blue skies flow those silver streams,
What wondrous signs they make,
Who did sow the precious gems in the skies?

The young moon pours light deep down
to my heart, it drenches me,
The strolling clouds dream a dream,
the sky breaks out in celebration!
The young moon pours light deep down
to my heart, it drenches me,

title: [The Oxymorons] முறையும் முரணும்
english_stanzas:
There are some noises
Which defies the term noise..
The lapping of waves of the ocean
Does not disturb the serene silence..
There are some mistakes
Which looks poetic to our thoughts..
A toddler teaching the parent
There are some silences
The silence in lovers’ tiff
Does belong to part of their conversation..
There are few poetic things
The insults from a dear friend
Are these due to
Wrong Words,
Wrong Meanings,
Or Wrong Interpretations?
Are like the tides of the ocean,
They make us admire,
They become the content of poetry..
The answers are never revealed,
Just as the tides never rest!

title: [Bharathi Vasana kavidhai] Sakthi – Happiness Part 8
english_stanzas:
We sing praise of Parasakthi.
How was she formed?
That’s what is not known.
Isn’t she the born mother; from the almighty “self”.
From what was she formed?
How did she form from the almighty “self”? Don’t know.
Creation is not known to the eyes.
Not known even to the wisdom.
Death is known to the eyes; But not known to the wisdom.
Life is about praising the Sakthi; The benefit of this is attaining pleasure.
For the heart to be clear; For the life force to have speed and heat; For the body to have peace and strength.
Living is getting the blessings of Maha Sakthi.
We again praise the Maha Sakthi, who makes us live.

title: [Bharathi Vasana kavidhai] Sakthi – Happiness Part 7
english_stanzas:
Snake charmer is playing the flute.
Is the music born in the flute?
Is it born in the hole (Of the flute)?
Is it born in the breath of the snake charmer?
It’s born in his heart; Exposed through the flute.
Heart doesn’t sound by itself.
Heart doesn’t merge with the flute.
Heart merges with breath.
Breath merges with flute.
Flute plays.
This is the play of Sakthi.
She sings in the heart. It resonates in the holes of the flute.
Matching the unmatchable and creating harmony in it — Sakthi
Small boys* are calling out for alms.
Who created symphony between charmer’s flute and voice of those boys? Sakthi
“Jari^ for sale; Jari” a passerby shouts out, in the same rhythm.
Ah! I found the essence.
The life of charmer, life of those kids and the life of that Jari merchant is being played by the same Sakthi.
Instruments are many. Instrumentalist is one.
Appearances are many. Sakthi is one.
Hail thee!

title: [Kaathuvaakula Rendu Kaadhal] Naan Pizhai
english_stanzas:
I am the flaw, you are the child’s sweet babble,
when you stay within me, I am no longer a mistake!

Detail:
I am a person full of flaws, and you are like a child’s babble. When we come along then the flaws is me are no longer seen as a mistake much like how a child’s sweet babble even while flawed (with mis-pronunciations) is enjoyable and beautiful!

You are the tender leaf, I am the monsoon rains,
There is no dribbling moment,
(My love for you is as intense as pouring rains on a leaf)

I got you after sifting (hard) the ocean,
you are the one to become my perfect shelter (Oyster shell?)

Hey, the damsel with a smiling face,
the one who manifests instantly with a thought,
Hey, the damsel with a smiling face,
the one who manifests instantly with a thought,
you are the boon that I got on the day I was born
( dude younger than the dudette? or our union was predetermined )

I am the flaw, you are a child’s babble,
when you stay within me

The language of her eyes,
I became a student reading it,
Her mannerisms,
I became a fan appreciating it,

With him beside,
I become the dew drops (frost) in the sun (fire),
With him approaching me,
I become the water caressing lotus,

I became a kind of friend who stays with her (always),
I became a kind of servant who she likes,

I got you after sifting from the ocean,
you are the one to be my perfect refuge (Oyster shell?)

Hey, the damsel with a smiling face,
the one who manifests instantly with a thought,
Hey, the damsel with a smiling face,
the one who manifests instantly with a thought,
you are the boon that I got on the day I was born

I am the flaw, you are a child’s babble,
when you come into me, I am no longer a mistake!
You are the tender leaf, I am the monsoon rains,
There is no dribbling moment,

title: [Rekka] Kannamma Kannamma
english_stanzas:
Oh dear Kannamma, (you are a) beautiful statue of flowers,
(Bcoz of you) Sweetness like honey pours into me as rain..
Oh my! If I keep thinking of you, my heart
prances in joy and goes out of control.
The glowing beautiful lamp, isn’t that you?!

Your talks are sweet like the hibiscus,
When you talk dearly even the summer turns winter..
The milky-moon becomes pudding in your hands,
The rainbow becomes a dress for you to adorn..

Kannamma, kannamma, won’t you stop?
My heart yearns for you..

To see your beauty, Gods too come out of temples..
Waiting for your footsteps, the earth risks going barren,
The bard Bharathi would turn your features into sonnets..
He would praise you heartily as the divine angel..

Kannamma, Kannamma.. What is this?
Shyness enthrals me..

title: [Jai Bhim]  Thala Kodhum
english_stanzas:
The fondling gentle breeze
Brings a new message

Seeds that turn into trees
Show how to live
Don’t worry, don’t worry, in your heart
All dusks turn into dawn

The fondling gentle breeze
Brings a new message

Seeds that turn into trees
Show how to live
Don’t worry, don’t worry, in your heart
All dusks turn into dawn (There is no dusk that hasn’t turned to a dawn.Written in the essence that there will be a bright side once you forego the bitter present)
A shadow stands very near you (You are accompanied/ supported by others)
A shadow stands very near you (You are accompanied/ supported by others. You are not alone)

When you trust yourself and go ahead
Path will unfold

Don’t pause, keep progressing.
Why tears in the corner of your eyes?

Don’t pause, keep progressing.
With love you will find ties.
There is no land without blue skies as its roof

Time and tide are your ties
Break the barriers
Will the situation change by itself?
Strive, you! Morality will once again be upheld on this land.

If you pass the remaining darkness
The dawn will come to you
And will carry you on its shoulder
Our day will come!

The fondling gentle breeze
Brings a new message

Seeds that turn into trees
Show how to live
Don’t worry, don’t worry, in your heart
All dusks turn into dawn
A shadow stands very near you

When you trust yourself and go ahead
Path will unfold

Don’t pause, keep progressing.
Why tears around your eyes?

Don’t pause, keep progressing.
With love you will find ties.

Don’t pause, keep progressing.
Why tears around your eyes?

Don’t pause, keep progressing.
With love you will find ties.

title: [Rettai Vaal Kuruvi] Raja raja chozhan naan
english_stanzas:
I am Rajaraja Cholan,
you are the loving kingdom that rules over me,
oh Flower! you are a love island!
heaven has dawned upon this earth, disguised as this damsel,
A world of pleasure has been created here

he eye gazes caress, they light up like the camphor lamp,
when the hands touch, electricity strikes,
On the dais of passion the one-act play unfolds,
the pleasure teach the lessons, oh my native dame

I sway here and there like the swing,
I burn in the fire of desire,
the rhythms of your song have smitten me,
I get carried away in the vehicle of love,
Hey red tinted lotus, red honey rain,
you are my soul, oh goddess!

your intoxicating looks strike and sink into my soul,
The body is prancing in excitement, amorously,
two arrows are troubilng the bow, withering it,
its the eyes of the damsel, its a lie!
the queen drapes herself in the prinstine saree,

while my amorous eyes go down into the palanquin,
Right by the honey stream, its time to drench,
the flute wobbles,
Oh golden form, hear me my queen,

title: [Dear Comrade] Pularaadha
english_stanzas:
Just before the break of dawn,
In the rain, that chatters to moon,
Like the un-drenched shadow,

My love yearns and yearns…
(The rain is so near yet not touching the shadow, I yearn to be loved in abundance and not just enjoy the view from afar)

Oh, Un-awakened love..
Oh, consummating love..
Oh, don’t scream love..
Oh, blooming love..

Bringing the blanket of kisses,
It wraps up your lips with mine..
It brings greater peace to the soul..
It melts all five senses of the body..

Infinite drizzling
From clouds of lust..
From now on, the rain-forest blooms afresh..

Oh, Un-awakened love..
Oh, consummating love..
Oh, don’t scream love..
Oh, blooming love..

Just before the break of dawn,
In the rain, that chatters to moon…

the soothing sounds
Of your breath rhyming in the heart
Is heard as booming within..

Like an unspoken language
Your caresses becomes..
My silence will speak for itself, here upon..

title: [Imaikka Nodigal] Neeyum naanum anbe
singer: Raghu Dixit, Sathyaprakash D, Jithin Raj
english_stanzas:
You and me, my dear,
Until the ends of time,
Live along as one..

For my entire lifetime,
You, my dear, is abundant..
Cuddling (our) four eyelids

You are my path,
You are my feet,
You are the length I travel..

You are my sky,
You are my earth,
You are my beginning and end..

You would live within me..
Even if your shadow parts,
I will crumble to ground.

In your lovely eyes, my twinkling star,
I found myself, in a newer version..
Even after finding you later in life,
You came here as mother’s lap for sleeping..

For fulfilling your needs,
I will swim thro’ boiling water..
By borrowing your love for me,
I will restore and revive myself..

I live along wholly as
My half and your other half are one..
If tears spill from your eyes,
I die on the spot..

For the flowers of wayside,
Look at us with jealousy,
my love, let’s live so everyday..

title: [Vada Chennai] Ennadi Maayavi Nee
english_stanzas:
Hey, you get on my head (you are giving me a high)
You leave your golden footprint,
You shake up my soul,
What kind of an illusionist are you?

You change my ground state,
You make me air borne,
You show me my reality,
You take the dagger,
and crush me like a candy now,
you are looking to rake up all my heart,
and scribble (claim) your ownership over it,

The air (from your breathe) is buzzing around me like a bee,
and breaking me into two,
the feeling of love that until now just stood as a bystander,
is boring in like a crab,

Shall I incessantly (pour) rant it out,
Like a mindless cloud?
Shall I live buzzing around you,
Like the crows circling the towers,
Shall we forget this impermanence (death)?
In the salty air ( that is my life) is this the fragrant (rose water smell) phase ?

title: [CCV] Praptham / Enge enge veezhvom
english_stanzas:
Without knowledge of destination,
The raindrops falling over
one over the seed,
one over the dead,
The Search for fate
Is indeed the Destiny..
When its heartless, blood surrounds..
Blood surrounds the entire living..
Which way to go ahead?
Which way to go ahead?
When the world burns in the fires of desire,
The sky and earth will become bloody red..
When the waters of ocean is filled with blood,
What it rains over the world, is bloody red, isn’t it?
Blood surrounds the entire living..
Be it victory, Be it defeat,
All the planets, revolving around the Sun;
Half of time, swimming in darkness;
All the bane, that looks like boon in life;
All the distress, that looks like happiness;

title: [Kaakka kaakka] Ennai konjam
english_stanzas:
Transforming me a little,
Pouring you into my heart,
Don’t you kill me bit by bit…
Is today and yesterday different?
Is whom you see today, really me?
Don’t you make me fall for you with your words…
I’ve just one thing to say..
I’ve just one thing to say..
I want to say it to your face..
My shyness has taken a change..
My elegance has gone up a notch..
Won’t you say it yourself, if you know it?
Whom shall I ask.. Will you tell?
Whom shall I ask.. Will YOU tell?
On the way I cross by, there are orchids..
Yet I’ve not stopped and relished its beauty..
But just today, I stopped by and picked a flower,
And walked away with a smile.. I never dreamt, I would do so..
The flowers you pick.. Are only for me to adorn..
The thought has started growing in me today..
It happens to be talking casually..
It’s crossing across skies,
A new kind of experience,
Explodes in a jiffy..
The lives of both of us..
You made me come here..
You made me blabber..
You made me bloom smiles.. what else?
Sitting next to me,
Are your naughty glances.. why is that?
My glances are new..
My talks are new..
I too have changed coz of you..
Your eyes to search for me alone,..

title: [Ondraga Originals] Ulaviravu / Thoorathu kaadhal
english_stanzas:
Long distance love, oho oh, is not my cup of tea,
None of the virtual kisses are like your real kiss..
Will you stand before me?
Will you hear out all my likes?
Will you join hands with me?
Oho oh, my love,
Come with me for a date-night (2)
Hey, ask for the time to run backwards a little..
No need for any rush..
Hey, lady, stop by for a little while..
Let’s board a bus, go for a long drive,
Let’s go for a walk in an unknown city, today..
Let’s enjoy the arts we dislike,
As lights twinkle in eyes,
As cassettes spill music,
For me to search, in your eyes, for my life..
After we warm ourselves, within a tent,
Shall we go to sleep, counting the stars?
Let’s shower under the falls, in each other’s embrace,
Let’s catch fish and cook it by frying over fire…
I want stealing glances,
Not the short messages..

Throwing away mobiles
And holding hands together..

title: [96] The life of Ram
english_stanzas:
Only after reaching the shore,
Ocean is to the liking..
To make today, meaningful right now!
All happiness of now and today,
Will show another meaning tomorrow..
For living my uncherished life,
I rising above without falling back..
To reach the eternal flow within,
Here, Right now, I recover..
Here, Right now, I rule..
Hey, I look at myself, as a stranger..
Bright and clear like light..
I live in the depth, where even “I” doesn’t exist..
Reborn as a mirror, I become everything, I see..
Like the cat, that crosses caressing in between legs, life is enough.. Oh dear..
Everything that’s seen, calls for a tender caress, with beauty..
I will be myself..
I will live completely..
The boring, imitating living,
I forget that life..
I live so beautifully..
I become so sweeter..
Here, a vulture flies away..
Nicely without a track..
Like the stone that drops to the bottom of water,
I get engrossed into the scenery, I see..
Like the crow that sleeps upon bull’s hump,
I will be upon the earth..
Along its course, linking hands, I will go with the flow..
Somehow a completeness dawns..
Aha.. It gives such deeper meanings..
In the moment of living as a mother,
it sings upon lullaby..

title: [Chekka Chivantha Vaanam – CCV] Bhoomi Bhoomi
english_stanzas:
Will the endless sky,
It can’t, right?!
Like the human form,
oh dear, will soul too die?
The vessel called, body, would break..
Oh wailing heart, do not not worry..
When the leaves fall,
Like a lower form of life*,
the world itself.. isn’t permanent..
Oh.. In the sound of world’s revolving..
In the sound of ocean’s roaring..
In the sound of human’s warfare..
Where could the koel’s sound be heard?
When a fish cries in sea,
Will it be heard in the shore?
Would the heart, bear the pain?
Ashes doesn’t remain in cotton..
More than living, pain is terrible..
Womb isn’t the beginning..
Tears flow, to say the truth..
the wretched heart doesn’t listen to it..
Where are you? Where?
I’ll be there, tomorrow..

title: [96] Anthaathi / Peranbe
singer: Chinmayi, Govind Vasantha, Bhadra Rajin & M. Nassar
english_stanzas:
Love, the tremendous tenderness,
A dance of, and towards the heart..
Love, wanders adorning various masks,
In blazing fire, In ceaseless breeze,
In grass, garlic, gnome,
in presence, in absence,
By itself, and as everything else,
What we see as unseen,
is the rest of love..
The search for non-existing,
Love, doesn’t change,
it counters the fight
We are, in the fire,
We are, in the storm,
(We are destroyed by the element of love)
We are, in the water,
We are, in the teat,
The taste of lust..
(We thrive because of the element of love)
Love, spider in tears,
Love, spree of stars,
Love, a true rumor,
Love, a divine attacker,
Love, a fan of Lucifer,
Love, soul’s constellation,
A degree, life’s graduation..
(I – An individual dissolves as two distinct persons becomes united as one)
You; Endearing entireness, come..
Endearing all-notes-of-music..
Five shades of elements..
Heart is brimming (with love)..
Love is in everything that’s seen..
Oh my love, oh my love,
Sole stupendous support (of mine)..
That’s would suffice..
Oh my love, oh my love,
To the extent of life,
Let’s go, you come along..
Goddess, himself, the Brahma…
The beauty of love,
The arrogance of love,
The sacrosanct of love..
Love, starts with you,
Love, ends with you,
Love, lives bcoz of you..
Andhaathi – Literal meaning – A poetry type, that starts with the last word of previous stanza. and the first stanza starts with the last word of last stanza.
It will come unannounced,
It’s entrance is shouted out loud,
By the heart..p
Love will reach you too, one day..
Wrap it up in your arms with warmth..
Take care of it tenderly…
Love is somewhat understandable..
Hesitates in the distance,
Love will be in your hands!
Heart will be in love’s hands!
Question, why the change?
Answer, Just for change!*
Why the Change? – Why does Love turn you upside down and inside out?

Just for Change! – From Two to One.. Change into betterment… For its the sole purpose of life ultimately!

title: [Chekka Chivantha Vaanam – CCV] Mazhai Kuruvi
english_stanzas:
In the blue mountain valleys,

where the gentle breeze does it’s weaving.
In the blue mountain valleys..
While the sky-bends and touches the land,
I was understanding love..
In the vast silence, where even music freezes,
I was gathering knowledge..
I had spread my heart wide open..
I was engrossed in nature’s wonder..
A sparrow with it’s friendly glare,
sitting on a round-rock asked me to come and join..
“chirp chirp” – she said;

“come closer” she said
without any words,

asked if I liked her..
In that small sparrow’s one-act drama,
I was a little engrossed..
Is it a one day dream,

or a divine relationship,
whose entry is it?
Are you the breeze that moves on, just caressing the eye?
Is it a relationship or just a sympathy?
In the blue mountain valleys…
Moving her beak she flew,
Shaking away the world
It flew higher up..
With the clouds gathering quickly,
Thunders striking with crackling sound,
There isn’t an umbrella to shelter the dense rain forest.
How come the wide open sky fall caressing the mud!
How come all the directions melted away in rain and got lost!
I lost the direction in which the sparrow flew unto..
I got separated from her, carrying the burden of sorrow..
I parted, parted away..
My Life drenched, drenched in sorrow..
Will that little bird now,
wander, straining and struggling?
Will its wings be in pain? Will it suffer?
At that time, In Forest
the whole story was of another..
See how the bird rejoiced..
In the spilling rain,
without getting drenched in that happiness,
Thinking about her, who parted me,
See me despair.. See me cry..

title: [96] Konjum / Kaathalae
english_stanzas:
You; Endearing entireness, come..
Endearing all-notes-of-music..
Five shades of elements..
Heart is brimming (with love)..
Love is in everything that’s seen..
Oh my love, oh my love,
Sole stupendous support (of mine)..
That’s would suffice..
Oh my love, oh my love,
To the extent of life,
Let’s go, you come along..

title: [Parashakthi] Sivaji Ganesan Court scene monologue
english_stanzas:
The court has met so many strange cases!
Yet, this case is neither strange!
Nor, me, the defendant is new!
In the course of life, I am a very commonly seen being!
I caused chaos in temple,
I was accused, as such!
That I would deny them all,
I caused chaos in temple,
Not for protesting against temple,
For temples not to become as the tent of horrific!
I attacked the priest,
Not for he is a devotee,
For oppressing Devotion from becoming a deception!
Why do you care about?
When none other in the world cares for?
My selfishness has public concern in it!
Like the fish, that consumes dirt for its hunger,
And still cleanup the pond!
You name me, culprit!
If you look back and look into
the course of life of this culprit,
You could count the numerous Torrents
that he has crossed over on his path!
In my path, there were no singing koels,
But there were slithering snakes!
I haven’t caressed the breeze,
I have jumped over fire!
Listen to my story!
Before writing my judgement, please listen!
In Tamilnadu, in this holy place, was I born,
A country to be born, Another country to strive,
Am I an exception to this fate of Tamilnadu?
Rangoon! It nurtured my soul!
Made me a great man!
I came back to see my sister,
In her wedding looks!
Involved in fraudulence case,
In the accused cage,
Here, this mischievous Jolly,
I am one of those who fell for her traps!
I lost my money purse,
Wandered in hunger, lost weight,
At last, has become insane!
I saw my sister, whom I came to see,
Like a portrait without eyes,
Yes, I saw her as a Widow!
My sister’s name was Kalyani,
Yet, there is no Mangalyam in her neck!
Baby in hand, Tears in eyes,
For Kalyani, I wandered!
Asked for her love in return!
Involved in murder case,
As accused, stands here,
He tried to woo my sister with his posh!
If I hadn’t stopped, my sister, by then,
Asking a glance from her, as token of gratitude!
Of them the chieftain is,
He has asked for her chastity
In the name of Parasakthi!
In the name of Mother of World!
Kalyani would have lived, in this world,
At least as a wriggling worm!
This priest is the one, who pushed her into
She didn’t like to leave behind her child,
In this heartless world!
She didn’t like for her child,
To writhing die helpless!
It is not strange for to kill the one you love!
He himself has advocated to kill the calf,
That is writhing with pain of disease!
Kalyani too followed the same principle!
How is that a crime?
For a tamizhan, returned from foreign,
Has no means to live!
For a woman, born in tamilnadu,
There is no protection to live!
If my sister had even compromised a little,
In the beds of a crorepati, for a day,
If she had said a price for her chastity,
In the laps of the wealthy, for another day,
She could have lived her daily life as such!
Is this what this court desires?
Posh chased my sister!
She ran in fear!
Money chased my sister!
Devotion frightened my sister!
She ran to the brim of life itself!
Her run should have been stopped!
Her poverty should have been averted!
By these law providers!
Did they do it?
Did they leave my Kalyani to live?
The accused seems to be arguing for someone else’s case!
No! Not for anyone else’s!
That case is too mine!
My Sister’s case!
What’s wrong in me, his brother,
running after the culprit,
who wanted to destroy my sister’s chastity?
Kalyani’s attempt to commit suicide is a crime!
Killing her child is a crime!
My attack on priest is a crime!
Who’s responsible for all these crimes?
Who is? Who is responsible?
Who’s crime is it for letting
Or is it the crime of rogues,
Who feast upon the name of fate?
Who’s crime is it for letting
the growth of money-laundering thieves?
Or is it the crime of rascals,
Who converted poverty to prostitution?
Who’s crime is it for letting
Fake priests to wander around, playing sin in the name of God?
Or is it the crime of Morons
Preaching in the name of God?
Till these crimes are cured,
Are never going to stop!
This is the lesson, Rational,
That can be found in every page
In the books of our lives!

title: [Viswaroopam II] Naanaagiya nadhimoolame
singer: Kamal Haasan, Kaushiki Chakraborty, Master Karthik , Suresh Iyer
english_stanzas:
The spring that flows as me,
With the foundation as mother.
The womb that has held me,
I keep thinking of you everyday…
I keep thinking of you everyday…
Like you, I too got a new life,
For me, the woman, became mother…
I proudly attained the purpose of my birth,
By giving birth to you, and as it happened,
I keep thinking of you everyday
I keep thinking of you everyday
A girl becomes a mother and a new life starts for her, just like the tiny baby that takes up a whole new life ahead of it.
You’re mother, you’re father too,
You also rule over, through affection

I proudly attained the purpose of my birth,

By having you in as family, and as it happened,

I keep thinking of you everyday
As Verb it means one who ultimately rules over the other. Here it means that he willingly enslaves to the boundless affection.

So the parent becomes both the worldly ruler as well as God-like to the child.
I searched for a feminine companion,
Who has the shades and likes of your heart
I see through teary eyes, in the mirage,
The age old dreams..
The memories of past would return,
Would the day come, for me,
To rest upon the lap on which I was born?
Would the special / festive day come?

title: [Agni Sakshi] Kanaa kaanum kangal mella
english_stanzas:
it is that time when clouds of the night (moon time),
are setting out on a procession! Oh dear!
it is the time they are set on a procession! Oh dear!
A damsel’s body, A baby’s heart,
aren’t you are the wonder that is a culmination of both?
Lying on husband’s lap, dawning the form of a daughter
sleeping like a child!
my dear, through the day, you change colors in an instant,
you are the question whose answer I struggle to find,
even while the lamp is lit,
you are the truth that seems like the shadow,
you are the truth that seems like the shadow,
I am the one in love with your reality,
and the one who worships your shadow,
and so, I take even the soil that was touched by your shadow
and apply it as the sacred ash on my forehead!
The cuckoo who composes new songs,
what is the wound that hurts you?
the waves of thoughts which ferociously torment you,
what sins caused them?
The skies of the east will eventually brighten up,
and so I wait here anticipating the day of the dawn!
the happy times will come in the future,
is what the present keeps telling us! Oh Dear!
this is what the present tells us! Oh dear!

title: [Geetha Govindam] Inkem inkem inkem kaavaale
english_stanzas:
A thought that I never perceived about
has connected our hearts now!
What else what else what else is needed? enough, this is enough,
you yourself came to me, only celebrations from now
You increased the pace of my heart,
you brought Holi into my house,
may be this is the normal when you are near,
every hour seems like a life time, I am born again only to die,
the beauty that cannot be envisioned,
the chain that forever clings the breathe,
Do you know what is going on? every corner of my heart is affected!
The lightning of your eyes,
elevates the chaos of my youth,
perhaps, this is the best time for my mischievous dreams!
To stand next to you is akin to getting VISA,
after getting it, I experience ecstasy (the heights of the skies)!
The damsel who is not pleased by the tricks,
The elixir who does not yield to words,
The tensions of constant confrontation, won’t they go away?
to narrate my story simply? won’t you listen to me for a minute?
why these persistent quarrels? won’t you be friendly?
the volcano that erupts thinking of my name!
won’t it cool down and bless me with your friendship?

title: [Aruvi] Merku karaiyil Andha Vaanam …
english_stanzas:
At the western bank (of the river),
the skies have slightly turned red (sunrise is about to happen),
The heart, yearning to witness the sunrise,
is waiting a little more
Will this dream close the eyes before catching the sunrise?
Will this soul get wasted and burn away?
When the clogged heart begins to open up, smile and speak,
the blocking sadness will run away frightened!
even the sidelined relationships will hesitantly join back,
The cool breeze, the soothing song,
does your breathe yearn to enjoy them?
the conversations you had while looking into the face,
are those moments now fogging you in them?
Pain is an experience too!
if you ask more,
it will bless you with the boons!
love and compassion, increase your longevity!
love and compassion, increase your longevity!
love and compassion, increase your longevity!
[Aruvi Merku Karaiyil lyrics and translation]

title: [Maa] Ennuyire …
english_stanzas:
The Lyrics, music and the wonderful voice of Padmapriya Raghavan do some magic here! A song which is deep and touches the soul! Must listen and ponder!
Whose mistake are you ?
Whose mistake am I ?
Searching for these answers, our whole life starts melting!
Before finding the answer, it completely dissolves away!
it this life just a dream?
it this life just a dream?
it this life just a dream?
(We spend a whole life time finding solutions to questions about our existence and purpose in life; in the end the question still remains, while our current journey comes to an end)
My Dear! My Life!

title: [Meendum Kokila] Chinnanchiru Vayathil …
singer: K. J. Yesudas, S. P. Sailaja
english_stanzas:
At this tender age I see a masterful artwork,
As if the barriers went away, I feel like saying something,
In the valorous dramas, he (the poet) had embedded an important note of wisdom,
Even while it stays in my heart, I stayed mute afraid to express it,
I had embraced silence,
why are you hiding it from me? tell me about the poem, he said!
At this tender age I see a masterful artwork,
As if the barriers broke away, I feel like saying something,
I lay there as if the white snow had melted into the laps,
I went until the school to learn the lessons, oh chellamma!
I have now voluntarily put my eyes into this blaze called love,
at the time when the fascinations bump, Oh chellamma!
At this tender age I see a masterful artwork,
As if the barriers broke away, I feel like saying something,

title: [Kochadaiiyaan] Senthee / Idhayam
english_stanzas:
Like the egg of peacock that was rolled on over the golden rock by a monkey,
My heart slowly, tenderly, hesitantly crawls on
Like the flower that withered from a fragrant branch of a good tree,
and got caught in the eye of whirlpool;
My heart is in a turmoil, forgetting the shores and losing directions..
Like the large fruit hanging on a tender branch,
My soul is small,
(Yet) my love is huge
The Creepers forgot to blossom,
The Lightning forgot to smile,
The Forest forgot to bear vegetation,
The books (epics were written on palmyra leafs) forgot to bear epics,
but I have not forgotten you and would never forget you..
Waves might desert the ocean,
Sound might desert the air,
But I would never ever desert you,
Petals open up with fragrance,
Could that fragrance be imprisoned? /
Once I speak up, it flows like gentle fragrance,
And who could ever imprison fragrance?

title: [Sathya] Yavvana
english_stanzas:
that which was not revealed to anyone until now,
that which was not felt in the last 21 years (3*7 muuvezhu),
my -fears- are now celebrating!
weave your hands with mine, yavvana
gaze into my eyes, yavvana
unite with my soul, yavvana
listen to my words, yavvana,
you are my life, yavvana,
you are my sky, yavvana,
that which was not revealed to anyone until now,
that which was not felt in the last 21 years (3*7 muuvezhu),
my -fears- are now celebrating!
unable to go with the skies,
unable to stand on ground,
my legs are confused!
I have turned into a (brittle) glass flower,
and have fallen into your hands,
weave your hands with mine, yavvana
gaze into my eyes, yavvana
unite with my soul, yavvana
listen to my words, yavvana,
you are my life, yavvana,
you are my sky, yavvana,
the blue glow (the rainbow) is spattered
for us, the river of time
is setting a tune!
love paints a picture,
A beautiful future is near, right in front of us,
A path laden with flowers,
The world transforms into a familiar dream,
I sport a fake smile
cast away my fears
and embrace me as the fence of love,
I as the spark of fire,
you are the wick that adorns me,
[Yavvana song lyrics and translation]

title: [Enai Noki Paayum Thota] Visiri …
english_stanzas:
How far should we go? I ask,
only for you to answer!
and so, I persistently ask!
since you say that
I leave even without a nudge!
you are the one who
strolls in the dreams of many,
if ever a man is your dreams,
it will forever be me!
I am the fan here!
You stood in my house,
in disbelief I pinched myself!
You stood in my garden,
mistaking you for the flower,
I try to pluck!
I have seen them all,
the garlands of glory, the honey groves,
why then did I come behind you?
No need of the big money nor the gold mines,
all I need is you!
I see my blazing vigour slumbering into tiny sparks,
Along with the breeze,
I see my angers dissolve like dust!
The days I do not catch a glimpse of you,
are the wasted days of my life!
since you came every day and offered me a shoulder,
I became an ecstatic woman,
if a heart refuses to accept a youthful man like you,
it sure is a fallacy,
I witness your unbounded purity,
in the manliness that converses looking into my eyes,
Visiri lyrics and translation

title: [Thavamaai thavamirundhu] Unnai charanadainthen
english_stanzas:
I surrender unto you, I’m born within you
I was frozen within me, I melt in you
My eyes depends on you over it’s lashes
My breathing searches for you over air
You have transformed to mother
You stand in support like the root
For the relentless heart, you are the soothing rhythm,
Like the salt that resides in the depths of tears,
I’ll reside within your heart forever..
I asked for flowers to bloom like the way you open your eyes to see..
I will grow peace and comfort all over the land that you would walk on..
I will infuse the tender love of mother even on the water you drink..
I will be the rain over your world (to nurture it)..
I will be the river over your desires (to cultivate it)..
I would say that there is no love in the word love,
Rather, let’s live this life as the meaning of love..
You have become all my relations,
You have ridden away all the despair..
As you embrace me, like the hatching mother sparrow,
I, like the newborn, crack open myself and inch myself out of my shell
And is born anew every single day..

title: [Sachin] Kanmoodi thirakkumbothu
english_stanzas:
Just after the blink of eye,
Like the God that appeared before,
Just before my eyes,
She came and stood by..
Just when the umbrella is not available,
Like the rain that drenched,
She drenched me in beauty
And said this is love..
Till I crossed my street end,
I thought it was just another day..
As soon as I saw my Angel,
I say today is a special day /celebration..
Oh my! I got myself into
Though there are ways to escape,
I declined the ways to get away..
I know not your name, I know not your place,
Does beautiful bird require a name?
I see you without you seeing me,
Does the moon know of its reflection on the river?
I carry another life in my life..
I feel the weight of mountain in my heart..
If you walk over the streets,
Even the street lamps wink at you..
Even the Sun will throw
tantrum to go home..
If you bathe in the river,
Even the fish will get fever..
Just to caress you,
Even when the quake shakes,
My heart hasn’t shaken..
But with the bump of a flower,
My heart has fallen..

title: [Kadugu] Nilavedhu Karaiyedhu
english_stanzas:
Which part is moon? which part is stain?
What is beauty? Which is flaw?
Who wrote those rules?
Heart has learnt to weigh the wound,
With the weight of tears shed from eyes..
Within me, is this a fire burning?
Alas, my heart, who would you ask?
Crime.. It’s depth of impact..
Never expressed by laws..
When the self is wounded,
His screams pierce the ears..
When someone else is wounded,
His ears become deaf to cries..
Pity, is there a smaller one?
Distress, is there a bigger one?
Who would you ask?

title: [Gnanapazham] Yaarum illaatha
english_stanzas:
I want a solitary island and
I want only you next to me on it..
I want the clouds of the sky to be the mat,
I want the stars to be flowers spread over them,
And let’s revamp this entire universe..
I want you alone as the reflection of my vision,
I want only your words to be heard through my ears,
I want a boon to be granted for my heart to beat
In the rhythm of your name,
I want to enjoy the bliss of feeling the tingling
through each pore of me, as your soul mingles into mine,
Like the relentless ticking of the second hand of the watch,
For my heart to circle you and for our souls to unite into one,
I want a solitary island and
I want only you next to me on it..
I want the Ganges and Cauvery to merge as one,
And let’s cherish the bathe with love in that river,
I want to give the sweet jasmine for you to adorn,
that has bloomed in the Eezham after the war has settled in there,
I want to stroll along with you, over the streets of Kashmir,
When the war fires are put out and breeze winds through in celebration,
On a day when blasting bombs become beautiful bouquet,
For me, to enjoy the bliss of sleeping, with your lap as my pillow,
I want a solitary island and
I want only you next to me on it..

title: [Kaadhal Mannan] Vaanum Mannum
english_stanzas:
M: Sky and earth has embraced each other

Blue of sky is sticking to the earth..

F: For a bamboo forest to burn,

A small spark of fire is enough..

The spark has ignited here..

M: Love doesn’t see places..

It doesn’t see races..

It blooms all of a sudden..

F: A fish of pond is desiring for shore..

What all would happen hence forth?
M: Is this right or not,

No one’s here to explain it..

F: As silence becomes a language,

Languages are just a hindrance..

Nothing else strikes the mind..

M: There is none who had witnessed

Drowning of moon in the river’s water..

F: This moon-like girl has drowned today

into ditch of gold hindering the self..

Grammars aren’t adhered to..

M: Blooming buds doesn’t look for a date to bloom..

F: Relationships might change, It isn’t in your control..

M: A fish of pond is desiring for shore..

What all would happen hence forth?
F: Where shall I rain? Does rain think so?

Seeing omens and stars, does love links hearts?

Is there a defined path for emotions?

M: Love defeats fate, is there a counter argument to that?

Thousands of paths spread for love,

Is there anyone who has seen them to relay?

Could dreams be fenced?

F: Love doesn’t listen to what time says..

M: The river of desire isn’t controlled by dams..

F: A fish of pond is desiring for shore..

What all would happen hence forth?

title: [Kaaka Muttai] Ethai Ninaithom
english_stanzas:
The thing we desired, we attained,
after attaining it did we realise the truth!
Our desires have no limits,
if you continue to pursue it, life will be burden,
No one has ever conquered desires,
My children seem to have realised it today!
it hands you new anxieties!
it will ruin your daily sleep!
while if you opened your heart,
you enjoy what you have!
riding on desires, we reached the clouds,
we became like the crows incubating cuckoo eggs,
If we learn to appreciate the dew drop sleeping
on the tip of a grass blade,
then, our obsession for the lustre of lightning
if we learn to enjoy the life
that we are currently bestowed with,
new light will reach us after
striking the doors of the windows!
[Edhai Ninaithom lyrics and translation]

title: [12B] Poove Vaai Pesum Pothu
english_stanzas:
When the flower begins to speak,
after listening to the words of flower,
say a few soothing words as reply,
If you say a soothing word,
I will live on in the creeper,
If you move on crossing me, I will wither to the ground,
I will continue to plead,
I would have tied up the flowers and be enveloped in it, Oh dear!
if you deliver a smile, they will stand dispersed, Oh dear!
I will be waiting for the command of my lover,
At your arms reach, I will wait delightedly!
I will keep wandering in your breath!
why do you break the lock of my silence?
what else could I say?
with a glance, come closer to me,
with a word, fill me up (with your thoughts),
Kill me with your affection,
Bury me in your heart,
If a thought of me ever strikes you,
Spill a tiny tear-drop,
Ah, a hundred epics will fail,
in front of what you said today!

title: [Raam] Nizhalinai Nijamum …
english_stanzas:
can the shadow ever separate from the object casting it?
can the soul live without the body?
was carrying me in your womb a burden? oh mother?
will you bear me once more again? mom!
I am here just as a moving corpse,
is this a conspiracy of fate?
the wave which gets spit by the ocean eventually merges back into it,
just like that, take me back, mom!
Since the whole world refers me as your son,
I even forgot who am I to myself! (other than that I am your son)
All I need is just one relationship, that is you,
this whole world is mine then,
I stayed inside for ten months until maturity,
was it a sin that I came into this world? oh mom!
all directions seem dark now,
where is my journey going now?
my heart has broken now,
I don’t know how to mend it!
if the sun breaks down, there is no day! oh mom!
if the skies disappear, the whole universe is a fallacy!
there are unexplainable things happening around me! oh mom!
will everything that was, go away as a dream?
I lost you in my slumber! oh mom!
will god help me find you back?

title: [Bharathidasan] Thamizhin inimai
english_stanzas:
The flesh-pulp from sweet fruit,
the juice derived from mature sugarcane,
The honey from snow-dew-flowers,

the sweet from jaggery when boiled,
The milk tendered from good-healthy-cow,

the cool tender coconut from coconut tree
Are indeed sweet to me, yet, listen,

I say Thamizh is my soul!
The buzzing of bees in orchard,

the babbling of water over pond or river,
The melody arising from flute,

the divine hymn spilling from veena,
The lisp of toddlers,

the fondling talks from lips of maiden,
Are indeed to my seeking, yet, listen,

Thamizh and me are indeed like body and soul!
The brothers who are dearest,

the kith and kin who are living around,
The mother who is kind and compassionate,

the father who never forgets about me,
The wife whose talks are as sweet as Koel,

the offspring upon whom love is poured upon
Are comparatively strangers, since, listen,

Thamizh resides thus on my knowledge!
The twinkling star studded blue sky

along it is the full snow White moon,
The emerging sun in morning

along is the sea flooded with the light,
The descending light of evening,

it’s beauty reflected over mountains,
Are indeed a wonder, sayeth the poet, yet,

would he be able to describe the wonder of Thamizh?
The rice derived from finest paddy,

the vegetable curry made with cow-ghee,
The beans which are one of its kind,

Rasam mixed with thick curd,
The yams prepared in good taste,

the pancakes which are mouth-watering
Are what builds your body, Thamizha!

Your heart and soul are built by Thamizh!

title: [Nee varuvaai ena] Paarthu paarthu
english_stanzas:
My eyes are always open, as I constantly keep on the lookout for your arrival, I gather and preserve the smiles by grinning, for you to arrive!
Will you come as breeze? I will wait as the window;
Will you come as dew drops? I will wait waiting as the clouds;
Will you come as the colors? I will wait as the flowers;
Will you come as words? I will wait as poetry;
in anticipation of your arrival,
I started gathering the sea shells on the shores everyday for you,
Thinking you would read Kumudam and Vikadan, I too became a reader,
I am gathering poetry and kolam (art) books for you,
I’m planning everyday about what to speak about to you in my dream,
Every time a crow caws, I look at my door,
The moon knows my pain, for it too doesn’t have a pair,
The poem I wrote for you, doesn’t have legs to reach you,
The female population in the world is 100 crores, In it, who are you?
I’m waiting as the dried leaf, awaiting your footprints,
My eyes get tired, checking and re-checking time and the walkways, Waiting for your arrival,

title: [Velaiilla Pattadhari 2] Angel Of Raghuvaran – Iraivanaai Thandha Iraiviye
song: Angel Of Raghuvaran – Iraivanaai Thandha Iraiviye
english_stanzas:
The portrait visible in the dark!
The angel who supports me even during distress,
Until this life holds, your lap is my abode,
In path of love, pains dissolve,
the whole world seems to be under the feet,
Oh dear, your life is your meaning!
Shall I bestow the skies upon you?
Oh dear, Oh dear, My king!
shall I place the heavens in your hands?
In my heart some thing smiles,
inside, the cuckoo sings,
The eyes attract magically,
You are the supreme mother,
water seems to seep into the (impervious) rocks,
plant a kiss, oh my beloved Tamil,
you are fully mine,
the elixir fills my ears,

title: [Aalavandhan] Kadavul Paadhi
english_stanzas:
I am a fusion of half God, half Demon;
I am an animal outside and a God inside;
I am like a poem that cannot be understood.
I am trying to kill the Demon, and
nurture the God in me.
But, the Demon is killing and devouring the God,
to get nurtured and grow!
will you kill the Demon tomorrow?
With the remains of what remained (of the God) ,
will you bring forth the God (again)?
If man came from monkey,
can he be born as  food?
Oh man who came from an Demon,
can you ever become one with the divine?
I am a fusion of half God, half Demon;
I am a bird that climbs in the air, dances on the mountain, and sings poetry.
cools down the roots of life.
the rain drops do not burn. Don’t you know?
The tears that fall through our face are
the one that burn. do you know?
You are the one who saw both the tears and rain as the same.
You are the one who made people shower in tears as well as in rain.
[Kadavul Paadhi lyrics and translation]

title: [Thavamaai thavamirundhu] Naane tholaintha kadhai
english_stanzas:
Oh dear one, I did not realise the tale of me losing myself (to you)
My love, will you find the way through which love creeped into me?
As the splattering rain drops freeze like the lightning,
As my shadow on the ground transforms into you,
Poetry pours out from fingers,
Love glides across my eyes,
Like the joy of rain’s one-legged dance over the river,
Dreams bloom in my heart and,
Love drowns me within its whirlpool,
to learn the ways of your heart, I was donning the role of a thief,
But now, I came to realise that you too are a thief like me,
I caress my fingers as yours during the night,
I splash water as your kisses over my face,
I become the sunshine in morning in search of your face,
I become the cuckoo on the road in search of your voice,
Even in the examination hall, my thoughts are only about you, oh angel!
Tomorrow is a holiday and our parting is torture of love,
My eyes seek you forgetting me,
My breathe sings your name within me,
Shall I have a love-tiff with you?
Or instead of speaking, shall I ask for a kiss?
Like the joy that rain brings to the sun scorched street,
At the time of breaking this  solitude (during the time of your company),
Love takes us like a breeze to distant places

title: [Rhythm] Kaatre en vaasal
english_stanzas:
Breeze, you came by my door and slowly opened it,

I asked your name, breeze.. and You replied as love..

Where were you yesterday? Tell me, oh breeze, I asked..

I was in your breath! said the breeze and left..
Oh prancing breeze, do speak your mother tongue..

As long as the moon and earth live, keep flowing into hearts..
When it rains in the monsoon, I need a place to hide..

Will you shelter me under your wrap?

For me to sleep, I need a beautiful place,

Will you let me in your eyes?
As you wriggle next to me,
I hide inside your heart..
Would you find my reflection in your heart?
Let lovers live as long as honey is in flowers..
Let love too live as long as sky is above earth..
Like the pearl which forms within a shell over a long time,

My femininity has attained its culmination..

is the unopening shell asking me to open it

My heart is shaken of possibilities..
I was thinking of myself as a kid..
Your arrival has made me realize my age..
Will you once again turn me into a kid?
Is it right of you, at this age, to ask for cradle instead of cot?
Is it wrong, for us, to become like babies on the cot?

title: [Mounam Sammatham] Kalyana Thaen Nila
singer: K. J. Yesudas K. S. Chitra
english_stanzas:
The sweet moon of marriage,
you are the unchanged pure (white) moon,
You are the moon of the skies,
come with me now, oh moon!
you are the never eroding bright moon,
is your love resident in these eyes?
the skies have transcended to the ground now!
The Pandyans of Madurai
The Poems of Thevaram
The never ending conflicts of lovers!
The honey drips in unison
Forever we stay united
is ecstasy in the body?
or is it in your fingers that caress me?
Lets find it out ardently!
Is your body made of teak?
is nectar dripping from your words?
is your look like a hook?
am I in a prison cell now?
or is it the words you speak?
is my life in me?
or is it in your looks?
is the honey dripping jackfruit

title: [Darling] Un vizhigalil
english_stanzas:
I am falling into your eyes and emerge again

Why am I falling again after emerging too?
I wander around to fall in line of your sight

Yet why do I get lost in that wander?

Even if I part you for a second,

My soul feels like being in war..

Putting together all my love for you,
I pen down a letter for you… My darling…
Like the cloud that appears afar,

I look at you so, my dear..

You once caressed me like a drizzle,

Did you realise that? my dear..

Will my heart’s desire become a mirage?

Or will it become reality? my dear..

Will the time I loved you become naught?

I am gathering all memories here..

Still, into the hands of love,

I fall willingly, my dear..
A woman’s heart is like

The colors that appear on a flower..

A man’s heart is like

The colors that appear on a butterfly..

Though the colors may appear different

Will the thoughts become one? oh dear..

For the wings of butterfly to rest upon,

Lips are awaiting here..

Still, into the hands of love,

I fall willingly, my dear..

title: [Raja Rani] Adada adada
english_stanzas:
Oh dear, Are you the beauty of beauty?
Are you my soulmate? Who are you?
Is this true? Or is my heart dreaming?
Or is this dream becoming true? Who are you?

title: [Raja Rani] Nee yaaro yaaro
english_stanzas:
Who are you? Who might you be?
Who am I? Who might I be?
But now, Am I a part of you?
I was going on without realising this,
You go on without uttering your thoughts,
Hence life was meaningless till yesterday..
I found the day from which I would start living again..
I found a shoulder to lean on and share my life..
From now on, With you, my loneliness will wither away..
From now on, my life would have a meaning / purpose..

title: [Guru] Aaruyire
singer: A. R. Rahman, Murtuza Khan, Qadir Khan, Chinmayee
english_stanzas:
my desires prance over you!
will you forgive? will you forgive? tell me,
the nights spent without you
won’t they be nights without air?
if at all you leave me,
my moon becomes fatigued,
the blueness of my sky fades away,
Insecurity struck me as I
thinking of you I wilted away,
without you, even poetry and music
Oh beauty of all five senses!
is it fair that the thorn (which is supposed to protect)

hurts the rose?

by our talking, will this pretentious anger of mine abate?

because of you, life here is a pleasure!

even while present, suffering does not seem to bother!

don’t kill me with your nonviolent means!
will you forgive? will you forgive? tell me,
[Guru] Aaruyire lyrics and translation

title: [Enai nokki paayum thotta] Naan pizhaipeno
english_stanzas:
Lessons aren’t to liking..
Why are they not over water on lotus leaves,
But hurting on earth, these two tender foot?
Why isn’t this art not confined to paper,
But here, with all its thousands of colors as this lass?
Will I survive? I’m hyperventilating..
My (love) fever crosses, Even beyond hundred!
All my thoughts, Are filled about dame..
Like a drama, Life scrolls on..
Feeling like to shower, thousands of flowers..
Just while thinking, my sins are washed away..
Bcoz of senorita, temperature is tampered..
Weather forecasts are being defeated..
Just as the sleep slips off, her face is the first sight..
Changing me into a newer version of myself is this introduction..
None ever till this day was this new orchard,
Which blooms everywhere, why did it come in a jiffy?
That moment of certainty to see you everyday,
It gave me quake that chilled me all through
Will I survive? I’m hyperventilating..
My (love) fever crosses even beyond hundred!
All my thoughts are filled about dame..
Like a drama, life scrolls on..
While seeing you, why previous memories,
When I go home, even there, your face
Comes stubbornly to weaken me, Why?
Even if I call it near to me, it wouldn’t come any closer..
It wouldn’t be enough,
To thaw this frozen snow
[Naan Pizhaippeno lyrics and translation]

title: [Kaatru Veliyidai] Kelayo – Tango
english_stanzas:
Won’t you listen?
Won’t you listen?
Won’t you have a look
at my pleading heart?
If I’m separated from you,
I won’t live alone,
Just like the bird Andril!
If you ever forget me, Wind will howl,
You won’t go afar from me,
You won’t dare forget me,
If you do, the far far away stars
Would be withering from sky..
[I believe that you wouldn’t forget me until Wind speaks of it’s own accord, Camel walks over ocean or stars twinkle in the sky]
What fault did you see in me?
Do you speak of love
Yet you nurture just lust?
Is love just a lie?
Why is there a gap, lady?
Why did you get separated?
Why did you do that?
You dare forget me, Why?

title: [Kaatru Veliyidai] Nallai Allai / Vaanil thedi
english_stanzas:
I was searching for you in the skies,

You immersed yourself into the deep oceans,

When I leapt into the deep oceans,

You emerged into the high skies..
You let me wander amidst stars,
You made me lose the thought of me
(You made me lose myself into you)
(You made me lose my self-centered thoughts)
This isn’t fair of you, Oh good moon,

This is definitely not fair of you..

This isn’t fair of you, Oh good night,

This is definitely not fair of you..
[The moon and night are called good sarcastically, since they seem to be playing spoilsport in letting the hero and his love meet in secrecy by being bright!]
The original kuRunthoGai song with its meaning could be found here!
The journeys seeking sound,

Find the destination of silence!

The journeys seeking silence,

Find the destination of wisdom!

When I was seeking you over land,

You ran away (into sky) adoring the clouds..
[The silence adds value to music and wisdom adds purpose to silence. Hence, I am seeking value and purpose to me / my life, which could be attained only when you are part of my life!]
This isn’t fair of you, Oh good moon,
This is definitely not fair of you..
This isn’t fair of you, Oh good night,
This is definitely not fair of you..
[The moon and night are called good sarcastically]
I was waiting to caress your face as a flower bud, cloud-bud (dew drop)..
You have bloomed into a flower,
I was waiting to inhale your fragrance (I was waiting to get married to you)
Even before I could get intoxicated with your pollen,
You withered away stating the scorching heat..
This isn’t fair of you, Oh fragrant flower,

This is definitely not fair of you..
This isn’t fair of you, Oh jasmine orchard,

This is definitely not fair of you..

title: [Endhiran] Pudhiya manidha
singer: S. P. Balasubrahmanyam, A. R. Rahman, Khatija Rahman
english_stanzas:
A new (version of) human!
Transcend to this earth!
By casting molten metal, blending silicon to it,
With a body that never decays, With a soul that never drains;
Infusing a blend of the sixth sense,
An attempt to raise the seventh!
Bring change, strive to elevate humanity;
With your skills and energy, Change the world;
Be good to all living things,
Be truthful in all circumstances!
I know six senses,
but, you (human) have exemplary knowledge,
I learnt six languages (for programming),
but, you (human) have hundreds of your own,
I have no kidney nor lungs nor pain,
No trouble of heart,
What’s born from womb withers,
What’s born from wisdom never withers!
Here is my robot!
I’m another Brahma (Four-headed God, who creates life on earth),
Who you are is my son,
A male child conceived by a man,
Yes, your name is Enthiran!
I, am the language of wisdom,
Why? (questioning) is my way of life,
My vision soars the horizons,
I’m the wisdom-light of tomorrows,
What you have is human form,
While my form is that of the intellect,
What you have is this one birth,
While I will see (take) many births,
Even while I learnt many languages,
Even if I win over many continents,
Wouldn’t I still be slave to my creator?!

title: [Duet] Anjali Anjali
singer: S. P. Balasubrahmanyam, K. S. Chithra
english_stanzas:
Oh Anjali, Anjali, my floral tribute!
Oh Anjali, Anjali, my floral tribute!
Oh floret, at your feet is my floral tribute!
Oh precious, my golden tribute in honour of your name!
Oh dearest, my musical tribute in honour of your voice!
for such an unseen beauty, my poetic tribute!
Until love enchanted us, we lead different lives,
the gold chain of love bound us now, my dearest!
After the droplets of rain merge into the ocean, which drop is the rain drop?
similarly, oh lover, I have now now become one with love!
I have held the precious feet of the damsel,
I compose a new song for her every day!
Anjali, Anjali, the love of my life!
The love of Sita sunk in through the eye then,
Today, the love of kodhai sunk in through the ear,
Oh what feeling is this? my heart is awe struck in the music,
in the path that the music took, slowly Tamil too slipped in,
Into the path of music, my heart did melt away,
Into the path of Tamil, my life sneaked away,
Anjali Anjali, she is the lover of arts!
Oh dear, for your love, my floral tribute!
Oh friend, for your eyes, my dance tribute!
My dear, for your music to sustain, my musical tribute!
Oh Poet, for the poet in you to sustain, my poetic tribute!
Oh beauty! There is no wonder quite like you!
As I utter your name, the buds blossom instantly,
After the month of kaarthigai passes, there is no heavy rain,
similarly, if you are not there, there is no poetry left in me!
are you a sibling of the moon?
was your genesis in a flower?
Anjali, Anjali, the love of my life!

title: [Karuththamma] Thenmerku Paruva Kaatru
english_stanzas:
When the southwest monsoon breeze caresses
the bee, there is drizzle, a drizzle of happiness,
As the forest cactus suddenly spawns a bud,
As the herb plant in red laden forest blossoms a flower,
The colours absent in the entirety of skies and this earth,
is what I witness in the damsel and her eyes,
The musical elixir absent even in a lullaby,
is what I witness in your praising song!
What penance did that rain drop do?
it enjoys being close to the flower’s bosom,
When I fantasise about you nudging
the places where the rain drop touched,
A strange intoxication runs through the body!
You and me, these two words merged into one,
and became the single word “Us”
and became the single word “humanity”
What is this illusion that the wizardry called love is showing me?
A piece of the rainbow transcended to this earth,
and without telling any one, became this damsel!

title: [Kaatru Veliyidai] Vaan …
english_stanzas:
He will come to me!

He will caress me!
He will drizzle like the rain drops!
He will unlock the mystery!
He will shine in me!
He will stand next to me (with pride / no hesitation)!
He will be humble when afar (missing me / missing part of him)
when arrogance strikes,

he freezes as stone!
he melts as a ripe fruit,
When he is with me,
he will think of her (motherland?),
when he is with her,
he will think of me!
He will never renounce me!
He will never forget my name!
If he forgot me,
He would give up his life!
When my eyes droop
he will expand as horizon in my dream!
if the eyes open,
he will melt in an instant!

title: [Kaatru Veliyidai] Azhagiye
english_stanzas:
Waiting for a smile, smile now!
My heartbeat has gone missing! You’re the thief!
Oho! I am a poet!
I am the poet spoilt by your sight!
Shall I speak honestly?
Or is this enough?
Many new account payables are pending!
Shall I ask you as a chorus?
is it a yes? is it a yes? is it a no? or are you planning to escape
Oh beauty! Marry me, Marry me! Oh Beauty!
Flirt With Me, Get High With Me,
If you get angry, if you get struck by coyness,
Oh beauty! Marry me, Marry me! Oh Beauty!
Flirt With Me, Get High With Me,
If love strikes you, if such a situation arises,
What is the thing, that thing,  that I ask you,
that has never been asked before?
If you give it, Thank you!
If you give it  without being stubborn!
I ask a tiny bit of your time!
I ask a tiny bit of your love!
I ask a tiny bit of lust!
Don’t say no!
you you you youyouyou youyouyou you you you
Oh beauty! Marry me, Marry me! Oh Beauty!
Flirt With Me, Get High With Me,
If you get angry, if you get struck by coyness,
Oh beauty! Marry me, Marry me! Oh Beauty!
Flirt With Me, Get High With Me,
If love strikes you, if such a situation arises,

title: [Kanchana 2] Motta Paiyaa…
english_stanzas:
The dude with shaven head, the dude with shaven head, is a very very mischievous dude!
The dude with shaven head, the dude with shaven head, is a very very mischievous dude!
The mischievous dude, the mischievous dude, the one who touched my soul!
Will I get such a relationship? the heart had yearned for it!
The boon has finally become a reality today!
The time when our love becomes triumphant,
God will finally appear to our eyes!
Admiring the music from the striking bells of your anklets,
I will live my tomorrows!
What was in the heart comes out as words,
at this moment I witness heaven on earth,
I thanked god for having given me my man!
My body and soul shudders as I think of you and I forget myself!
There may be women more beautiful than you in this world,
let them be, they are not beautiful to me!
The happiness that your smile exudes, is the limit of beauty!
If you happen to go in the street carrying god’s chariot,
I will forget my religion, and strive to
try to find a place near you!

title: [Madarasapattinam] Pookal pookum
singer: Roop Kumar Rathod, Harini, Andrea Jeremiah, GV Prakash Kumar
english_stanzas:
The instant when flowers blossom,
Oh my dearest, no one has ever seen it,
When the sky dawns to morning,
Until yesterday time did not seem to move,
While with you beside, time is never sufficient
Nothing has been spoken today, why so?
Nothing crops up in thoughts, what is this (feeling)?
The night doesn’t seem to crawl to dawn, but when it dawns,
The day doesn’t seem to end, oh my tender one..
for the damsel’s glances speak volumes for a lifetime
No need of yesterday, no need of tomorrow,
Just this moment alone is enough..
Without roots, without seed, without the rain from the skies,
How are these flowers blooming in his garden?
How does his friendship win over me?
This hesitation that fills all the heart,
where will it take me to?
To know (answer to) this, where could I get an explanation?
If (you) ever receive the reasons, do tell to me too..
Oh my tender flower
It Makes Me want to come alive; it makes me want to fly into the sky!
Oh Where Would I Be If I didn’t have you next to me?
Oh Where Would I Be? Oh Where, Oh Where?
What cloud is this, which has come to my doorstep,
And is sprinkling cool rain all over..
What relationship is this, which couldn’t be comprehended,
Yet this keeps on growing..
Without deciphering who he is nor knowing his name,
How a relationship is being bound to him?
Without asking why nor stopping when hindered,
My heart keeps following wherever he goes on..
Even while the paths ends,
the journey doesn’t end in this world
Though the bird has flown far into the sky,
The dance started in the leaves doesn’t finish,
What wonder is this?

title: [Baba] Sakthi Kodu…
english_stanzas:
looking at our walk, egos would be caged!
looking at our army the directions should run in fear!
give us the strength! give us the strength! give us the strength!
You are the soul!
you are the truth!
he is omnipresent, in the pillar, in the straw!
to bring an end to atrocities,
For principles to win,
Give us the strength!
Give us the strength to bring to shore
those displaced by floods,
Give us the strength to bring up
those lying in the hollow!
Give us the strength to  set fire to
Give us the strength to rejuvenate
those born to poverty!
Give the strength to smash volcanoes with our legs,
Given the strength so that with a single uttered word the world changes,
Once I make a decision, I will not change my path,
I will not take back steps I kept forward,
I will not disappoint those who come relying on me!
I will not also not be duped by those who want to use me just as a ladder to move ahead!
I will never forget the land of Tamils which fed me!
I will never forget the land of Tamils which fed me!
Life is only here for me!
I will never run away!
I will never desire political affiliations or official designations!
I will never deny the order of time too!
[Baba Sakthi Kodu lyrics and translation]

title: [Thaakka Thaakka] Saaral mazhaiyaai
english_stanzas:
Like the sprinkling rain, you entered through window..
Like the tiny drops, you spilled over me..
Like the fingers of wind, you yearned to caress me..
With the charming beauty, you struggled to kill me..
You embraced me for a second,
I was afloat in the middle of sea..
You kissed me on next second,
I was flying in the sky..
In an unexpected moment,
You give what’s expected..
You gave fire as well as water in single glance..

title: [Bairavaa] Manjal megam / Nillayo
english_stanzas:
Yellow cloud.. A yellow cloud
Goes in front of me, as a young lass..
My trembling body and screaming soul
Goes following her, asking for her name..
My darling flower, I found you..
I find my life scattering into tiny pieces..
Wont you stop? Wont you? What’s your name?
Because of you, I forgot.. What’s my name?
Is this a dream? Is what I am seeing a dream?
In front of me, is this God Particle? Solid form of Wind?
Is she the bearer of Kamban’s poetry?
Is she the fourth sea of South?
(Is she) Silicon statue?
(Is she) a flower with tiny petals?
(Is she) White river?
(Is she) Moon from another place?
(Is she) Statue made of fine gold?
(Is she) the beauty of five metals?
(Is she) daughter of Brahma?
(Is she) female form of Sun?
I have not seen another woman like you,
(Hence) No one has ever killed half my life..
Either embrace me and give me bliss,
Or hang me in noose with your hair..

title: [Yazh] Yazh nee
english_stanzas:
You are harp; I am fastidious honey,
I am bark of sandal tree; you are smiling flower,
You are sword, I am melting war,
I am crumpled paper, you are alliteration,
You asked for vermilion directly, you, the sparkling cloud,
I am the root of wax, you seeped into every part of me as Sun,
What else am I? All answers would be you!
Is there honey untouched by Sun? You are leaf-brush of the scorching heat,
Is there flower untouched by Honey? I, the dew drop hanging in the tip of peepal tree,
Like horseride, the speed increases,
[Pari – Horse / Speed]

In two cups, the ocean resides,

title: [Kaalakkoothu] Engeyo Pogum
english_stanzas:
Tamil cinema music is in good hands!
Let us embark on new journeys in this world!
What will happen to life here?
Who will give answers?
two lives yearn to find out!
Like shade in scorching sun,
Like an umbrella in the rain,
who will come and join us?
A shoulder to rest upon,
A support that is mine,
this relationship alone is all I have,
When we embark on a journey
with no expectations, no disappointments,
God will be with us!
For this relationship that is as inseparable in life
as the lines of the feet, what is its longevity?
Like the sculpture within a stone, Like the waterbody within our eyes,
When the gods transcend into this earth,
don’t forget to ask them their views about this,
In this fleeting life, what is it that is permanent?
who will give a convincing explanation to this?
In this life that is as temporary as the mirage,
will one be able to win life on friendship’s support?
When it so happens that one supports another in a journey,
is this the genesis of a new relationship?
Who will come and tell us about those unwritten rules,
is this only a perception? No it is reality!
Tears or happiness, everything is split equal!
who taught us this beautiful new principle!
Millions of ties, with them are millions of bonds,
all of them seem to have become a lie!
What ever may come, our friendship alone is enough,
with this thought, eyes close and the journey continues..
[Kaalakkoothu] Engeyo Pogum lyrics and translation

title: [Enai Noki Paayum Thota] Maruvaarthai
english_stanzas:
fall asleep along my lap,
As I protect you like those eyelids,
transform into a dream,
Like the feathers of a peacock,
my fingers caress you,
The conversations that ensue
As those tears get squandered,
I preserve those drops hoping that
they do not cross over my eyelids,
my eyes swell into an ocean now!
Even while I claim to have forgotten you,
Not a day passes without your remembrance,
Even in separation, my love for you
is never a lie (is a truth)!
The dawns that do not break!
In those unending evenings,
remnants of undrained sweat drops!
those inseparable moments in the blanket!
A clock shows the time!
but we understood the torment it brings!
the interval for changing robes,
we realized only later,
The heart never forgets! it follows even after death!
you are the beginning! you are the end too!
You are the shine (joy)! You are the universe!
Even while you are afar!
Even while you seem like the horizon!
you have merged into my eyes!
You have entwinted into by soul long before!
With the flower called your lips,
you drew many a letters!
but before I could reply to them,
you dissolved as a dream!
The ire will abate! My darling!
We lost (ourselves) ! this youthful form!
From now, will be the times of rain (monsoon)!

title: [Amaran] Chandirane Suriyane
english_stanzas:
A father talking to his son about life! Beautiful!
My Moon, my Sun, my stellar hero (referring to his son)
My Moon, my Sun, my stellar hero
The east brightened, the heart too bloomed!
The scar from the burn did not heal, The heart refuses to change even after the ordeal!
The scar from the burn did not heal, even after the ordeal, nothing changed!
If a fire is housed in the heart, can water ever put it off?
If thorns are stitched into eyes, can the eye lids close?
The story of Mahabharata too is a scripture that ended due to revenge!
To flourish, or to die, is decided by nature!
To flourish, or to die, is decided by nature!
after I die, what will live on is the story written by my life (while I was alive)!
If you and I have to flourish, then burn the evil!
If all that is bad has to be destroyed, then sacrifice cruelty!
live life on the principles dictated by Krishna in Bhagavad Gita,
For a young sapling to flourish, removing weeds from the soil is not a sin!
For a young sapling to flourish, removing weeds from the soil is not a sin!
In this end, I search for a new beginning and attempt to write a new story (of my life)!
[Chandirane Suriyane lyrics and translation]

title: [Thiruda Thiruda] Rasathi …
english_stanzas:
Oh Beloved! My breathe is not mine anymore!
Adorning flowers, there she goes having entered into a wedlock!
If you leave, my body will go into soil,
this sad news will reach you by the break of dawn, come!
Oh Beloved! My breathe is not mine anymore!
while sitting on the cemented porch of the house and grinding turmeric for curry,
before grinding the turmeric, you ground my heart,
while washing your kanandaangi saree along the canal running through the forest,
you let the clothes be wet, and wrung out my heart!
you pulled and tied me tight to the plough in the field,
she is leaving having lost her mind!
Wiping her tears in her wedding saree,
she leaves, as the woman of another man!
discarding the jasmines I gave her into the river,
she adorns oleander flowers (known to be poisonous) and leaves crying!
The damsel made a promise thumping on my palm in the groundnut field,
promises made by such women are like writings in air
the little finger which dabbed vermilion and kept the dot on your forehead is still fresh (with the vermilion),
The hands that adorned the marigold on your hair have not even lost their fragrance,
Even the bangles I bought from Madurai are new and unbroken,
Even the turmeric mark on the dhoti is still fresh as new,
when again will I get to see that beautiful mole at the corner of those ears and the back of that neck?
When can it be seen? when will the full moon come again?
When again will I hear the tunes of those anklets and the youthful laughter of the damsel?
when can it be heard? When will the green plant flower? (implying an impossibility)
In the thick of karuvelam forest, a black sparrow
