this is equivalent to drinking the virtuous holy water / being at the place where gods idol is placed (divine place),
to a person who does not bow to the feet of his mother and father,
what is the use of (/ what will he see) going to temple everyday,
will the god (Krishna) give him the boon he prayed for?
having a golden body ( I guess healthy and perfect body), all the materialistic things, owning land,
a chaste wife, children, glory and all the good life associated with the aforesaid,
how did you achieve them without your mother and father,
it is akin to saying that you may be like a mighty huge tree, but without a seed how did you come about?
if not for the seed how would you bear the fruits?

title: [Panjavarnakkili] thamizhukkum amudhendru per…
composer: M S Viswanathan , T K Ramamoorty
english_stanzas:
Tamil is also synonymous with nectar,
Tamil, sweet Tamil, is equivalent to our soul, it is our soul,
Tamil is synonymous with the moon,
this sweet Tamil is the water that nurtures the growth of our society,
Tamil is synonymous with fragrance,
this sweet Tamil is the cornerstone of our lives,
Tamil is synonymous with honey(sweet),
this sweet Tamil is the root that holds together our rights,
Tamil is milk for our youth (that supported the growth of our youth) ,
this sweet Tamil is the weapon (lance (instrument)) for the renowned and good poets,
Tamil is the sky that facilitates our ascent,
this sweet Tamil is the honey that gave vitality back to our tired souls, (or is the medicine to get the spark back into our tired souls)
Tamil is the shoulder that supports our intellect,
this sweet Tamil is the diamond sword (imperishable, sharp) to our poetry,
Tamil is the mother of our birth,
this sweet Tamil is the igniting spark that leads us to prosperity,

title: [Kai Kodutha Deivam] Sindhu nadhiyin misai …
english_stanzas:
Also don’t miss out Bharathi’s idea of connecting rivers of our India, long before the idea emerged as we know it recently 😉
basking in the moonlight along the banks of the Sindhu river,
along with the youthful women from the fine country of Cheras (present day Tamilnadu and Kerala),
composing and singing songs in the beautiful telugu language,
lets row our boats and merrily play together,
lets exchange the products of wheat from the area around Ganges river,
with the beetle leaves from the area around Cauvery,
lets get poems from the brave Marathas,
and gift them back the elephants tusks from the Chera region,
let us build a bridge to the island of Srilanka,
lets raise the level of land covered by Sethusamdram, and build roads from india to Srilanka,
the excess water from the bengal region,
and use it to irrigate (and cultivate) the other areas of our country…

title: [Anjathe] achcham thavir, naiya pudai…
english_stanzas:
don’t loose you manliness, never compromise on your dignity,
shower praise on talented/skilled people, don’t be afraid of evil people,
never compromise on your dignity, don’t fear death,
don’t waste time, don’t be afraid of unethical/wrong people,
learn the art of warfare, in the event of failure don’t breakdown,
embrace (love) new things, increase your power ( strength, virility),
lethargy always spoils, don’t be afraid of the antiquity (do not be afraid to break the status quo and come up with new pathbreaking ideas),
speak with openness and clarity, think good,
eliminate greed and desire for materialistic pleasures; forever, practice (or complete the) penance (meditation),
practice what you learn, revere skilled handicraft,
Being united never fails, don’t be afraid of ghosts,
revere the sun, mantras are potent (so chant them),

title: [Kandukondain Kandukondain] suttum vizhi sudar dhaan …
english_stanzas:
Given that its the valentine’s day week, presenting (one of ) the best ever poem written to the one you love. One instantly falls in love with Kannama :). Only a maverick like Mahakavi can write something so wonderful.
the sparkling light(flame) that adorns and emanates from your eyes, oh Kannamma! , are they the sun and the moon,
your beautiful round black eyes, oh Kannamma!, are as pure as the dark sky,
the silk dark blue sari that you adorn with the exquisitely pure diamonds embedded in them,
are like the stars that sparkle in the middle of night,
the light of the flower that blooms in the garden, is nothing but your beautiful smile,
the beauty of waves in the blue sea, is nothing but the waves in your heart,
the graceful and sweet sound of a koel, is nothing but the sweetness of your voice,
with you, the virgin girl (woman), Oh Kannamma! I am mesmerized and have fallen in love,
you talk about the rules, Oh Kannamma, why do we need these rules?
for people who are impatient (passionate), Oh Kannamma, how can the rules apply?
the rituals of marriage that are done with the consent of elders, can wait ( we can get married later),
how can I wait anymore? look now! I give a kiss on your cheek.

title: [Saraswathi sabatham] Deivam iruppadhu enge?
english_stanzas:
where is it that god resides?

it is here, where else? ( in human’s themselves)
thelindha ninaivum , thirandha nenjum , niraindhadhundo angey,
it resides in the person who has a clear thought ( conscience), an open heart that is content and is filled with all the good things,

the hearts of people who only have all the riches and all material comforts, is like a forest grown on lies,

the hearts of people who are learned, and can think is where god resides,

the dresses, the ornaments, the things which we adorn to flaunt; are not what god likes,

unfocused worship ( by having each of your eyes ( thoughts) focussed on different things) is not considered worship ,

in music, in arts, poetry and child’s language is where the god resides

if one realizes that these are where god lives ( or is god), then god will accept all your offerings,

in people who are thankful, there is god,

in people who do good, there is god,

in people who don’t forget their past (history), there is god,

in people where affection blooms (who care for others), there is god,

god resides here,

title: [Mounam Pesiyadhe] Aadaadha aattamellaam pottavanga…
english_stanzas:
those who danced too much (people who to any extent for personal satisfaction) in the past,
are all gone to the soil (dead), do you know the story of their death?
what is it that you came in with when you were born, what is it that you will take away after your death,
do you understand what is the truth?
no one can claim ownership of “life” here,
those who came and those who will come, are not here to stay forever (every one dies),
you and me are not going to live for 100 years anyways,
we are always in search of numerous materialistic desires, during which we close our eyes and roam around,
we accumulate sins constantly during the course,
we externally appear human, but we live like animals,
we forget that each of our actions will be judged one day (justice will be done one day, all our ill actions will be punished),we keep doing bad deeds,
the time that passed will never return (you cannot go back in time and correct your mistakes), so dont loose track,
we are such susceptible creatures that even if this earth shakes a bit (earth quake), we die (so why this fake life when alive?)
our small dance starts naturally in mothers womb,
when we are in the cradle , the dance continues,
one we attain teenage, we fight for love,
once we fall in love, we are in an inebriated state and dance,
for attaining fame and status , we dance , for getting money , we do multiple dances,
but once you are dead, and carried by 4 people ( 8 legs ) to the graveyard, the world dances for your departure!

title: [Saraswathi sabatham] kalviya selvama veerama?
english_stanzas:
is it education? wealth? bravery? that is the most important
it is like asking if mother? father? or god? that are the most important
without one how can the other begin ( or exist) ?
then, where is the separation about is more important ?
for the scholars (educated people), without wealth how will their hunger satiate?
for the wealthy, without intellect ( which comes by education), how will they become famous?
even if one is learned, or has all the wealth, does it lead to strength?
if you don’t have bravery, then is such a life worth living?
do all the ideas or ideals of learned people,  get accepted or lead to accolades?
how can the ideas or ideals of creator, be rejected?
whether it is the learned or the creator,
if they also possess bravery, then is there any one comparabe to them?
each of these qualities are intertwined and began within each other,
they all are meaningful only when taken together,
if each of them detests the other, where is progress or elevation?
if all of them are at a place, then what is comparable to its power?
so do you want wealth that will last the next 3 generations?
or do you want a powerful intellect that will be remembered and revered till the end of time?
or do you need the strength that will send shivers down the enemy who opposes you?
or do you need the goodness that comes with help of all three qualities?

title: [Avanthaan manidhan] manidhan ninaipadhundu…
english_stanzas:
A sad song, for pondering 🙂

“this life is permanent”,
god thinks ( to this thought of human),
“I am sorry for humans”,
father committed a mistake,
mother also co conspired and gave room for it,
as a result we were born,
all we did was grow our relationships,
my heart is beating in pain,
what is the gain in crying?
its all by the rule of god ( we just dance to his tunes).
if your heart ( intellect) is an untamed forest,
then worries easily grow in it,
if you open the cage (open up to new ideas, ideals, experiences etc.),
the bird (worry) will fly away,
all we do is tie shackles to our own legs,
we term it as “duty”,
with our “tied” legs, we are trying to dance,
in the chariot of “fate”, we travel speedily (hastily),
my intellect is dizzy, my small heart is crying,
I don’t have anything to give, my confusion came to an end,
I finished the calculation, my worry is over now,

title: [En pondatti nallava] ponnukkula thodangiyadhu….
english_stanzas:
what started inside a women (human life begins in a women’s womb), finds rest in soil ( when cremated)! oh knowledgeable people!
in it why this sorrow, why this remorse, what is the use in blaming people! oh knowledgeable people!
this body is itself not perfect with all holes ( our values, beliefs etc have flaws), why then is this craze to amass wealth and power,
birth, death; both are natural and routine, so why become emotional (cry) for them,
Oh look! all we have is this 6 feet of body, once it rests ( dies) there are no problems it creates ( all the vices/fights that we make when alive, vanish when we die),
All the classes that we separate people into ( as some body being superior/ inferior), are applicable only till you are alive,
all the calculations that the human mind makes, is not valid now ( after death),
this life is a game in which the mind is a monkey; it does not listen to what is said,
it wanders around here and there.
two people ( your parents) bring you here, now four people’s shoulders carry you back,
what the knowledgeable saints said then, is understandable to my intellect now,
the liquor that I drank, had all the intellect, because of which I too got it automatically,
I am hiding the tears that come in my eyes (due to your death), and dancing in the street

title: [Manamulla Marudhaaram] Inbam enge inbam enge endru thedu …
song: Inbam enge inbam enge endru thedu …
english_stanzas:
Want to know what true happiness is? listen to this and find out 🙂
constantly keep seeking happiness, pro-actively keep looking for it,
where ever it may be, go seek it,
people who are here today, are gone tomorrow ( everyone dies some day),
what is the use of ignoring (not understanding) this fact and amassing and protecting materialistic objects (wealth)?
until we are alive, we should inculcate the ability to enjoy all the good things (which make us happy),
else in your lifetime you will never see happiness,
drinking sweet juices, alcoholic drinks and spending time is not happiness,
the pleasure derived with the help of young women is not happiness,
your incomparable wife’s sweet words are the true happiness,
the smile that comes out of her mouth is the limitless happiness,
having multi-storey houses, crores of rupees, vehicles, are just unnecessary pride;
they do not give a person true happiness ( is not a true sign of happiness),
listening to the sweet voice and ramblings of your children,
and the way they kick (play) on your chest (shoulders) is the true happiness,

title: [Edhir neechal] vetri vendumaa pottu paarada edhir neechal
song: vetri vendumaa pottu paarada edhir neechal
english_stanzas:
do you want success?, swim against the tide ( depicted metaphorically to mean battle against tumultuous times) ( hard work, do things differently, smartly),

to attribute all your actions to fate and not doing what you truly want to do, is a big problem (irritating),

if you act bravely, carefully calculating all your moves; then what is it that is impossible?

if you put a bit of effort, there is nothing that you cannot get.

for the mother who bears her child,

the ten months of pregnancy is a swim against the tide ( battle against tumultuous times),

once the child is born, until the time it learns to walk,

leaving it ( putting) on the floor is a swim against the tide,

once the child grows a bit, finding/admitting to a suitable school

is another hard time for the father,

even after the child gets an admission,

when the examinations come then its again a time to swim against the tide,

to work hard for a handful of rice, so as to fulfill the foot long stomach we have,

is a swim against the tide,

to fight claiming ownership for a handful of land,

is a swim against the tide,

to not get entrapped in the 8 feet of mud (to die),

and cheating death is a swim against the tide,

if you actually look at the way we live our lives (do the balance sheet of life),

till the end , all we do is to swim against the tide.

title: [Guna] Appanendrum ammaiyendrum…
english_stanzas:
this body that we don, is nothing but piled up waste that a man and woman who took the role of father and mother produced,
oh virtuous women, this body is just a byproduct,
how is it that it can transform into becoming the buddha, or the sages, or the madman, (intriguing)
finally just like the chaff of the sugarcane (bagasse) that remains after all the juice is extracted from sugarcane, similarly you will also be drained of all your life and become dead(waste) one day,
oh virtuous women, only the baggasse will remain of the sugarcane,
our bodies have fallen into the marsh of relationships, love etc,
where should one go to wash off the stains due to it , ( just like people go the Ganges river to wash off their sins, where do I go to wash off the stains due to falling into the marsh of relationships, love etc)
who among us has not committed mistakes or not born with limitations? ( all of us have our own limitations and mistakes),
nobody is pure, we are all just sacks filled with sins,
this society ( people) will even speak of lord Shiva too as being a madman,
all these ignorant mindless people, don’t have the vision of knowledge,
people from the beginning to the end who your own, or are your relatives will stay so only till you exist,
all these relations come together, play together, separate; all this is just a trade market where people just fulfilling their own desires and aspirations,
in this what are you, what am I ?
whether people come or go, don’t mind, just stay detached and move on,
the reason why we came here, with these hands, legs and nose is to dance(play),
we should dance ( play), so that we can clean (clear) all the sins that we have accumulated,
oh human! you dance (play) and run around, what you don’t realize is that with all the dance(play) you are accumulating sins,
but then who realizes this (no one objects to not dance (play) and run away)?
your mind ( which acts like a monkey) , always runs around offtrack and is always restless,
you can always control this monkey, if you put it in the cage of salvation and knowledge,
if the heart does not dance around (play) or stoop,
and as you gain more knowledge all the ignorance will go away.

title: [Lee] yaaru yaaru netru saadhichadhu yaaru
english_stanzas:
who were the achievers of yesterday?

they were people like you and me!

this earth is nothing but a stone,

without the sweat of many people , how can flowers bloom in it,

( all the good things we see are due to the collective hard work of many people)

the sweat from our forehead should fall down on the lap of this earth (we should work hard),

then, not only in the sky , but even on this earth you will see the sun rise ( with hard work, there is a bright and prosperous future),

all the setbacks(disgrace) you go through now, will act as supplements for your victory in the future,

one can even fight against the mighty mountains, if one turns him self into the cloud ( the rain from clouds can erode even the mighty mountains),

one can live even with fire, if he turns himself into the ritual of worshipping fire, ( one can live through bad times in life, by adapting to situations)

the electric wires across electric poles (which are supposedly dangerous), are nothing but a nice swing for the birds,

we should start to love thorns ( hardships), let us extend this world,
we can take on any invincible power, and with more happiness achieve heights,

we can go on a procession even on roads made of broken glass,

even in the event of a wild(erratic) flow of the stream, we can cross it speedily,

what we need is a new self confidence, with it your hands (you) will win,

victory does not differentiate you based on your caste/creed/color,

the chairman of UN ( Kofi Annan) is a none other than the son of a black race,

title: [Annamalai] vetri nichayam ….
english_stanzas:
success is certain, this is the truth of the vedas,
“My Ideals will win”, this is the goal that I have
if you respect me, I will save you at the cost of giving my life,
if you stamp on me, I will see that one of the two of us survives ( I will make sure you learn a lesson)
oh my friend, I am telling the truth,
don’t challenge me, I am sure to win over you,
till my stature grows monumental ( like the himalayas), I will not die,
the sun may sleep ( set), but my eyes will never sleep,
Without the rain of sweat (hard work) , the flowers of success will not shower,
till I reach the goal, my body will not be destroyed even if you burn me ( I will not stop, no matter what)
in every seed, there is a hidden tree,
every sunrise (morning) will chant my name from now on,
money and praise are blinding your eyes,
what ever shame I went through today, it will make me win accolades later ( will instill the feeling to win, failure is the steeping stone to success),
the sky may come down, but my self respect will not go down,
without up’s and down’s, where is happiness in life?
if the boulders are not there , where is the music in the water falls?
falsehood, deceit may be your ancestors,
blood, sweat are my mainstay,
in my walk your army will be down to pieces,

title: [Kamal kavidhai] grahanaadhi grahanangal…
english_stanzas:
I am told, that somewhere beyond all the planets, there is an invincible power (God),
although there are numerous accounts(in the literature) of this power, no one knows (understands) it yet,
it seems you don’t have a choice other than to dread it, feel it , and sing praises of it,
it seems that all the ill (bad things) that we do(or go through) now, is due to “fate” and a consequence of past karma ( in previous birth),
and people who try to challenge their “fate”, shall be (lovingly) taught a lesson (brought down by inflicting pain/damage) through deceit,
it seems this holy power seeds the wombs with the blind, deaf, infertile , handicapped ,
(if god is all powerful and truly running this world, why are deaf, blind, infertile and handicapped people born, is he so heartless)
why do dreaded diseases like leprosy, cancer, stomach ailments, piles exist, are all this its work? ( when it is unhappy with you),
even if the worm that lives in wounds does good deeds, it seems it will be blessed with a better/new life (rebirth as a better organism?),
the wealthy are not made to suffer much, they are let off after having  tested them for some time by this power and made to reach their goal,
however the hardships and the turmoil that poor people go through is just being witnessed by this power (to no avail), its projected that  it is a usual drama (game) played by this power so that these people worship it more.
it seems that every things that ever happened, is happening, or will happen is by the will of this power, even the wars that are being fought  are its acts,
this power gave power to all the evil kings (who killed innumerable lives) that were glorified by poets in the past and protected them when they were doing all the damage, ( what kind of a power is this?)
among 40 million sperms, only one sperm wins (gets life) and fertilizes the egg, ( how can life be so unfair if it is run by this just power that we call god),
this power is portrayed as the one which killed all the evil forces in the world, is it also the reason why now we are able to break open atoms and make atomic bombs (are all these too its grace?),
all the innocent people who are living in the farlands ( I think referring to the srilankan tamil genocides) were killed and eaten as snacks by this power (what was this power doing when these innocent lives were killed?),
on the contrary, to disciples who killed their own sons to feed this power, it graced them with boons, it is truly the ultimate power (sarcastically) ( referring to Chiruthonda Nayanar)
Since your parents, your relatives  your teachers are all preaching and forcing their belief on you, go on and start  worshipping this power just as they do,
do it for the fear they have instilled in you about this power, even though you haven’t seen it, start firmly believing that it exists,
as was sermoned to you, immerse yourself in ponds ( and let go of your toxins)  to wash off all your sins, get you mind laundered  with the existence of this power,
let the worship begin by beating the drums and ringing the bells, also do  the camphor ritual
however remember that, you were given a needle  to stitch your clothes which were torn at revealing places(solve problems in earth) , instead don’t go on to use it to adorn the carpet ( which is of no value, only ornamental value)(referring to god worship),
however if you don’t want to hear all this and want to still focus on stitching the carpet instead of focusing on your self, then please go ahead (once you see the disappointments of your thoughts you will realise)

title: [Naan kadavul] Pichai paathiram yendhi vandhen…
english_stanzas:
No Words to depict this beauty! listen and ponder!
I have come with the begging bowl, oh my father (referring to god),
I have come with this begging bowl, oh my father
This begging bowl is a lump made of flesh, bones, nerves,
and blood, together as the body,
(The human (material) body is depicted as a begging bowl which the soul carries)
was this bowl (body) given by my mother and father,
or is it a product of all my past karma (misdeeds from the beginning of time),
I don’t understand (the reason for) my current birth,
I stand here like a small puppet, trying to know the truth,
all the treasures are with you,
where else shall I go to beg,
(you gave me this body (begging bowl), so that I can reach you (where all riches are))
All I have is just the bowl ( can also be interpreted as I am just playing a role(in a drama)),
the secret(reason) for it is only known to you,
not once, not twice,
you have made me take innumerable (different) births,
is it for my present misdeeds, or my past misdeeds,
that every moment that I live you are making me suffer,
this meaningless life which is constantly in search of materialistic desires is haunting me,
the heart that is begging for your grace is blabbering today,
look at me with your graceful eyes,
support me with your flower like feet,
let your holy hands embrace me and bless me,

title: [Mayakkam enna] Ennena seithom ingu….
english_stanzas:
what all have we done here (on earth) till now in our lives,
where all have we gone, in the name(pretext) of destiny,
our eyes carry the sorrow that we never saw (we even worry in anticipation of difficulties, which never occurred to us),
our hearts(minds) are constantly wavering,
Oh God, I think about this sometimes,
I (have) come in search of you (seeking answers to these confusions),
in your temple will this wavering (of the mind) be won over ( show me the truth), oh god,
please show me your loving smile,
kill me(amaze) with your beautiful gaze,
aren’t you and me the same? you are giving me the answers,
are you just a stone? “you wipe people’s tears” – is it false?
if one imbibes you in with all his heart(with deep devotion), you make him reach the shore (final destination),
what is the meaning of this life?
what harm is it if we live it to its full and see?
why is it that we keep making stories, kill the fear ?
is it that the might of the morning rising sun,
and the chirping of the birds are telling us something?
your empire is a huge forest,
in which this earth is just a small nest,
if we embrace you and stand with our melted hearts,
even the burning fire will seem like a caress in joy,
searching for you, people relentlessly roam around not knowing that you are within each one of them,
are you the womb (which gives life) or are you in the enormity of the waves of ocean,
one group of people climb hills in search of you,
another group dips in the river in search of you,
we falsely follow people who profess such things,
however we forget the compassion of our great mother,
who made us see things and make us realize you (god) even in stones.

title: [Ezhavathu Manithan] Kakkai siraginile nanda laala…
english_stanzas:
In the wings of crow, oh lord,
all I see is your ebony complexion, oh lord,
In all the trees that I see around me, oh lord,
all I see is your green complexion, oh lord,
In all the sounds that I hear, oh lord,
all I hear is the resonating melody of you, oh lord,
when I keep my fingers into fire, oh lord,
all I can feel is the ecstasy of your touch, oh lord

title: [Aandavan kattalai] Amaidhiyaana nadhiyinile oodum…
composer: M S Viswanathan and T K Ramamoorthy
english_stanzas:
The boat moves on (functions properly) in a silent(serene) river,
however if there is a limitless flood, it shakes ( turbulent and capsizes),
(we humans are fine when things are going well, but when a catastrophe (bad time) strikes we get shaken and fall down)
if during huge winds, lashing rains and in heavy thunder,
the boat stays at the shore, then it will live,
(if during bad times, we stay at the shore ( take no risks, or pray god etc) , we will go through the bad phase and good times will come back)
the same breeze that gently lullabies the leaves of the coconut tree,
can bring down the coconut tree, when it turns into a storm,
( the coconut tree can boast as being mighty etc , but when a storm strikes it goes down)
however there is the Hardy Sugar Cane grass(naanal),which is found in the river bank, ( it is a small plant known to withstand the severest of storms)
it does not go down on any storm, in the same way a matured mind never sulks and remains unaffected by major catastrophes’.
( naanal may seem a small plant ( compared to the mighty coconut tree) but it can withstand any amount of storm)
women and naanal are but the same things (they are strong/mature),
they also have the softness that will build a cradle in the breeze,
anything which falls in the dusk, will rise back in the morning (up’s and down’s are a part of life),
with the language of love, all the worries will vanish.

title: [Simla Special] Unakkenna mele nindrai….
english_stanzas:
what is for you! Oh god! you are the one standing in the top,
I am singing (living) according to your commands, for a long time now!
we were born in the lap of our mother, we grew up in the lap of Tamil,
we blossomed as actors, we became a part of the drama (of life)
(This world is nothing but a drama and we are all actors in it playing our parts)
there is no stage where we have not danced, there is no act that we haven’t donned,
there is no tear that we haven’t shed, there has been no dearth of laughter.
we humans,who are dancing with our legs, are mere puppets with strings,
oh god! (do) you hold those strings and make us dance to your tunes(?),
we falsely believe many people to be our friends, and get cheated by them,
we see thorns as flowers and fail to comprehend (and stand confused),
both toddy(a liquor, associated with intoxication and evil) and milk(associated with good, purity) are similar to look at,
am I toddy or milk, tell me oh god!

title: [Thaai Sollai Thattathe] Poyum poyum manidhanukkindha…
english_stanzas:
god (being the supreme), unfortunately gave human this thing called “brain”(intellect),
using which he (human) is spoiling this world,
human, is spoiling this world!
both the eyes would carry grace,
in what he preaches, there will be a thousand meanings,
but his heart is filled with lies,
which will break all relationships ( including your own siblings)
god kept the atrocity (ferocity) of a roaring lion,
in its eyes (i.e you can know the ferocity of a lion by looking at its eyes),
but the qualities of this spoilt human, he hid in the blanket of the heart,
(it is impossible to understand a person’s true feelings by his appearance alone, lots of things are concealed in the heart)
human puts his hand on your shoulder ( like a friend),
he terms it as his kindness,
he keeps on searching for something,
what ever his finds , he takes it and runs away!

title: [Malai kallan] ethanai kaalam dhan ematruvaar indha naatile…
song: ethanai kaalam dhan ematruvaar indha naatile…
english_stanzas:
for how long will these people (politicians, bureaucrats) cheat us in this country,
in our own country, in our country,
All of them act as though they don’t deter from the path of truth,
but they all look for the right time (opportunity) and loot in various(novel) ways,
they put on false acts as a disciple,
and they cheat the common people but get them entangled in their cruel web,
and make sure there is no one is uneducated,
let there be no hunger(poverty) in the society,
Let us all vow to build one house each,
in it lets learn dedicatedly (in the right way) all the arts that we can,
instead of wasting days by ridiculing others and killing time,
lets us ask more questions , and combine it with knowledge and move ahead

title: [Aayutha Ezhuthu] Jana gana mana…
english_stanzas:
For the youth , oh Yuva ,Yuva!
Think about the people (masses) , as in our national anthem,
for your dreams to succeed , your actions will support (work hard),
Let the light be your path,
Let the mountains be your stepping stones,
Let all your rivalries vanish,
Take up arms and shoot down your arrogance,
Take the fire and burn the evil,
let the darkness be burnt down,
establish a new order by reducing the divide between the “living as poor” and “living a good life”,
break out the shackles of law and defeat the plans of all conspirators,
the wind that enters the jungles,
If a thousand youth dare ( to do something),
there is no need of weapons,
Let go of all the fear, focus on achieving your goals,
let go of all differences, focus on achieving success,
oh my friend, keep fighting!
Just like river can pave its way even through the mountains, you too command your forces
such that a glorious success/victory is guaranteed,
If all the good men move away from the problem,
the jackals(bad men) shall become the leaders and wreck havoc,
if the youth take to the swords, the earth shall spin back in the right direction,
Let us make a fate (order) that will change fate,

title: [Yen] Iraivan endroru kavinyan…
english_stanzas:
The beauty of lyrics is fantastic… by the way notice SPB’s voice (in his early days)… correct me if my interpretation is wrong in some places….
The poet named “God” ( God is depicted as a poet),
his created poem are we “Humans”,
among his creations are also the ignorant, the blind,
but the beginning and the end are the same (all the differences we human’s create among us is of no use, finally all our beginnings and ends are the same),
Among god’s creation are the poems ( normal human’s),
and also epic songs like “Gandhi”,
also there exist story’s which are incomprehensible and unending,
there are also creations which are finished compulsively,
(get the link between how a poet’s different creation is compared with different kinds of people)
he began with the eye and ended it with the eye,
what was born with the woman he gave it back the woman,( I think it refers to “Love” referred to as being born in women, and the manifestation of love, “new life” ( children) being borne by women)
what ever happened on the soil ( earth), he gave it back to the soil ( I think it refers to birth and death)
a poet’s birth is right from the womb,
the gift of time ( Poets creations become immortal) is the speciality of the poem,
Good imagination is the creation of god,
but then the poet thinks that he has won over god,

title: [Paadum vaanambadi] vaazhum varai poaraadu
english_stanzas:
Until you live keep on fighting , keep singing (thinking) that there is always a way (to greener times),
today we may be on streets, but tomorrow ( in the future) we will be in our house ( reach our destination),
there will be rain (good times) in our forest (lives),
In rich houses even the windows are wearing clothes (screen),
in slums small children are naked ( no clothes to wear),
always my song will rule this world,

title: [Oomai Vizhigal] nilaimaarum ulagil …
english_stanzas:
In this world, that constantly changes state (Ever changing world),
thinking (dreaming) that everything will persist,
We human’s live,
In doing so, justice doesnt exist
For a poor person, the main dream for him is that he gets food every day,
In such a state of mind (where getting a square meal a day itself is a dream), where is the time (or effort) to think about a new beginning/pursuing new fruitful things in life,
When a human is born, the one who does not die
(here the poet hints that for the poor who don’t die immediately after birth (and have to face this cruel world))
For those people, living itself is a curse,
and is the misdeeds of his ancestors…

title: [Karnan] Ullathil Nalla ullam urangadhenbadhu…
english_stanzas:
The nicest (best) among souls never fades (they stand the test of time and live forever),
this is the rule devised by god,
Hence, oh Karna, get ready to face what(ever) is coming your way (fate),
you are not the son of your mother, ( Karna’s mother Kunti devi deserted him early)
you are not an elder brother to your siblings, (He went to against his brothers , The pandavas)
you took the blame for this world,
I (Krishna) too shall bear your sins (since Krishna too played a role in deceiving Karna by disguising as a Brahman and asking his virtues as donation in the War  )
(Refers to how unlucky Karna was)
The ones who get crowned as kings (Karna),
he (Krishna) is ready to serve you (for the crowning ceremony),
he (Krishna) bows to you ( since the king is the symbol of dharma),
To repay the debt to the person who fed you, (referring to Karna taking the side of Kauravaas),
you took the side of the people who are not right (Kauravaas),

title: [Ashok kumar] bhoomiyil maanida jenmam adaindumor…
english_stanzas:
Inspite of being born as human on this earth (supposed to be a superior birth),
we don’t live a virtuous( meritorious)  life , instead we live like animals,
Unwantedly (unfortunately), lust and anger are filled in our hearts,
we kill time ( as time passes we go down),
Due to the  deeds of virtuous and ideal noble human’s,
we are all blessed to be born and living in this world,
The one who is an embodiment of truth, knowledge, and treasure house of compassion,
is Lord Buddha , and to  revere (pray) to  him is our duty,
If we don’t live on the principles of truth, love for all living creatures and nonviolence ,

then this human birth is a burden for earth, just like a load bearing dead tree. It is a low creature

title: [Varumayin Niram Sivappu] Nalladhor veenai seidhe …
english_stanzas:
having made a wonderful veena (a musical instrument),
would the creator(of the veena) throw it in dirt to spoil (in negligence),
Tell me, oh goddess,
you created me with sparkling intelligence (human is the wonderful veena that god created and the poet says how can the god see us go down and he asks god to empower us),
empower me with the strength and skill,
so that I can live for the betterment of this society (earth),
Tell me, oh goddess,
will you let me off to live as a burden to this earth?
Just like a ball with force (speed),
let my body be so strong and nimble that it can accomplish anything that my mind directs it to,
I ask for a mind that has no desires (untarnished),
I ask for a soul that constantly emanates new light (renewed positive energy) (like a gem),
even if my materialistic body is engulfed by fire (death),
give me the longevity to keep on singing your praise, my goddess,
I ask for unshakable wisdom,
(Oh goddess) All that I ask you, I hope you don’t have a problem is granting it to me!
Another wonderful music composition by ilaiyaraaja

title: [Bharathi] ninnai charanadaindhen…
english_stanzas:
Addicted to Bharathi Songs…. Presenting for your Pleasure, get ready to dwell in magic!!
I surrender unto you,
oh beloved (the ultimate truth),
I surrender unto you,
I (human) desire (long) for gold (riches), status, fame,
I (human) desire (long) for gold (riches), status, fame,
let all these numerous worries (desires) not eat me up,
cowardice and fear have spread through my heart,
cowardice and fear have spread through my heart,
these feelings have made my heart their home, In order to kill and permanently remove them from my heart,
Let my quest (suffering) end here for what I deem as my tasks (leads to excessive pride/resentment due to the attachment we develop to things),
instead I will do (them as) your tasks (what you have destined for me), and attain fulfillment,
There will be no more sorrow, no more exhaustion (desperation), no more defeats,
I don’t know to differentiate the good and the bad (evil), I don’t know , I don’t know,
let morality (righteousness) grow in  me by means of love,

please ensure that the good prevails and the evil perishes

title: [Aayirathil Oruvan] unnai naan sandhithen…
english_stanzas:
you are one among a thousand,
I gave myself (to you),
you are the god of my temple,
your body is “gold”,
your heart is like that of a small child,
I measured you based on your “eye”,
with your touch I bloomed,
you are a great donor ( by your heart), you are the leader of poor,
with my thoughts I followed you,
I engulfed your heart like the creeper,
I was eager to say it that day,
but I hid it due to my shyness,
oh king, if I marry you I will be happy

title: [kavalai illaadha manidhan] kavalai illaadha manidhan ….
english_stanzas:
The human with no worries,
The person who has understood the world, and who is brave,
is the human with no worries,
The one who doesn’t mourn about what left (one looses),
The one who doesn’t get hypnotized (too excited) with what came,
one who staunchly follows truth, one whose hands don’t shiver ( fearless, is firm in his thoughts and actions),
the one who has understood the truth and the lie,
This life is but a drama,
where one thousand people came and left,
no body took anything with them (when they died),
what people gave (in terms of ideals, values etc.) when they went (died) is forgetten,
this drama is not yet finished,
when it recurs again tomorrow, no one realises,
The one who realises life is the voluptuary,
the saint is the one who dreads living (life),
the one who sheds tears is a fool,
the one who wins time is brave,
make relationships that give you good happiness,

title: [Kavalai Illatha Manithan] pirakkumbodhum alugindraai…
english_stanzas:
When you are born, you cry,
When there is death, you cry,
why do humans forget to be happy, without worrying even for one day?
human’s have become so pessimistic that they say the tears of the night are the dew droplets,
and the tears of the clouds are the rain drops ( Human’s look at everything negatively)
if  nature weeps (rains), this world prospers ( fostering growth etc),
when human’s cry, nature laughs,
Living in the hands of mother is pleasure,
leaning on a women’s (wife/lover) shoulder  is also pleasure,
But when one realises( understands) himself, that is  “true pleasure”,
and when one forgets his selfishness, that is magnanimous pleasure

title: [Alagiya tamil magan] Ellaa pugalum oruvan oruvanukke….
english_stanzas:
Singer and Music director
Come to the front!
you can do it , my friend!
All the fame (praise) is only for the one ( god),
you keep on flowing ( running/moving) like the river,
for your sweat (hardwork) , success is guaranteed ( rooted),
Truth will act as the filter of your heart!
Oh friend, come to the front,
you can do it,
you are the supreme commander,
oh beloved leader, success is definite for us,
you are the handsome son of Tamil,
Don’t waste your present (today), thinking about your tomorrow ( future),
Don’t forget that only whatever you sow today will sprout (reap benefits) tomorrow ( in the future),
how can one forget/leave justice by brooding on the injuries of the past,
what is justice?, what is pain? only god knows , so leave it for him to decide and you move on.
If a student put’s his heart , there is nothing impossible,
Just like the ocean, mountain, air , earth, you too bring glory!
We were born, we lived, we died,
throw away such an attitude ( live life with a purpose)

title: [Nool veli] mounathil vilayaadum manasatchiye…
english_stanzas:
Oh Conscience, you are the one who plays with(in) silence,
you are the one who becomes a thousand thoughts,
you are the one who becomes the enjoyable dream,
you are the one who becomes the tear in the eye when something (task) goes wrong,
you are a secret tunnel,
you are the stage where (Life’s) drama unfolds,
you are the place where trials (hardships) happen,
oh heart you are the mother of sorrow too,
for being wrong at a moment,
you repent for it for ages (a long time),
The eyes spill (tears) the definition of silence,
for truth you are the only one witness,
for telling false you are one of the many witnesses,
the heart is the shadow of  thoughts!
you become a stone when filled with desires,
you become like wax when filled with fear,
whose ever face you see,
you become restless with doubt.

title: [Dharmam thalai kaakum] Oruvan manadhu onbadhada…
english_stanzas:
If one’s heart has nine things, (Can be interpreted as one’s heart being an eunuch, lost in identity),
In it is hidden eighty things, ( which means that our hearts are filled with many unwanted feeling and thoughts although we seem to be not so sophisticated)
Only god goes beyond external appearance and see’s (feels) the heart,
When one climbs (goes up in life/ is successful), he is filled with selfishness , jealousy to others etc,
When one falls (goes down in life/ experiences failure), he laughs,
When the time is to live, he moves around (comes),
When one experiences poverty, he breaks away,
One forgets the glory of mother,
he falls is the marsh of self focus (selfishness),
he protects money like a demon,
he does not follow the ideals of forefathers, instead ridicules them,

title: [Bommai] neeyum bommai naanum bommai
english_stanzas:
You are a puppet, I am also a puppet,
If you think about it, everything/everyone is a puppet!
In the lap of a mother , her child is a puppet,
in front of a leader, his party-men are puppets,
the idol in the temple is a puppet,
all the people who worship it are puppets,
to the skill-full master ( in a manipulative sense), the good guys are puppets,
in front of  “haves”,  the “have-nots” are puppets,
the person who works day-night is a puppet,
the person who always worries and walks around is a puppet,
In the eye of  destiny, all living creatures are puppets,
for the storm, the world is a puppet,
In front of enjoyment, your duties are a puppet,
For the forthcoming “death” , life is a puppet,
In the arms of love, all of us are puppets,
in the sweet words, the brain becomes a puppet,
in the forest of joy, nature is a puppet,
in the  law of nature everything is a puppet.

title: [Rambayin Kadhal] Samarasam ulavum idame….
english_stanzas:
the place where “equality” is prevalent,
which none of us get to see during our life times,
caste discrimination , where the high class are considered elite,
the low caste and considered sinners ,
these differences are not there in the grave yard!
all of us finally reach this forest(ground)!
This is the house, where all of us sleep without any worries!
In this world, this is the place where equality is prevalent (which we dont see during our lifetime)
The beggar finally comes here, the king also finally comes here
the intellectual finally comes here , the fool also finally comes here
once your soul leaves ( you die) , people gather here,
hence this is the place where equality reigns!
the  person who helps others and sacrifices, the person who enjoys all the pleasures of this life,
The yogi who reaches for the foot ( blessings) of God,
all these people sleep here together, and hence its the only place where equality reigns!

title: [Suryakanthi] Paramasivan kazhuthil irundhu paambu kettadhu…
english_stanzas:
From the neck of Lord Shiva, the snake asked the eagle “are you doing fine?”.
(Lord Shiva’s neck is adorned with a snake, here the snake is in a safe place (Shiva’s neck) and is questioning (in a teasing tone) the eagle (traditionally, its arch enemy) about its well-being)
The eagle replies, “If everyone stays in their designated (rightful) place, then everything will be fine”, there is a (deeper) meaning in what the eagle said.
When you are in a high position then this world will respect you,
however when your status reduces a bit , then your own shadow will stamp you.
Don’t enter the house of a person who does not respect you,
this was told by Avvai to the man with self-respect,
there is a deeper meaning in what Avvai said.
For a vehicle to run, two wheels are necessary,
if one of them is smaller , then how can the vehicle run,
one should limit his relationship like you,
if people in high status and low status are involved in a relationship,
it leads to humiliation, there is a deeper meaning in it .
You and me lived like the moon and the sky,
I eroded like the moon (faded away) since you ( the sky) grew,
When one’s conscience (heart) see’s oneself and teases,
where is peace in the family life of the have-not,
this is what the husband said, it has a deeper meaning to it.

title: [Unnal Mudiyum Thambi] Akkam Pakkam Paaradaa ….
english_stanzas:
Beautiful song…. so much to learn from it … seems so relevant now 🙂
tell me what is the vision of the sky ( emphasis on having a broad vision).
what are you doing with your mouth, are you chanting hymns?
is your heart just a machine (nonreactive , unemotional, mundane )?
the child is speaking to the god ( worshiping idol, chanting hymns),
but  the mother’s cry seems to be unheard! ( emphasizing that today’s man has become so ignorant of people’s suffering and is focused on praying god (idols) etc)
“mother , hungry” (begging, poverty, hunger etc) this seems to be the national language now ( emphasizing the rampant poverty all around),
political parties are raising their flags there, but here the mud pot ( to cook porridge) is on the streets ( emphasizing that people are busy playing politics than to think about people)
In this independent nation, there is a dearth even with the basic need of “food”,
don’t  keep chanting the names of gods only (emphasizing the need for action),
our land is always considered as the nation that did the most charity, ( so share your wealth with others in terms of charity)
This nation has done a lot of things for you,
in return ask yourself and tell, what you did for the nation?
You seem to be insensitive and walk away from (bad) issues happening around, since it does not directly affect you,
if the nation is on fire , how can only your house be saved ( these lines emphasize that one should do something about the issues facing the nation and not be insensitive to it , since our welfare is contingent on the nation’s welfare)

title: [Babu] idho endhan deivam munnaaley….
english_stanzas:
here is my God!, in front of me,
I saw it in the single smile (of you),
“God” lives in the hearts of the kind,
“God” is every where , he is in the fragrance and beauty of the blooming flowers,
he is in the sweet voice of the nightingale,
he is in the cold cloud that rains and quenches the thirst,
he is in the sweetness of fruits,
The knowledge you gained by reading numerous books,
The money (riches) you gave (donated) for the good of people,
The happiness  you feel in other’s progress,
in all these deeds is “God”,
The poor who lives his life on the basis of his sweat and hardwork,
he goes to work and raises himself,
I heard his heartwarming laughter,
in his laughter I saw “God”.

title: [Jai Hind] Thaayin manikkodi thaayin mannikodi solludhu jaihind……
song: Thaayin manikkodi thaayin mannikodi solludhu jaihind……
english_stanzas:
our motherland’s flag ( referring to as mothers necklace) tells us “Jai Hind”,
to protect our motherland, and unite ( removing our ego’s and selfishness), tell(shout) “Jai Hind”,
This is my country “India”, this nation has shed a lot of blood,
this holy nation has been home to great souls like Gandhi,
we may be of different colors, but our thoughts (ideals) are one,
there may be many birds (citizens), but the sky is jut one (nation)
our bodies may be different, but our blood is one,
we may speak many different languages, but our nation is one
if you come to us with flowers , we are a virtuous ( full of good deeds) nation,
if you come to us with swords (for war), we will take your heads,
our country’s history has seen both our blood and tears,
we have risen out of fire,
for all the people who sacrificied their heads for our country,
we bow to them and offer our first prayers,
wont our system(government) get a new speed,
only when there is speed will there be victory
wont our soil harbour the birth of new energy,
only when there is energy, history will be made,
Take the system(government) in your stride and burn down all the ills,
if something is not fine, remove it from the roots,
rise like a tiger, spread like a storm,
young blood is not fake,
we have to write(script) a new India,
to all the protectors of our freedom,
we offer our first prayers,

title: [Naan potta savaal] nenje un aasai yenna…
english_stanzas:
oh heart, what is your desire?

If your thoughts are strong there is nothing impossible ( you canachieveanything that you think),

this earth , and the sky,

bear the brunt of the lightning ( similarly you too can bear any amount of hardships and still come outsuccessful)

search for truth, search for accomplishments,

sing about your elevated state in all the 8 directions.

the sea ( that constantly roars) , never stops,

after seeing this how can your heart and eyes sleep,

the breathe just got stuck to us, when we run its gone ( if you are a coward you loose your life)

what do you loose anyways , whats wrong in it?

if you are a sculptor or holding some talent (referring to 2 important people in tamil history?), then you can become a hero( one who has renounced for the world’s good),

if one has good thoughts, and has a lot of motivation , then victory isdefinite.

title: [Marupadiyum] ellorukkum nalla kaalam undu…
english_stanzas:
For all of us ,  good times are guaranteed in our lives,
even for the “have-nots” ,  bad times will change and progress is guaranteed in this world.
why do we dwell in unwanted questions and unattainable dreams,
your day will come, all things will be in your hand’s reach . So, why do you unwantedly suffer now?
believe  in a better tomorrow,
On our earth, all we souls have innumerable desires,
not one but more than thousands of needs,
who decides if  our thoughts turn into  a reality?
God and his will is the one which finally finishes it all,

[Alternate meaning: One who can turn his thoughts into action / reality,

Can achieve anything in this world!

(Nothing is impossible for the clear minded people)]
so believe and trust in the one thing -GOD-.

title: [Ninaithale Inikkum] shambo shiva shambo…
english_stanzas:
greetings to the god shiva (mainly used in the context of “god of joy”),
this world is your space ( what you make out of your ability), being happy and effortless is the secret of it,
man is a machine , oh shiva,
your heart is the temple, your thoughts are the god(s),
every day is nothing but a drama , oh shiva
oh human , in your lifetime all days are good days,
don’t think about tomorrows, today is the golden day,
don’t be the person who is carrying the palanquin, be the one who sits in the palanquin,
your lifetime may last 90 years, but live as though  you are 16 forever.
our fathers and fore fathers came and went,
there is nothing correct , nor anything wrong , just play as you feel,
people may say that you are simpleton , don’t feel bad about it ,
even if you eat stone today it will get digested,
as times pass they will say not to eat ,
ah if there is liquor , women ,  food,
effortlessness and the heart , that is heaven and you are ensured a place in heaven

title: [Oomai Viligal] tholvi nilayena ninaithaal….
english_stanzas:
if you think defeat is permanent, then how can one approach (think about) life,
why do we think that this life is a burden, and trample the dreams of our elders (mother) ?
we may have lost our rights,  our possessions but how can we let go of our spirit (feeling) ?
how can we forget the dream that fueled our spirit and intellectual growth?
sunrise(light)  is not far off( good times are near), why is there heaviness in your heart,
your heart is full of braveness , why then are your eyes wet?
Let there be wars , let there be blood shed, but you should not change your paths,
in the heat of blood let all the fear burn, our principles should not die.

title: [Saroja] Nimirndhu nil…
english_stanzas:
its the beginning of your age,
whatever you thought , do it ,
your thought is your main strength,
break all the hindrances,
leave the habit of postponing things,
your duties are new,
get your hands together for it,
if the path you took was the wrong one , you can’t change it now,
go on this new found path and put your efforts,
never does time  change for you,
you have to change the times , reach shores(destination) and move head
there is no “yesterday”, there is no “tomorrow”,
“today” is what you will always have,
what changes you have made till now are too small to be considered as changes,
today is your day to change and you must change,
with all the running , your legs have become tired,
with all the search your eyes have drooped, but why?
no one is born a warrior , people become warriors due o circumstances,
no one is coward, if one gets angry then there is no cowardice.
here , you life is in your hands , your speed in your heart,
now is the test for your manhood,
if you fall , fall like the waterfall,
if you rise , rise like the mountains, ( do whatever you do , the best)
if you cry , it should be only for showing love ( compassion),
whatever is here is only for friendship,
if you become tired or lie down,
there will be nothing in your life,
in the end your army will win,
in this world crores of people come and go ,
only the winners(people who did things differently) will be remembered and reveared by people,
you were a zero only in your past , from today you are a hero,
don’t ever stop since there are no hindrances in front of you.

title: [Vettaikaran] Unnai arinthaal, nee unnai arinthaal
english_stanzas:
if you know yourself, if you know yourself
your can fight in this world,
whether you reach heights  in your life, or reach lows,
you can live your life without bowing down your head  ( live with your head held high , with high esteem)
People who value honor ( dignity) as a big thing in life,
are also referred to as  “kings”,
one who understands self and also the world ,
if  you walk in a big dais (consortium of  people),
you should be adorned with garlands,
people should sing your praise saying you were a king with an untarnished reputation.

title: [Sindhu Bhairavi] Manadhil urudhi vendum ….
english_stanzas:
There should be determination (strength) in the  mind,
There should be sweetness in the words we speak,
our thoughts should be noble,
we should be able to get our hands on things near us, ( we should be able to achieve what is in our reach)
all our dreams should become true,
what ever is in our reach , we want it quickly (easily),
we need wealth and pleasure,
we need fame in this world,
our eyes should open,
what ever we do ( actions) , we need to be firm in it,
we need women liberation,
the big gods should protect us,
the land should become bountiful,
the sky should be visible ( heaven should be visible ),
truth should last and survive

title: [Lakshmi Kalyaanam] yaaradaa manidhan inge ….
english_stanzas:
who is the human here?
what remains of god’s creation, are only monkeys!
Among humans, there are dogs,
in their hearts, there are foxes,
In their looks, there are tigers,
In practice there are snakes,
In this world filled with dogs, foxes , tigers and snakes,
what is missing is the true human being with qualities of dignity, culture and knowledge.
In laughter , there is no human,
In tears, there is no human,
In heart, there is no human,
humans are all in sleep.
The beast is living , the divinty is sleeping,
In between then is the human,
if there is someone ( who embodies divinity/is divine),
the world will worship him.

title: [Panam Padaithavan] kan pona pokkile kaal pogalama
english_stanzas:
is it right for the legs to go where ever the eyes wander to?
is it right for the heart to go where ever the legs take it to?
Wherever the heart goes, can the person also to go with it?
( The main essence of the above lines is that a man’s actions and thinking should not be driven by all the worldly pleasures that his senses perceive )
Can we forget the journey that great people (human race) endeavored?
The visions that you saw will eventually be gone, just like the dreams,
he words you spoke will be forgotten with the winds,
The truths that the world saw (in terms of your good deeds), will live for you
for those who don’t realize this truth, it will be of no use
for some of us who are the fake one’s, there is a new culture ( based on western influence)
for those who don’t understand this fake culture,  it will be considered as the standard culture,
but for those who live  the straight forward (virtuous) life, what is the culture?
what ever our fore-fathers taught us, that is the culture!
what is the use of people (hearts) who don’t rectify themselves?
what is the use of the birth of people who don’t even “repent” (for their mistakes)?
whether you are alive or dead, your name (remembered as a great person who lived/ is living ) must live on,
the world must praise that there is/was no equal to you.

title: [Shanthi Nilayam] Kadavul oru naal ulagai kaana …
english_stanzas:
One fine day, god decided to come alone to see the world,
whomever he saw, he asked  “are you fine?”
one human said “life is sweet”,
another human said “life is a torture”,
the creator laughed at once on hearing these statements,
God said  “I gave the heart that does not involve in dupery, deception etc,
but then who here corrupted it with concepts of money, riches and desires? “
God said  “I gave limitless amounts of water and land,
when did humans begin to think that they owns all of it?”
God him self could not understand,
he did not understand the ideals that humans followed.
Next, god stood in the path leading to a school,
in the face/language of the innocent children he saw him self.
he saw that their hearts were overflowing with love and compassion,
happy that he saw the truth, he went back to the skies in peace, .

title: [Dharma Dorai] aan enna penn enna…
english_stanzas:
what(/who) is man? what(/who) is a women?

what(/who) are you?what(/who) am I?

all of us are the same ( species/collection),

what is the world? what is the house?

all are nothing but the same ground,

you come in after 10 months ( born after 10 months of pregnancy),
so do I ,
our acts (forms, thoughts, emotions etc) change.

each of us should support each other,

why is there separation in hearts,

both eyes are the same (both the eyes act together to provide vision, each eye doesn’t show you a different image ),

but then why is there a separation in your vision? ( in our society)

all the gold, materialistic things will go and come in life ( not constant),

only love ( affection) will never leave,

the money that we search for constantly ( all our lives) will run away,

god will never leave us.

aspiring for the podium ( popularity/prominence) , garlands ( accolades) , crores ( money) ,

why is there bloodshed and violence all around.
even after you understood it,

and after you realized the truth,

why are you still in bewilderment

when all you dear ones and relatives stay together,

there is no need of materialistic wealth,

when all the relationships break away,

there is no meaning in living this life,

when your thoughts(feelings) are united,

never will there be sorrow,

when a mother separates from its the child,

there is no happiness,

the life we live by aspiring for land, for big name , and car ( materialistic desires) ,
has no meaning

title: [Autograph] Ovvoru pookalume solgirathey ….
english_stanzas:
every flower is a testimony to the fact (says) that
life is a  battle ground where each of us tries to fight on (struggles)
what every morning says is that,
after night ( darkness) there will be  day (light),
In our lives we need to have  faith,

with it, we will surely achieve our goals some day,
Oh heart, you  transform (change your thoughts)
be it rain or snow, be ready to face it (combat) ( be ready to face any difficulty in life by developing the right mindset)
on any day or  any point of time in life, one should never be heartbroken ,
one should never get the feeling of  “What is this life?”,
Tell me, which human heart is not hurt or injured?? (Which human heart does not have lacerated feelings??)
in course of  time these feelings will vanish, this is the magic of  time
On this earth, only the stones which bear the chisel become sculptures (which are adored by others),
similarly only the heart which bears  pain  finds lasting happiness and well being .
Why do tears flow from your eyes?
If you have a dream and work towards achieving it every day, it will become a reality some day .
Let us read this poem called life, let our thinking be as vast as the sky
we should put incessant “Effort”,  and we should follow this like our breathe ( cannot survive without it)
Having numerous dreams in your eyes, and Goals  in your heart,
there is no one to win over you, fight on with determination.
Oh human!! tear up your heart and put in the seed  of these thoughts,
It will grow as a tree,
Insults and utter defeats will be manure for the seed to grow.
you can never create history without going through defeats, why are your sad , oh my friend,

if you have a determined goal which is  clear,  then the sky will be in your reach.

title: [Annai] Buddhi ulla manidhanellam ….
english_stanzas:
All the people who succeed are not necessarily intelligent
A person who possesses money (Rich) , doesn’t usually have the heart (to give)
and a person who has the heart , doesn’t usually have the money
In  a rich man’s home , every one who comes is a  relative,
for the poor, all relatives are nothing but sorrow.
not  every one who matures , falls in love,
not every couple who fall in love ,  get married,
not every couple who marry, live together,
not every couple who live together , go (die) together.
for a day dreamer,
everything he thinks is a dream,
in his dream all that
in his dream, she will come,
and smile at him,
in her dream ,who come’s?
and call’s whom? ( is unknown)

title: [Nichaya Thamboolam] Padaithaane …
english_stanzas:
He  made sorrows grow in the heart,
God gave humans the curse of forgetfulness,
he separated the heart and sorrows
When humans were monkeys, their heart
family, wife, brother (elder and younger),
all groups don’t exist,
if one gets entangled in desires,  affection, love,
he doesn’t see peace (in the heart),
so human wandered, suffered, trembled, and finally died  in all these entanglements,
and there is none who gained from all this.
In the heart of  one who is born alone,
there are no confusions  (apprehensions) ,
If one gets another life into his (marriage/other relationships) ,
it is always troublesome (painful),
in such a small human’s mind,
from the 20’s to the 60’s ,

title: [Sumaithangi] Manithan enbavan deivam aagalam….
english_stanzas:
A human can become god.
When he gives ( unconditionally and without any selfishness ( in scoops and heaps) ), he becomes a king (philanthropist),
Just like a banana tree ( whose every part is useful – signifying ultimate sacrifice) , one could  sacrifice for the good of people and be remembered as a great human,
he could spread light ( all goodness and positive energy), like the wax in the candle that melts itself to spread light.
the hearts (people) that lived for the welfare of the society  may become (noble) statues ( as a mark of respect),
a person who opens up (helps in need) for  a relationship will bear a heart that is as beautiful and pure as the beautiful flowers. ( emphasizing the importance of helping people around oneself and the concept of inclusion)
When one cries for the problems of others and gives a helping hand, he becomes a great leader,
such a heart with all these qualities, becomes a temple.
If you have the heart then even in a bird’s nest you can accommodate a deer ( emphasizing that you  are never too small to help, its all in the mindset),
if you have the vision/can see the path, then even in a grain of mustard ( something so small) you can envision a mountain ( something big) ( means that even in/with small thing , you can achieve great heights),
if you dare, then you can carry any amount of burden on your head ,
such a virtue or trait , will be considered equivalent to a temple

title: [Thai pirandhaa vazhi pirakkum] Aasaiye alai pole…
english_stanzas:
Desires are like waves,
We are like the boat on those waves, living all our life according to it (desires).
In the wind of “youth”,
The chariot of  “love” flies,
men and women feel happy (enjoy) in it,
attain serenity, and see miracles,
but then, who knows the path of tomorrow’s world today?
why does this life finish (end),
why does only the form remains?
will we get back youth,
will the hearts fill back with youth (will it regain its fragrance),
is old age a comfortable experience (happiness)?
what course time takes, who knows (has seen it)?
When a hailstorm strikes,
how can a boat sail calmly (smoothly)?
In this life, sorrows are the income,
happiness is the expenditure, present is nothing but a dream,
what calculations has time made for us, who knows ( has seen it?)?

title: [Aandavan kattalai] aaru maname aaru….
composer: M S Viswanathan and T K Ramamoorthy
english_stanzas:
heal .. oh heart … heal, god’s commands are six
for the current eroded human to live correctly,
god’s order (prescription) are the following six principles,
For people who say and do the same (What they say is what they do), they have peace in their heart (soul),
sorrow in happiness, and  happiness in sorrow,
this is the rule of the god.
When your actions follow what ever you speak that’s a golden virtue,  what ever sorrow comes to you, the happiness that follows it is the healer of the sorrow.
in the heart which  realises the above two principles,
all the good things will happen,
When one speak the truth and does  good, then the world will be charmed (impressed) by you,
when your status goes up and if you still have humility,  then the souls (world) will respect you
truth is love, and extreme humility is the hallmark of good character
in the heart which  realises  the above four principles,
desire, anger, stealth – One who possesses these characters is nothing but a beast that can speak,
Love, thankfulness, compassion – One who possesses these characters is god in human form.
in this the beast has the hidden (black , filled with bad qualities) heart,
the higher god has the child’s heart (pure)
in the heart which  realises the above six principles,
is the white heart (pure) where god lives..

title: [Nenjil or aalayam] Ninaipadhellam nadandhuvittaal ….
english_stanzas:
If everything that one thinks (wishes)  for  comes true ; then there is no (need of)  god,
If one keeps on dwelling (worrying)  about what happened all the time, then there will be no peace ever.
In God’s books, a finished story never continues,
a story that continues never ends in a human’s house,
The heart contains a thousand gates, through which a thousand feelings ( ideas) arise,
In it someone will come, some one will stay. how they came in or left will not be realized/known.
If only one person stays in it, then there will be no sorrow,
if when one is already there, another tries  to come in, then there will never be peace.
where does life start? where and how it ends?
is this the right path? is this the right journey? no one knows!
paths will change, the journey will eventually end,
if one realizes the change, the confusion will be clarified.

title: [Naadodi Mannan] Thoongadhe thambi thoongadhe…
english_stanzas: dont sleep , oh younger brother , dont sleep,
dont get the name of being a lazy guy.

the dress that you carry ( referring to the soldier) and the weapons you carry,
these prison doors will tell many historical accounts,

If power(god) was there , it would laugh at you,
only a common place for destitute and home less will give you place to live.

People who slept throughout the nice ( productive) day,
not only spoil the country , but spoil themselves.

some people just waste all the days and nights like a stone on the street ( doing nothing ),
and complain that they don’t have any luck
people who become awake will live on ( have a successful life)
and people like you , who snored ( slept their time off) will loose.
in the battle field , one who sleeps looses victory ( always fails)

In high school if you sleep , you loose education,
if in your shop you sleep , you loose your investment in the shop,
the person who sleeps over his responsibility , looses fame,
because of responsible men sleeping off ,
many golden tasks are lying idle ( undone due to the laziness of responsible people )

title: [Unnal mudiyum thambi] Unnal mudiyum thambi thambi….
english_stanzas:
You have the potential to do it , oh my younger brother ,
depend on the “you” in you to do it.
lift your arms , awaken the sleeping and falling country.
I have seen in you the heart that can finish (acheive) anything….
In tomorrow’s world you will be the leader,
have hope (confidence) and come,
a time will come when your name (and your deeds) will be etched in history
The waterfall may become dry,
but in this place the liquor flow will not stop ( reflecting the poor state of affairs of the place where everyone in intoxicated on liquor  and wasting lives),
The law made by the  people who control(the government) us,
doesn’t apply to people who have lots of money ( means all the control measures of the law are not applicable to people who have money),
The person who is drinks alcohol stands in a intoxicated state,
he keeps his family to the streets,
who  will stop all these atrocities ? you should ,
on the money of these alcohol shops , the political parties run ,
on the money of these alcohol shops , the political parties run ,
we should transform( to the good) our country before it goes to the mud ( before it is too late)
A place (town/locality) without college /School should not exist and we should burn such places ( Saying no place should be without a school  and college ),
we should transform our country so that there is no one who is uneducated,
Lets change all our temples to schools where people can study ( emphasizing that schools are more important than temples),
We will see the gopuram of knowledge then,
the sky is in your hands, knowledge is in your hearts,
the sky is in your hands, knowledge is in your hearts,
don’t think about “me” , think as “us” ( what ever we do lets not just focus on only our needs, but the community as a whole)

title: [Paavamanippu] vandha naal mudhal…
english_stanzas:
From the day we came , till today,
The sky has not changed,
the moon in the sky , fish , ocean, the wind,
the flowers, the soil (earth) , the plants (creepers) , the forest,
the river , none of these have changed,
if his status changes, he changes his character too,
daily he preaches (claims) about caste and creating differences,
he also preaches it to be the god’s way,
Human has changed, he has climbed on religion ( has gone crazy)
he saw birds, he made the plane,
In the moving fishes , he saw the idea of a boat
he heard echo , he made the radio,
what did he see? to invent money?
all the pleasures and love is the way of nature,
ups and downs are the castes of human,
what ever the nature created in this whole world,
the sinned human , has separated it all

title: [Aalayamani] satti suttadhadaa…
composer: M S Viswanathan and T K Ramamoorthy
english_stanzas:
The mud pot got baked,
hence it left the hand  (The clay of the mud pot no longer sticks in the hand , and hence leaves it)
Wisdom (heart) has dawned in me  ( The mind no longer wants the materialistic needs),
only after all the things happened,
I knew which are good and which are bad.
In one half of my heart  god was present and  took care,
however in the remaining half the beast was present and made me dance to its tunes.
Now the beast to whose tunes I was dancing to, has diminished (subsided)
as a result , the whole heart is now taken over by the silent god and transformed it into a temple  ( and peace remains)
All the loud demons ( materialistic desires , greed, show off etc ) have run away,
The sound of the temple bell has filled my heart ( the path to god and eternity has dawned into me).
At the temple of  lord of dharma (God), I can see the light ignited
The heart is saying peace, peace, peace and is getting freed from anxiety
when the skin of the ant was peeled , an elephant emerged ,
In the same way I peeled my heart and saw knowledge emerge ( enlightenment)
today I am getting the (state of) heart , that was , before my birth (pure)
I am experiencing the silence that comes after death

title: [Apoorva raagangal] yelu swarangalukkul yethanai paadal…
english_stanzas:
Within the depths of one’s heart (depicted as a tunnel), how many innumerable questions?
In the people we see, how many innumerable disturbances (indecisions),
all his (human’s) attention is for mere  imaginary pleasures,
As soon you wake up in the morning, you are worried about the tomorrow!
once you reach it also, your soul is restless ,
the question of “why”  always stays along,
In human’s happiness or sadness, finally what remains is only a question,
You can cry on my behalf, this can naturally happen,
however how can you eat  for me? ( you have to eat to satisfy your hunger, some body else eating on your behalf would not reduce your hunger),
In this earth each of us has our duties to perform,
its good to perform these duties with our own hands , for ourselves.
In the beginning, your birth is not in your hands,

always, what happens after another, is also not in your hands,

Once you have decided on a path to be taken,  what is the use of getting scared?

take the path and go ahead with your journey, all the sins will  disappear
always live tomorrow in the belief that it is for us,
to guide us along there is someone, find it in the temple,
believe that your time will come,
every sorrow will vanish  like a passing cloud.

title: [Sumaithangi] mayakkamaa kalakkamaa….
english_stanzas:
are you bewildered? baffled?
is your heart in a confused state?
is your life in a trembling state? ( are you fearful?/ are there a lot of uncertainties?)
In life, there are one thousand things that may happen ( good or bad),
every doorstep ( signifying that every person) has its share of worries,
what ever may be the suffering you are going through,
if you wilt(droop) seeing the suffering , the sufferings ( problems) will not go away,
if you have a heart that can bear anything ( strong heart),
till the end you will be in peace
make your poor heart into a mansion,
through day and night recite(sing) poems ( in praise of god) ,
Leave the worries of tomorrow to god,
Try to search for peace in your current life ( Don’t focus on tomorrows, god will take care of it , focus on what is there today and seek peace in it)
There are millions below you,
think about their life and seek peace ( that you are in a much better position than them)

title: [Paalum Palamum] ponal pogattum podaa…
english_stanzas: if it went , let it be gone ,
In this earth , who is going to live permanently anyway?

We know that we came ( how , when and where – all known ), what we don’t know is where we are going ,

If every one who came stays back, where is the space for all of us on this earth?

Life is, but a business,

where birth is the income,

and death is the expenditure.

When the lender asks for his stuff back, will he leave you when you refuse to give back?

if you cry (plead) citing your relationship , will he give back the life ( that’s already left)?

even if you yell (shout, cry loudly) , you will not get it back

neither can you win it in the court,

Once you enter that fortress (of death) , you can’t return

I have found (seen/know) cure for the bones and flesh,

but why dint I find (seen/know ) a cure for this (death)?

If I had its cure , would I leave her alone in the burning fire ( signifying burning of body after death),

There is one ( supreme /god) above us all,

he is the leader who knows everything,

who is an artist playing drama everyday.

title: [Padagoti] koduththadelaam koduththaan …
english_stanzas:
the one who gave us everything that we have,
for whom did he give it to?
did he give it to one person?
no, he gave it for the whole community ( world).
if you have a hut made of mud ,
does the breeze hate coming into your house entrance ?
( just as the breeze doesn’t differentiate whether it is entering a rich man or a poor man’s house , we are all equal)
The evening moon , knowing that a person is poor,
does it deny giving light to him?
differentiation such as “For you a particular thing , for me a another thing” ,
is not what god does , god never differentiates in what he gives us.
We can’t blame the creator for the current state,
The one who is hungry has committed no sin,
The one who got it (rich capitalists) , shared among themselves,
The one’s who enabled it ( rather gave)(workers) ,are on the streets,
For many people to wilt away, and only for some to move ahead and live a rich life,
this is not the reason for which god gave us all that we have.
Until there are “have-nots”,
the people who “have” will say they dont have ,
Such people although have their laps full of materialistic wealth,
their hearts are full of darkness
